title: Robotic Simulation Engineer
description:
Who You Are

As our new Robotic Simulation Engineer, you will be responsible for robotic and system simulation services to the Process Engineering group.

We need a strategic, problem-solving professional who is customer-focused, results-oriented, and experienced in partnering with internal teams and customers to deliver solutions that meet or exceed expectations. You’ll be responsible for creating and maintaining robotic simulations using software like ROBOGUIDE, Process Simulate, and Emulate3D. You’ll take part in proposal and design reviews, project meetings while supporting integration and hardware builds where you will collaborate with various engineering teams. Are you ready? Apply today!

How It’s Done

  • Ensure proposed solutions meet required capacity parameters, including throughput, jobs per hour (JPH), cycle time, and annual capacity
  • Ensure all reliability and maintainability data, including mean time to repair (MTTR), and mean time between failures (MTBF), reject rate, and availability, is accurately captured and used in throughput simulations
  • Identify bottlenecks and recommend solutions to right-size the capacity of an operation
  • Set up and document all aspects of the workcell simulation, including cycle time, robot data sheets, DCS sheets, simulation videos, payload sheets, and related deliverables
  • Configure, emulate, troubleshoot, and validate PLC logic, automation hardware, safety interlocks, and system communications using electrical and control system documentation to support virtual commissioning
  • Configure and integrate hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and software-in-the-loop (SIL) control systems with virtual commissioning platforms, robotic simulations, and industrial networks using protocols such as Ethernet/IP, PROFINET, and OPC UA
  • Perform electrical controls testing, signal verification, and root-cause analysis within the virtual environment, providing technical feedback and design recommendations to controls, electrical, and project engineering teams prior to system deployment

What You Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field or equivalent relevant experience
  • Exposure to and basic understanding of PLCs and other controls hardware (i.e. HMIs, safety devices, sensors)
  • Proficiency in industry-standard simulation software (i.e. Siemens Process Simulate or Plant Simulate, Rockwell Automation Emulate3D, FANUC ROBOGUIDE)
  • Experience deploying cells while connecting PLCs, HMIs, and robot controllers virtually and validating sequence logic and error recovery
  • Exposure setting up AMRs simulation paths specific to the automotive industry
  • Demonstrated knowledge of safety standards (i.e. ANSI/RIA R15.06-2012, ISO 10218-1) and robotic system safety/risk assessment

What Would Be Even Better

  • Master’s degree in a related field
  • 6+ years of experience in process/systems engineering
  • 6+ years of work experience in robotic simulation using one or more of the software tools listed above

It’s Your Move

At FANUC America Corporation we are passionate about our customers, our employees, and the work we perform. We maintain a workplace where individuals can be proud of, where talents are embraced, and results are encouraged and supported.

We are looking for talented people who value integrity, informed decision-making and collaboration. If you believe you are one of those talented people and are interested in being considered for a career at FANUC America, we invite you to apply today!

We offer market competitive pay and benefits programs, as well as opportunities for advancement, knowledge and skill development, and recognition of individual achievements. In addition, we offer the following benefits to our employees:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Program

It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing. At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are more than just a coffee company. We are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company that makes a difference one cup at a time.

title: Sustaining Systems Engineer
description:
About The Role

The Sustaining Systems Engineer will be responsible for assessing ECO’s, change requests, debug, and coordination and creation of validation plans to support mass production server platforms. In addition, the Systems Engineer will play a critical role in documenting key learnings and proposing/designing new and complex system requirements for future programs as improved methodologies and system designs evolve on next generation server products.

What You’ll Do

  • Determine system specifications, I/O processes, and working parameters for hardware/software compatibility.
  • Coordinate the validation/debug/design of subsystems and the integration of the total system.
  • Maintain updated overall server and system product configurations as they evolve during the sustenance phase through EoL.
  • Work as part of a cross-functional team to define/create validation and debug methodologies for customer change requests, alternative source part validation, 2nd source qualifications, updated FW/BMC/UEFI, etc.
  • Optimize system performance and resolve performance problems post launch.
  • Ensure and maintain the manufacturability, reliability, and serviceability of designs.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineer or Computer Science and 6+ years of server design experience (alternatively a MS and 4+ years)

  • Robust technical knowledge and expertise in Platform execution

  • Board level development skills
  • Good understanding of hardware and system software interactions, and ability to apply this knowledge to resolve technical issues
  • Proactively oriented to seize opportunities and identify potential problems

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

White Collar Factory (95009), United Kingdom, London, London

Senior Software Engineer

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer

Location: London - Hybrid

Working Pattern: 3 days in-office (Tuesday-Thursday) and 2 days remote.

Our Mission

We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. Throughout our almost 30-year history, we’ve consistently been recognised as a great place to work; in 2026, Capital One was officially ranked 9th in the UK’s Best Workplaces™ list. Hear from our team about what it’s like working at Capital One UK.

About the Role

Working in and across tech teams is a natural part of our outcome-based culture, so you’ll have plenty of opportunity to talk, coach and learn with many great and diverse individuals.

In this role, you will design, develop, test, and maintain software products that automate core business processes. You will walk in the shoes of our users, collaborating with Business, Technology, and Operations teams to build frictionless, high-impact solutions.

Please apply if you are keen to work with the following technology stack. You do not need to be an expert in all of these areas; we are primarily looking for excellent problem solvers with a strong willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies:

  • Java (built with Gradle), makes up most of our services, although Typescript and Python can be found in the right places
  • Cloud & AWS technologies, driving our journey into public cloud architecture
  • Docker, for our containerised applications
  • Jenkins, for continuous integration and deployment

And meet most of the following:

  • You are passionate about creating products that produce good customer outcomes
  • You enjoy working with other technologists, alongside product, design and other disciplines
  • You want to contribute to new designs of new product iterations, thinking strategically about architectural decisions and can communicate well with stakeholders
  • You appreciate the sensitivity of customer data and the resiliency, performance and security that demands
  • You enjoy automation (unified deployment pipelines, automated testing) and aspire to automate all but the creative problem solving
  • You want to develop yourself, with access to various support systems (learning, mentorship, conferences, progression)

Where and how you'll work

This is a permanent position based in our London office.

We embrace a hybrid approach to work. You'll spend three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday), with Monday and Friday being dedicated work-from-home days.

Our offices are designed to inspire and support you. Our London office boasts a rooftop running track and coffee bar.

What’s in it for you

We invest in the growth of our people alongside our business. You will have extensive opportunities to learn and develop your career, including access to up to £5,000 in funding for external qualifications.

In addition to career development, our comprehensive benefits package is designed to grow with you, ensuring your wellbeing is prioritised at every stage of your career:

  • Wealth & Future: Competitive pension and performance-based bonus schemes
  • Holidays: Start with 25 days of annual leave, increasing with tenure. Need more? You have the option to buy 5 additional days.
  • Health: Access premium care through our private medical insurance.
  • Family Support: We champion your milestones with enhanced parental leave.

A full list of our benefits is available here.

What you should know about how we recruit

We pride ourselves on hiring the best people, not the same people. Building diverse and inclusive teams is the right thing to do and the smart thing to do. We want to work with top talent: whoever you are, whatever you look like, wherever you come from. We know it’s about what you do, not just what you say. That’s why we make our recruitment process fair and accessible.

We value diversity, inclusion and belonging at our core. We empower our associates to do great work by creating an inclusive culture—one that values diverse perspectives, fosters collaboration and encourages innovative ideas—and a place where associates of all backgrounds can thrive by bringing their most authentic selves to work. We call this our Culture of Belonging, and it rests at the heart of our business.

Our associate-led Business Resource Groups were created to help support our diverse population and include over 10 groups across our offices. Because each Business Resource Group is as unique as the population it serves, they offer a range of activities, networking opportunities, special events and learning programmes to associates.

Capital One is committed to diversity in the workplace.

If you require a reasonable adjustment, please contact ukrecruitment@capitalone.com All information will be kept confidential and will only be used for the purpose of applying a reasonable adjustment.

For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com

Capital One does not provide, endorse nor guarantee and is not liable for third-party products, services, educational tools or other information available through this site.

Capital One Financial is made up of several different entities. Please note that any position posted in Canada is for Capital One Canada, any position posted in the United Kingdom is for Capital One Europe and any position posted in the Philippines is for Capital One Philippines Service Corp. (COPSSC).


Who We Are

At Capital One, we're building a leading information-based technology company. Still founder-led by Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard Fairbank, Capital One is on a mission to help our customers succeed by bringing ingenuity, simplicity, and humanity to banking. We measure our efforts by the success our customers enjoy and the advocacy they exhibit. We are succeeding because they are succeeding.

Guided by our shared values, we thrive in an environment where collaboration and openness are valued. We believe that innovation is powered by perspective and that teamwork and respect for each other lead to superior results. We elevate each other and obsess about doing the right thing. Our associates serve with humility and a deep respect for their responsibility in helping our customers achieve their goals and realize their dreams. Together, we are on a quest to change banking for good.

title: Senior Associate (Insurance, Cyber and Technology)
description:
Cyber & Technology Insurance Senior Associate

Location: Central London


The Opportunity

An excellent opportunity to join a highly regarded and growing London law firm with a strong reputation across the insurance, cyber and technology markets.

The firm's Data & Cyber practice is expanding and works with a sophisticated client base on complex and high-value matters. The team combines specialist cyber expertise with deep insurance knowledge, providing lawyers with exposure to a broad range of work across cyber incidents, insurance coverage, technology, data protection and disputes.

This is an opportunity to work closely with leading Partners on challenging matters, gain significant client exposure and play an active role in a growing practice.


The Team

The Data & Cyber team advises insurers, insureds, brokers and major corporates on the legal and insurance implications of cyber incidents and technology-related risks.

The work covers the full lifecycle of a cyber event from immediate breach response and ransomware incidents through to insurance notification, coverage strategy, regulatory engagement, claims and dispute resolution.

The team also continues to expand its work with corporates outside the traditional insurance market, providing advice on cyber preparedness, incident response, remediation and data-related issues.


The Role

The successful Associate or Senior Associate will work alongside Partners on a varied caseload involving cyber and technology insurance, coverage and incident response.

A key part of the role will involve advising insurers and insureds on cyber insurance policies, coverage positions and claims strategy, including complex and high-value multi-insurer matters.

You will also have exposure to cyber incident response, ransomware and cyber-extortion matters, regulatory issues, data protection and technology-related disputes.

The role involves direct client contact and working closely with brokers, forensic specialists, incident response providers and other advisers. At Senior Associate level, there will also be opportunities to take responsibility for matters and supervise junior lawyers.


Key responsibilities include:

  • Advising insurers, insureds and brokers on cyber insurance coverage, policy interpretation and claims strategy.
  • Working on complex and high-value cyber claims, including multi-insurer matters and allocation issues.
  • Advising on technology, cyber and professional liability coverage, including technology E&O exposures.
  • Supporting clients through cyber incidents, including ransomware and cyber-extortion matters.
  • Advising on regulatory implications of cyber incidents, including ICO engagement.
  • Supporting technology and data-related claims and disputes, including ADR, mediation and litigation where appropriate.
  • Advising on data subject and third-party claims arising from cyber incidents.
  • Working with data protection specialists on issues including DSARs and international data transfers.
  • Managing relationships with clients, brokers, technical specialists and other advisers.
  • Supervising junior lawyers and taking greater responsibility for matters at Senior Associate level.


What They're Looking For

The firm is keen to hear from lawyers with experience across cyber, technology, insurance coverage, data or related disputes.


Ideally, you will have:

  • Experience in cyber breach response, insurance coverage and/or cyber or technology claims.
  • Experience advising on cyber insurance policies and coverage issues.
  • Exposure to complex, high-value or multi-insurer claims is advantageous.
  • An understanding of cyber incident response and the ability to operate effectively under pressure.
  • Experience of technology and data-related claims or disputes, with ADR, litigation or arbitration experience beneficial.


Why Consider the Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to build a genuine specialism across cyber, technology, insurance and data, working on sophisticated and often high-profile matters.

With the practice continuing to grow, there is scope to take on increasing responsibility, develop strong client relationships and play a meaningful role in the continued success of the team.

title: Sr. Analyst, Last Mile
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Analyst, Last Mile based in the United States.

This role supports the growth and day-to-day performance of a fast-moving Last Mile eCommerce business across major delivery platforms.
You will combine data analysis, campaign execution, promotional planning, and cross-functional coordination to improve commercial outcomes.
The role provides visibility into platform performance, customer marketing, retail media, digital shelf execution, and omnichannel strategy.
You will translate complex performance data into clear insights and practical recommendations for internal and external stakeholders.
Working closely with commercial, marketing, finance, analytics, and platform teams, you will help ensure initiatives are executed accurately and efficiently.
The position offers an opportunity to build expertise in an evolving digital commerce environment while contributing to broader organizational learning.
Success will depend on strong ownership, analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to move multiple priorities forward with speed and accuracy.

Accountabilities

  • Support business management across priority Last Mile platforms, tracking performance, identifying opportunities, and helping maintain strong day-to-day execution.

  • Analyze platform, campaign, promotional, and category performance to identify trends, generate actionable insights, and support optimization recommendations.

  • Build and maintain recurring scorecards, trackers, dashboards, and reporting tools covering key eCommerce and Last Mile KPIs.

  • Support the planning and execution of media, promotional, merchandising, and test-and-learn initiatives, coordinating assets, inputs, budgets, invoices, and follow-up actions.

  • Partner with Omni Shopper Marketing, Retail Media, Sales, Finance, Marketing, Business Analytics, and external platform teams to align plans and ensure effective execution.

  • Identify and communicate best practices, business learnings, and performance insights to strengthen Last Mile capabilities and decision-making.

  • Support digital shelf and platform execution initiatives designed to improve the consumer experience and commercial performance.

  • Proactively identify risks, resolve issues, and maintain ownership of deliverables from planning through completion.

  • Contribute to performance visibility, budget and billing accuracy, cross-functional alignment, and the development of a broader Last Mile learning agenda.

    • Requirements

    • 3–5 years of experience in eCommerce, customer marketing, sales analytics, retail media, marketing, or a related commercial field.

    • Strong understanding of CPG, eCommerce, and omnichannel business dynamics.

    • Strong analytical capabilities, including proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint and comfort working with dashboards, scorecards, KPIs, and multiple data sources.

    • Ability to translate performance data and business trends into concise insights, compelling narratives, and practical business recommendations.

    • Strong written, verbal, visual, and presentation skills, including the ability to develop clear and effective PowerPoint materials.

    • Demonstrated project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy, organization, and follow-through.

    • Ability to establish productive cross-functional relationships and influence stakeholders through collaboration, credibility, and clear communication.

    • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-changing environments while balancing speed, accuracy, and business priorities.

    • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to work independently while proactively keeping stakeholders informed and aligned.

    • Experience with Last Mile platforms such as Instacart or DoorDash is preferred.

    • Experience partnering with Marketing, Sales, Retail Media, and eCommerce teams is preferred.

    • Familiarity with syndicated data, customer marketing, promotional planning, platform reporting, digital shelf, search, or related eCommerce metrics is advantageous.

      • Benefits

      • Base salary range of $89,800–$112,200, with actual compensation varying based on factors such as geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity.

      • Eligibility for a performance-based bonus subject to applicable plan terms.

      • National remote work arrangement from the employee's home.

      • Flexible work arrangements, depending on role and employment circumstances.

      • Healthcare benefits including medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage.

      • Paid time off, company holidays, and applicable leave programs.

      • Retirement savings through a 401(k) plan.

      • Life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment, and disability coverage.

      • Employee assistance and wellbeing programs supporting physical, social, emotional, and financial wellbeing.

      • Family support programs, recognition opportunities, training, and professional development resources.

      • Opportunities to work across eCommerce, customer marketing, retail media, sales, finance, and analytics functions.

      • Some travel for internal meetings and external partner visits.

description:

title: Shift Lead
description:
Shift Lead (Operations Lead)

HRforGrowth® is engaged as the exclusive talent acquisition partner to conduct this search on behalf of a client organization that is hiring for this role. HRforGrowth is not the employer for this position. HRforGrowth identifies, evaluates, and presents top-tier candidates through its global talent acquisition practice; all employment decisions — including final selection, offer terms, compensation, and conditions of employment — are made solely by the hiring organization.

Position Summary

The Shift Lead serves as the operational lead on the warehouse floor and acts as the Supervisor's primary support partner. Similar to an Amazon Process Assistant (PA), this role functions as the Supervisor's "right-hand person," helping coordinate daily operations, lead employees, and ensure productivity, safety, quality, and customer service objectives are achieved.

This is a hands-on leadership role focused on executing operational plans, training employees, managing workflow, and supporting warehouse systems and processes. The Shift Lead does not have hiring, termination, or disciplinary authority but provides day-to-day leadership and direction to the hourly workforce. In the Supervisor's absence, the Shift Lead may oversee daily operations to ensure continuity and service levels are maintained.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

  • Support the Supervisor in managing daily warehouse operations.

  • Provide work direction and leadership to hourly team members.

  • Coordinate labor and workflow to meet productivity goals, customer SLAs, and KPIs.

  • Lead shift start-up meetings, daily stand-ups, and operational communications.

  • Serve as the primary floor leader and first point of escalation for operational issues.

  • Step into operational leadership responsibilities when the Supervisor is unavailable.

Training and Team Development

  • Train, coach, and mentor employees on procedures, safety practices, quality standards, and system processes.

  • Support new hire onboarding and cross-training initiatives.

  • Provide performance feedback and observations to Supervisors.

  • Reinforce accountability, teamwork, and operational excellence.

Systems, Documentation, and Compliance

  • Utilize and support Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), RF scanners, voice technology, and related warehouse systems.

  • Maintain production records, operational paperwork, and shift documentation.

  • Update work instructions, process documentation, and workflow procedures as needed.

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, quality requirements, and ISO procedures where applicable.

Continuous Improvement and Safety

  • Promote Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Support 5S workplace organization standards.

  • Conduct safety, quality, and housekeeping audits as assigned.

  • Identify and communicate opportunities to improve productivity, efficiency, and process performance.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Partner with operations leadership and cross-functional teams to achieve business objectives.

  • Support inventory accuracy and operational performance targets.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Scope

The Shift Lead provides operational leadership and work direction but is not responsible for:

  • Hiring

  • Terminations

  • Formal disciplinary actions

  • Employee relations decisions

The role serves as the team's hourly operational leader and supports execution of daily business objectives.

Qualifications

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED required, an Associate's or Bachelor's degree is a plus

Experience

  • Minimum 2 years of warehouse, manufacturing, logistics, distribution, or fulfillment center experience required.

  • Previous leadership, lead, team lead, or process assistant experience required.

  • Experience working in automated or technology-driven warehouse environments preferred.

  • Lean Manufacturing experience preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong leadership and coaching abilities.

  • Working knowledge of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and standard warehouse technology.

  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to prioritize work, manage multiple tasks, and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  • High attention to detail and commitment to safety and quality standards.

Physical Requirements

  • Stand and walk for extended periods.

  • Frequent bending, reaching, lifting, and carrying.

  • Ability to lift up to 40 pounds independently and heavier loads in a team-lift environment.

  • Ability to work in a warehouse environment with varying temperatures and production conditions.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

The Digital and Synthetic Capability Unit (D&S) is committed to providing mission-driven information solutions that seamlessly bridge the digital and physical realms. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies and advanced platforms, we empower operational readiness and elevate situational awareness across diverse domains—including air, maritime, and space.

Position Summary

Metrea is seeking a dynamic and highly motivated individual to join our software development team, building business software solutions and visualisations for the Enterprise.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, and maintain well-tested, scalable code in alignment with our engineering principles and standards
  • Lead the delivery of features and enhancements to production, coordinating cross-functionally where needed
  • Architect, design, and implement microservices or monolithic solutions to improve functionality and performance
  • Apply strong understanding of system architecture and design patterns to propose and implement effective technical solutions
  • Troubleshoot, debug and resolve production issues, including conducting root cause analysis and implementing preventative improvements
  • Actively contribute to code reviews, providing constructive feedback to uphold and elevate overall code quality across the team
  • Collaborate effectively with teammates and stakeholders, contributing to technical discussions and leading design decisions
  • Proactively identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks and architectural improvements, and drive initiatives to address them
  • Consistently adhere to and help reinforce our Ways of Working, contributing to process improvements where appropriate
  • Communicate progress, risks and trade-offs clearly to the team and relevant stakeholders to ensure alignment with the product roadmap

What You Bring

  • 6 years of experience as a backend engineer with a strong focus on web development, REST APIs and software architecture ideally with Python frameworks
  • BSc level qualification in Software Engineering or equivalent Computer Science related discipline
  • Strong understanding and practical experience of web development using Python Frameworks e.g. Django/FastAPI
  • Experience with cloud technologies, preferably Azure, and tools like Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, Elasticsearch
  • Understanding and/or experience of team delivery in an Agile software development environment
  • Drive to learn constantly and further your knowledge
  • Strong leadership, organisational skills, proactive approach to task delivery and required documentation
  • Great interpersonal skills, able to confidently communicate and articulate technical issues to non-technical team members

Benefits

  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Subsided gym membership / plans through Wellhub
  • Electric Car scheme
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Free lunch on office days
  • Enhanced Parental Leave
  • 30 days annual PTO plus b/h
  • Bonus Scheme
  • Personal development opportunities

Work Authorization / Security Clearance

The employee will have the legal right to work in the United Kingdom and will be able to produce right to work documentation. Employee must undergo a minimum of BPSS check. Employee must be willing to sign the Official Secrets Act.

AAP/EEO Statement

Metrea is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time non-exempt position with typical working hours of Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Hours and work shifts may change in accordance with department and business needs. Exempt Employees must have the ability to be on-call and available, as business needs require. Non-Exempt employees may be required to work over 40 hours per week with approval from the department manager.

Work Environment

This job operates on a hybrid working split, with a requirement of three days per week of office-based work.

Travel

This role may require occasional travel to other Metrea UK offices.

Our Firmware

At Metrea, our single core value is Rooted in Humility, and our four cornerstone attributes are Entrepreneurial, Systematic, Discerning, and Over-Deliver. These form what we call our Teammate Firmware. Just like technical firmware connects software and hardware, our Firmware is the constant interface between our mission and our people. It defines how we show up, how we work together, and how we solve complex problems.

Our team Firmware creates a web-like, hyper-collaborative, dynamically hierarchical way of working that helps us adapt quickly, communicate openly, and distribute decision-making to where expertise actually lives. It enables groups to self-organize around hard problems, shift fluidly as priorities evolve, and operate with the trust, curiosity, and discipline required in a complex mission space. This foundation allows us to deliver elegant, effective solutions and uphold our purpose: protecting our precious inheritance.

title: Senior Analyst, IT Change & Configuration Management
description:
The Senior Analyst – IT Change & Configuration Management is responsible for the governance, administration, execution, and continual improvement of the organization's IT Change Management and Configuration Management processes.


This position oversees and coordinates the end-to-end IT Change Management lifecycle while supporting the integrity, accuracy, completeness, and governance of Configuration Items (CIs) and their relationships within the Configuration Management Database (CMDB).

The Senior Analyst will report to the IT Change & Configuration Management Lead and work closely with cross-functional technology teams, including Infrastructure, Applications, Network, Cloud, Database, IT security, Service Desk, Enterprise Architecture and Managed Service Providers (MSPs).


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

IT Change Management

  • Administer, coordinate, and govern IT Change Management process for standard, normal, and emergency changes with established policies, procedures, and approvals.
  • Review Change Requests for completeness, accuracy, and compliance, including business justification, implementation plans, testing and validation plans, risk and impact assessments, rollback/back-out procedures, dependencies, and outage requirements.
  • Evaluate proposed changes for operational, technical, security, business, and service impacts and ensure appropriate risk mitigation measures are documented.
  • Facilitate and support Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings, including agendas, review proposed changes, documentation of decisions, approval tracking, and follow-up actions.
  • Monitor change execution and maintain reporting on successful, failed, backed out, cancelled, emergency, and unauthorized changes.
  • Coordinate and document Post-Implementation Reviews (PIRs) for significant, unsuccessful, high-risk, emergency, or business-impacting changes and ensure corrective and preventive actions are appropriately tracked to completion.
  • Identify recurring change-related incidents, process deficiencies, control gaps, and opportunities to improve change quality and service stability.
  • Ensure Change Management records, approvals, supporting documentation, and audit evidence are complete, accurate, and retained.
  • Promote adherence to Change Management policies, standards, procedures, and control requirements across internal technology teams and third-party service providers.

Configuration Management / CMDB

  • Support the governance and administration of the enterprise Configuration Management Database (CMDB) and associated processes.
  • Maintain and improve the accuracy, completeness, integrity, ownership, and lifecycle status of application, infrastructure, network, database, cloud, business service, and other Configuration Items.
  • Perform periodic CMDB audits, reconciliation activities, CI certifications, and data-quality assessments to identify and remediate duplicate, orphaned, incomplete, stale, inaccurate, or non-compliant CI records.
  • Coordinate CI onboarding, modification, ownership transfer, lifecycle updates, relationship management, and decommissioning in accordance with established Configuration Management standards.
  • Maintain and validate CI relationships and service mappings to ensure business services, applications, infrastructure components, and technical dependencies are accurately represented.
  • Review implemented changes that require CMDB updates and ensure approved configuration changes are accurately and promptly reflected within the CMDB.
  • Support automated discovery, service mapping, integrations, reconciliation processes, and other technologies used to populate and maintain CMDB information.
  • Collaborate with CI owners, application owners, service owners, technical teams, and Managed Service Providers to resolve CMDB data-quality issues.
  • Establish and reinforce compliance with CI naming conventions, data standards, mandatory attributes, ownership requirements, relationship standards, certification schedules, and other CMDB governance controls.
  • Support initiatives to improve CMDB health, configuration visibility, service dependency mapping, and overall data reliability.

ITSM Governance, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Support broader IT Service Management (ITSM) processes and their integration with Change and Configuration Management, including Incident, Problem, Asset, Service Request, Knowledge, Service Level, and related service management practices.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance operational dashboards, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), management reports, and governance reporting for Change Management and CMDB performance.
  • Monitor and analyze key measures including:
    • Change success and failure rates.
    • Backed out and cancelled changes
    • Emergency and Unauthorized changes
    • CAB and PIR effectiveness
    • CMDB health and completeness
    • CI data accuracy and certification compliance
    • Duplicate and orphaned CI records
    • CI relationship and service-mapping integrity
    • Timeliness of configuration updates
    • Process and policy compliance.
  • Analyze operational trends, recurring issues, process gaps, control weaknesses, and data-quality concerns and recommend corrective or improvement actions.
  • Identify opportunities for workflow optimization, process standardization, automation, and integration across Change Management and Configuration Management processes.
  • Develop, maintain, and periodically review policies, procedures, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process flows, work instructions, governance documentation, and supporting controls.
  • Support internal and external audits and provide evidence required for applicable technology governance, cybersecurity, risk management, regulatory, and compliance.
  • Partner with control owners, auditors, risk teams, and technology stakeholders to address findings and implement sustainable remediation actions.
  • Provide guidance, training, and subject-matter support to technology teams regarding Change Management practices, CMDB standards, documentation requirements, risk assessments, CI ownership, and governance expectations.
  • Promote continual service improvement through process enhancements, improved stakeholder accountability, increased automation, and adoption of ITSM best practices.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of IT Service Management experience, including hands-on responsibility for IT Change Management and CMDB in an enterprise technology environment.
  • Experience supporting CMDB processes, including CI lifecycle management, CI relationships, reconciliation, certification, data-quality controls, and governance.
  • Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable enterprise ITSM and CMDB platform.
  • General understanding of enterprise technology environments, including applications, infrastructure, networking, databases, and cloud services.
  • Experience developing operational reports, dashboards, KPIs, metrics, and management information used to evaluate process performance and compliance.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, documentation, and process-management capabilities.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL Change Enablement and Service Configuration Management.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing and governing Change Requests, facilitating CAB processes, and coordinating Post-Implementation Reviews.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical teams, business stakeholders, and external service providers.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, identify operational risks, drive issue resolution, and work effectively within a structured governance environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical and process requirements to both technical and non-technical audiences.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • ITIL 3 or 4 Foundation certification
  • ServiceNow certification such as Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS), or a related ServiceNow credential.
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow CMDB, Discovery and Service Mapping.
  • Experience supporting technology governance, enterprise risk management, internal or external audit, regulatory compliance, or Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) control environments.
  • Familiarity with public cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  • Experience working with globally distributed technology organizations, outsourced technology functions, or Managed Service Providers (MSPs).
  • Experience supporting CMDB maturity initiatives, service mapping programs, ITSM transformations, or process automation initiatives.

KEY COMPETENCIES

Successful candidates should demonstrate:

  • IT Service Management and ITIL process knowledge
  • Change governance and operational risk management
  • CMDB and configuration data governance
  • Data quality management and analytical thinking
  • Continuous improvement and process optimization
  • Strong diligence and cross functional collaboration
  • Effective written and verbal communication
  • Problem-solving and root-cause analysis
  • Ability to influence process compliance without direct authority

SUCCESS MEASURES

Performance in this role will be evaluated based on measurable improvements in the following:

  • Timely completion of required Post-Implementation Reviews and corrective actions.
  • Improved CMDB health, accuracy, completeness, and certification compliance.
  • Reduction in duplicate, orphaned, stale, inaccurate, and non-compliant CI records.
  • Improved accuracy and completeness of CI relationships and service mappings.
  • Timely incorporation of approved configuration changes into the CMDB
  • Improved overall change success rates and service stability.
  • Reduction in failed, backed-out, emergency, and unauthorized changes.
  • Successful completion of internal and external audit, risk, and compliance activities.
  • Increased accountability among CI owners, service owners, technical teams, and MSPs
  • Improved quality and effectiveness of Change Management and CMDB reporting metrics.
  • Demonstrable process improvements through standardization, automation, improved controls, and continual service improvement.

The anticipated base salary for this position is $108,000-$135,000. This role may also qualify for annual incentive and/or comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including without limitation, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and if applicable, the location of the position.

title: AI Developer
description:
Location: Burbank, CA
Employment Type: Full-Time
Compensation: $80,000 - $130,000 annually

About the Role

Block LLP is seeking a hands-on AI Developer to design, build, and maintain AI-powered applications, automations, and integrations that improve how our firm operates.

This role will focus on turning real business and legal workflows into functional technology solutions. The AI Developer will work closely with firm leadership, our AI Implementation team, and departments across the organization to develop internal AI tools that improve efficiency, reduce repetitive work, and help our teams work more effectively.

Unlike a traditional software development role, this position sits at the intersection of software engineering, artificial intelligence, automation, and legal operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable writing code, working with large language models and APIs, experimenting with new technologies, and taking an idea from prototype through deployment.

About Block LLP

Block LLP is a rapidly growing plaintiff personal injury law firm dedicated to delivering exceptional results and exemplary service to our clients. We are passionate about helping injured individuals and families navigate some of life's most challenging moments with compassion, advocacy, and expertise.

Our culture is built around five core values: Vibrant Culture, Teamwork, Relentless Pursuit of Excellence, Dependability, and Exemplary Service. These values guide how we support our clients, collaborate with one another, and approach our work every day.

What You'll Do

AI Application Development

  • Design, build, test, and maintain internal AI-powered applications and tools.
  • Develop solutions using large language models (LLMs) and platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, or comparable technologies.
  • Build AI assistants and agents that support legal and operational workflows across the firm.
  • Develop tools for tasks such as document analysis, information extraction, summarization, internal knowledge retrieval, and workflow automation.
  • Take projects from initial prototype through testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement.

AI Agents & Knowledge Systems

  • Build AI agents capable of completing multi-step tasks and interacting with firm systems.
  • Develop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions that allow AI applications to securely retrieve information from internal documents and knowledge sources.
  • Create and optimize prompts, agent instructions, tool integrations, and AI workflows.
  • Build processes to evaluate AI outputs for accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
  • Improve existing AI applications based on employee feedback, usage, and performance.

APIs & Systems Integration

  • Build integrations between AI applications and existing firm software using APIs, webhooks, and other integration methods.
  • Connect AI tools with business systems, databases, document repositories, and third-party applications.
  • Develop automated workflows that securely move information between systems and reduce manual work.
  • Work with automation platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or comparable technologies when appropriate.
  • Troubleshoot and maintain integrations as systems and business needs evolve.

Software Development

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Develop primarily in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Work with structured and unstructured data, databases, APIs, and common business file formats.
  • Use source control and development best practices to manage code and application changes.
  • Test, troubleshoot, monitor, and maintain applications after deployment.
  • Build solutions with appropriate security, privacy, and access controls for sensitive legal and client information.

Collaboration & Innovation

  • Partner with the AI Implementation team, leadership, attorneys, and staff to understand workflow challenges and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Evaluate the technical feasibility of proposed AI initiatives.
  • Rapidly prototype ideas and determine whether they can become reliable, scalable internal tools.
  • Research emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and platforms that could benefit the firm.
  • Explain technical concepts, limitations, and recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Document systems, integrations, and development processes to support long-term maintenance and scalability.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional software development, AI development, automation development, or closely related technical experience.
  • Strong working proficiency with Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience working with large language models or generative AI APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience building APIs, integrations, automations, or internal software applications.
  • Understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, databases, and modern software development concepts.
  • Experience taking technical projects from concept or prototype through implementation.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently in an environment where requirements may evolve as solutions are tested.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical team members.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing AI agents or multi-step agentic workflows.
  • Experience building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications.
  • Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search.
  • Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or comparable AI development tools.
  • Experience with automation platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience with Git or similar version-control systems.
  • Experience developing applications involving document processing, document management, or large volumes of unstructured data.
  • Experience working in a law firm, legal technology, professional services, or another environment handling confidential information is a plus.

Benefits

  • Opportunity to help build the firm's AI capabilities from the ground up.
  • Direct collaboration with firm leadership and key decision-makers.
  • High-impact role with visibility across the organization.
  • 9 paid firm holidays annually, plus additional time off.
  • 401(k) retirement program.
  • Career growth and advancement opportunities.

Apply Today

If you're a developer who enjoys turning emerging AI technology into practical tools that solve real business problems, we'd love to hear from you.

Block LLP is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Beauty Brand Expert - Augustinus Bader, Flushing - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Beauty Brand Expert at Macy’s, you are the go-to authority for your assigned brand, responsible for driving sales, elevating the customer experience, and leading with passion, expertise, and style. You serve as both a product educator and beauty enthusiast - creating personalized routines, demonstrating new trends, and helping customers look and feel their best.

In this role, you’ll inspire teamwork, coach fellow Beauty Advisors, and lead by example through exceptional service and product knowledge. You’ll foster customer loyalty, build relationships through clienteling, and execute brand strategies, events, and training in collaboration with store leadership and vendor partners. With a deep understanding of your brand and strong business acumen, you’ll analyze sales data, identify opportunities, and deliver results in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment.

How Our Beauty Brand Expert Leaders Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As a Beauty Brand Expert Leader, you come in energized and ready to inspire your team - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting colleagues with genuine warmth, and ensuring your counter is polished, organized, and fully prepared to welcome customers. You set the tone by reviewing daily sales goals, staying informed on new launches, top-performing products, and current beauty trends - so you're equipped to lead with confidence, support your team, and deliver exceptional service to every customer.
  • On the floor, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships.
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by ensuring testers are clean and well-stocked, signage and pricing are current, and displays reflect brand standards. You lead by example, jumping in to support merchandising updates and keeping the space visually appealing and welcoming throughout the day.
  • You help the team Finish Strong - by reminding them to share Loyalty benefits, making sure customers leave with everything they need, and ending each interaction with a sincere thank-you, often using the customer’s name and adding a personal touch.
  • You know that service starts with each other. You model collaboration, honesty, and care - supporting your peers so the whole team can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are and What You Will Do

  • Deliver exceptional customer service through personalized consultations and expert product knowledge
  • Build lasting relationships with clients and drive client development through outreach and follow-up
  • Review and analyze business performance of daily, weekly, monthly, seasonal, and annual sales results and implement strategies to grow business and improve results
  • Plan and execute in-store and vendor-led events to drive traffic and engagement
  • Maintain brand standards through proper merchandising, hygiene, and stock replenishment
  • Collaborate with vendors, personal stylists, and store leadership to optimize outcomes
  • Resolve customer concerns in a professional and customer-first manner
  • Stay informed on new launches, best-sellers, and beauty trends to support team education
  • Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail
  • Demonstrate sound judgment, and a passion for the beauty industry
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits

title: Forward Deployed Analyst
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
WELLTOWER – REIMAGINE REAL ESTATE WITH US

At Welltower, we’re transforming how the world thinks about senior living and wellness-focused real estate. As a global leader in residential wellness and healthcare infrastructure, we create vibrant, purpose-driven communities where housing, healthcare, and hospitality converge. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and endlessly ambitious—guided by our mantra: The only easy day was yesterday.

We’re looking for bold, independent thinkers who thrive on challenge, embrace complexity, and are driven to deliver long-term value. Every team member is empowered to think like an owner, innovate fearlessly, and lead from where they stand. If you're passionate about outcomes and inspired by the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare infrastructure, we want you on our best-in-class team.

SUMMARY

The Forward Deployed Analyst embeds with a team, learns how they make decisions, and deploys our tools against their live workflow to make their work sharper and faster. You lead the engagement and own the outcome. A build team stands behind you.

Welltower, the world's largest real estate company by market capitalization, is growing at an exciting pace. We move fast, think like owners, and build for long-term value. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to build from the ground up inside a company with real scale behind it.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Embed with a team and learn their decision process end to end: how they screen, evaluate, and benchmark, and where judgment drives the call
  • Deploy our tools against their real data and workflow, tailoring the output to how they actually work
  • Own adoption and the relationship, getting the team to trust the output enough to act on it
  • Capture and encode what you learn against a common framework so knowledge compounds across engagements
  • Push AI tools into a real workflow and drive adoption with users who are new to them
  • Feed field insight back to the build team to shape the roadmap

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

  • 4+ years in CRE investment analysis or capital allocation
  • Solid understanding of how institutional real estate decisions get made
  • Hands-on user of AI tools in your own work, with a real point of view on where they help and where they fall short
  • Genuine interest in AI and a track record of adopting new tools early rather than waiting for them to be proven
  • Strong client-facing presence, comfortable working directly with senior teams
  • Fluent with data and analytical tooling; you translate easily between domain experts and engineers
  • Bias toward shipping fast over perfecting
  • Based in the NYC metro area and able to work on-site

COMPENSATION

Salaries may vary by location. The base salary range for this role in New York is $135,000 to $165,000. In addition to base pay, this role is eligible for a total rewards package that includes an annual bonus opportunity, equity awards through our long-term incentive program, and a comprehensive benefits suite.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, drug screening, and verification of employment, education, and other credentials relevant to the position.

WHAT WE OFFER

Welltower® Inc. (NYSE: WELL) an S&P 500 company, is the world's preeminent residential wellness and healthcare infrastructure company. title: Web Developer
description:
Website and Digital Development Lead | Inveraray Castle and Gardens, Argyll Estates


Lead the digital transformation of one of Scotland’s most iconic historic destinations.


“Each day when you arrive at the Castle, you realise how amazing it is that you get to work here; you’re not just a visitor seeing it for one day. Looking out across Loch Fyne, with the Arrochar Alps, hills and forests on your doorstep, and the photogenic Georgian town of Inveraray five minutes’ walk away, Argyll Estate is an inspiring place for anyone with a creative mind.”


Location: Inveraray Castle | Hybrid working considered

Appointment: Permanent, fixed-term or consultancy arrangement

Salary: Dependent on appointment structure and experience

Accommodation: Estate accommodation may be available

About Inveraray Castle and Argyll Estates

Inveraray Castle and Gardens is one of Scotland’s most recognisable historic visitor destinations. Set on the stunning shores of Loch Fyne in Argyll, Inveraray Castle has been the ancestral home of the Dukes of Argyll and Clan Campbell since the 18th century and remains both a private family home and a nationally recognised visitor attraction.


The Castle sits at the heart of a diverse working Estate encompassing heritage, internationally important collections, architecture, landscape and gardens, tourism, events, filming, accommodation, food and beverage, retail, archives and wider Estate life.


The Opportunity

Inveraray Castle is now embarking upon a significant redevelopment of its website and wider digital infrastructure. This is far more than a visual redesign: it is an opportunity to shape how Inveraray Castle presents itself digitally to visitors, partners and wider audiences.


This would suit someone looking to join Inveraray and become part of the team, or an experienced independent consultant wishing to take responsibility for a significant standalone digital project. For an exceptional candidate, there may also be the opportunity to develop an ongoing role managing, optimising and developing Inveraray’s wider digital platform beyond the initial website project.


We are therefore searching for an experienced Website and Digital Development Lead to take ownership of this important project. We are open to structuring the role in one of the following ways, depending on the experience, availability and circumstances of the successful candidate.


  • Permanent employment as part of the Inveraray Castle team, where an ongoing digital role can be demonstrated.
  • Fixed-term employment, anticipated to be 9–12 months, allowing for delivery, launch and an appropriate post-launch period.
  • An independent consultant appointed on a deliverables-based basis, with duration and fee agreed around the final scope.

What is essential is that the successful candidate spends meaningful time at Inveraray Castle to understand the visitor journey, how the organisation works, meet those working there and appreciate how the independent roles of the Castle, gardens, family, history, visitors and the wider Estate fit together.


Local and relocating applicants are particularly welcomed. Estate accommodation may be available.


The Role

Reporting to the Castle Manager and working closely with the Senior Marketing Executive, the successful candidate will also work with departmental managers, visitor-facing teams and relevant external specialists.


The new website should transform how visitors discover Inveraray, understand what it offers, plan their journey, purchase tickets and engage with the Castle before and after their visit. It should bring Inveraray’s story to life while making planning and booking a visit straightforward and intuitive.


Key Project Responsibilities

  • Discovery and requirements outline
  • User experience and the variety of visitor journeys
  • Visual and responsive design
  • Frontend and backend development
  • Selection of an appropriate content management system
  • Ticketing and booking integration
  • Third-party integrations
  • Content migration
  • SEO, analytics and conversion tracking
  • Accessibility standards and inclusive user experience
  • Performance and security testing
  • Website launch planning and delivery
  • Post launch handover, training and documentation


Understanding Inveraray


This is a digital project rooted in an understanding of place, people and visitor experience, not simply a technical build. You will need to understand the workings of the Castle and Estate through the eyes of visitors, venue location managers, event organisers and the wider Clan Campbell community.


About You

We are particularly interested in someone who listens before acting, builds trust with stakeholders and takes time to understand the setting before proposing solutions.


You will bring experience in some or all the following areas:

  • Website design and development
  • User experience and information architecture
  • Responsive and mobile-first design
  • Content management systems
  • Front-end development
  • APIs, databases or third-party integrations
  • Booking or payment systems
  • Technical SEO and analytics
  • Website security and data protection
  • Working with non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience in heritage, tourism, hospitality, cultural organisations or other visually compelling, story led environments would be particularly valuable.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating projects you have successfully delivered will be essential.


Personal attributes:

  • Highly organised
  • Visually discerning
  • Commercially aware
  • Comfortable taking ownership
  • Able to explain technical matters clearly
  • Collaborative but confident in your recommendations
  • Sensitive to heritage, family ownership and reputation
  • Self aware and comfortable drawing on specialist expertise where needed
  • Motivated by creating something with genuine long-term value


Package and Practical Details

  • Appointment structure: full time permanent employment, a 9 to 12 month fixed term appointment, or an independent, deliverables based consultancy arrangement
  • Full-time salary: Expected £35,000 per annum, depending on experience and employment structure
  • Consultancy fee: To be agreed according to the final scope, deliverables and proposed delivery programme
  • Location: Inveraray Castle, Argyll, with meaningful on-site involvement
  • Hybrid working: May be considered for an exceptional candidate
  • Accommodation: Estate accommodation may be available, subject to availability. Options may range from a room in shared Estate accommodation for occasional stays to a house for someone based at Inveraray full time or close to full time.
  • Start date: As soon as reasonably practicable


To apply, please send your CV, portfolio details and a short covering letter outlining why this opportunity interests you to Katharine Landale at Bold New Recruitment.


We look forward to hearing from you. Thank you.

title: Senior Director, Finance
location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
Position: Senior Director, Finance / Controller
Position Type: Full-Time
Reports to: Kelli Herrick, Interim COO
Location: Hybrid in Washington, DC

Anticipated Start: December 2026 / January 2027


ABOUT THE ROLE
Future Caucus seeks an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Director of Finance / Controller to lead finance operations on our team. They are responsible for the integrity of our financial systems, reporting, controls, compliance, planning, and analysis. This position will also ensure high-quality accounting practices, support strategic organizational decision-making and budgeting, oversee financial grant reporting & contracts, and equip our executive team and department leads with the financial information, tools, processes, and guidance they need to actively manage their budgets and be effective stewards of organizational funds.

We’re looking for someone who gets excited about the idea of finance system transformation on a growing team. You are just as eager to think big picture about the systems of the future as you are to roll up your sleeves and actualize those systems in the day to day.

At Future Caucus, the operations & finance teams are service-oriented and exist to enable impact and efficiency across the organization. We understand that a strong financial & operational backbone equips those within the organization to dream up and do big things while sufficiently managing organizational risks. We’re looking for someone who possesses a similar orientation to their work: someone who asks the right questions, surfaces risks early, and helps us model what’s possible by working with the COO to translate big ideas and organizational ambitions into clear financial scenarios, tradeoffs, and pathways for sustainable growth. This job is for you if you can effectively communicate with stakeholders ranging from the coordinator level to the C-suite and Board of Directors and have an exceptional ability to manage up and laterally.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in nonprofit finance, is a proactive communicator, and is known for letting no detail go unnoticed. They will report to the Chief Operating Officer and oversee the relationship with our part-time external accountant, audit team, and other financial vendors. Our hope is to bring someone on to our team who is eager to lead on establishing systems that will help us scale to our next level of impact, and wants to grow alongside the organization.

ABOUT FUTURE CAUCUS
Future Caucus has an audacious mission: activate young leaders to bridge the partisan divide and transform American politics. Future Caucus is a national, nonpartisan organization dedicated to supporting the next generation of elected leaders. We provide the resources, networking, and capacity-building opportunities for these policymakers to forge productive partnerships on critical national issues.

In 2013, Future Caucus organized the nation’s first and only caucus for young members of Congress, the Congressional Future Caucus, to build coalitions on future-oriented challenges. Future Caucus also scaled this model into 36 state legislatures, each with a Future Caucus consisting of young, high-potential legislators, and now engages more than 2,100 young legislators nationwide. In 2025, Future Caucus’ President & CEO was named to the TIME100 Next list. Learn more at .

RESPONSIBILITIES

Financial Strategy & Leadership

  • Serve as Future Caucus’ senior internal finance leader, providing strategic financial guidance to the CEO, COO, Board of Directors, and senior leadership team
  • Develop and maintain financial plans and projects, including cash flow, reserves, and investment strategies analyses
  • Contribute to the development of the organization's long-term strategic and operational plans with a focus on financial sustainability
  • Communicate regularly with the CEO, COO, and senior leadership regarding financial performance & forecasts, proactively surfacing significant risks, opportunities, trends, and tradeoffs
  • Translate complex financial information into clear, actionable, and timely insights for stakeholders with varying levels of financial expertise, building financial fluency and accountability across the organization
  • Prepare the CEO and COO to present quarterly financial reports and narratives for Board meetings, providing clear, actionable, and future-oriented recommendations

Budgeting & Financial Planning

  • Alongside the COO and President & CEO, oversee the preparation and management of the annual operating budget, ensuring participatory budget practices and alignment with the organization’s mission, programs, and strategic priorities
  • Lead the forecasting process and establish appropriate forecasting cadences to ensure budget projections are accurate and reflective of current financial performance, revenue expectations, organizational priorities, and risks, partnering closely with the Development and Program teams
  • Monitor financial performance, identify variances, and recommend corrective actions as needed
  • Build and embed financial processes, tools, and policies that empower department heads with the financial fluency to make strong decisions on expenditures
  • Lead budget reviews with department heads to ensure financial targets are met and budget forecasts are accurate
  • Provide financial oversight of organizational grants, including budget development, financial reporting, compliance, cost allocation, reimbursement process, etc.

Financial Reporting & Systems

  • Prepare and present accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports & narratives, including statement of activities, statement of financial position, cash flow statements, and budget-to-actual analyses
  • Analyze and interpret financial results, translating reporting into actionable insights, trends, risks, and recommendations for the COO, President & CEO, and senior leadership
  • Oversee the preparation of year-end financial statements and ensure compliance with accounting principles (e.g. GAAP, fund accounting)

Administration, Compliance, and Risk Management

  • Establish and maintain strong internal controls to safeguard the organization’s financial resources and mitigate financial risks, taking appropriate action when risks are identified
  • Establish clear mechanisms for identifying and promptly escalating material financial risks, concerns, or errors to the COO and President & CEO, along with recommended corrective actions
  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of all financial data and accounting records, overseeing the organization’s external accounting firm for timely and accurate accounting functions, including keeping the general ledger, accounts payable / receivable, payroll, and month-end close
  • Oversee the preparation and filing of annual tax returns (e.g., IRS Form 990) and the annual audit process, ensuring the organization’s external accounting firm & audit team produce accurate and complete audits and tax filings
  • Oversee the creation of and training and development of staff on financial policies, procedures, and best practices
  • Establish and execute accounts payable procedures & technologies to ensure timely payments, working with the Operations Coordinator and account firm as needed
  • Complete all necessary registrations, licenses, and insurance needs
  • Perform other related duties as needed

Requirements

ABOUT YOU

  • Minimum 7+ years of relevant experience, with non-profit finance experience required
  • Experience managing a budget of $4M or more
  • Degree in finance, accounting, non-profit/business administration, or equivalent professional experience
  • Demonstrated experience with nonprofit financial systems, grant & restricted revenue compliance, and board-level financial reporting
  • Detail-orientation and analytical skills, with the ability to ensure accurate reporting and translate it into strategic organizational insights
  • Strong interpersonal judgement when communicating with a range of audiences (e.g. stakeholders, funders) in writing and in person
  • Advanced skills with Microsoft Excel and other financial tools (ex: Quickbooks, forecasting tools, AP software)
  • Strong initiative - a self-motivated individual known for identifying problems alongside solutions and a bias for proactive communication
  • Experience in or knowledge of ethics requirements in legislatures a bonus
  • Sincere commitment to Future Caucus mission of working across partisan lines

OUR VALUES

In 2020, Future Caucus unveiled a set of organizational value statements developed collaboratively by our team. This ethos represents what we believe in at Future Caucus, and what we have worked to establish during the last eleven years. These are the values we have set for ourselves, and what we see come to life through our legislators in our network, partners, and supporters:

  • Listen First: communicate openly and respectfully - make room for others at the table
  • Say “We”: there is no “I” in Future Caucus - welcome diversity; it makes us stronger
  • Build Trust: Integrity in our relationships is fundamental - be reliable and follow through
  • Empower Others: Be empathetic - practice transparency and collaborate openly
  • Break Barriers: Climb it, go through it, or work around it - limits are challenges to overcome
  • Innovate Freely: Disruption leads to creative solutions - forge a new path forward

Benefits

LOCATION
Future Caucus is currently in a hybrid work environment, candidates must be located in the Washington, D.C. metro area, or be willing to relocate.

COMPENSATION
Salary for this position is $101,500 - $109,600. Highly competitive benefits are provided, including commuter/telework stipend, 401(k) with employer contributions, generous vacation policy, professional development stipend, and comprehensive health benefits.

CULTURE AND CONNECTION
Future Caucus aspires to an organizational culture based on our values, where our team is connected and collaborative. We take time to share in the wins and impact of our work, chat over regular employer-paid lunches, learn together, and participate in local social and service activities. We are eager to add team members who share our values and will continue building our positive culture.

HIRING PROCESS

The priority deadline for this role is Oct. 13, 2026 and we anticipate communicating to all candidates following our priority deadline. Applications received after this date will be evaluated on a rolling basis.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
As an equal opportunity employer, Future Caucus is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. We welcome members of historically underrepresented groups to apply, including people of color, women, LGBTQ+ individuals, veterans, individuals with disabilities, and multilingual individuals. Reference checks are conducted on all prospective new hires.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Java Software Engineer


Complex Systems | Modern Stack | Agile & XP Culture


Remote First (office visit approx. once per month – South Manchester)


£60,000 – £70,000 + Bonus + Excellent Benefits


We’re partnering with a long-established technology business building modern platforms at the heart of a complex, highly regulated domain. With continued growth across their product suite, they’re now looking for three Senior Java Software Engineers to join their engineering teams.


The Opportunity

This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role working on large-scale, business-critical systems, within an organisation that genuinely values engineering craft, collaboration and continuous improvement.


Agile and XP practices are embedded across the engineering function, with a strong focus on TDD, pairing, continuous integration and shared ownership.


You’ll join a cross-functional Scrum team alongside Product Managers, UX Designers, Test Analysts and fellow Engineers, taking ownership of features from initial idea through to production.

At Senior level, you’ll also play an important role in mentoring other Developers, sharing knowledge and raising engineering standards across the team.


You’ll be encouraged to challenge existing approaches, contribute ideas and have a genuine influence on both technical direction and how the team works.
