title: Fabricator
description:
About Us

Amarr, a part of ASSA ABLOY, the global leaders in opening solutions, is a performance driven manufacturing organization committed to safety, quality, and operational excellence. As an industry leader, we empower our teams to innovate, continuously improve, and deliver world class solutions to our customers.

The Barrel Fabrication Operator is responsible for fabricating, welding, and assembling barrel components in accordance with engineering specifications, quality standards, and production requirements. This role ensures barrel assemblies are manufactured accurately and efficiently while supporting production schedules, maintaining quality standards, and promoting a safe and organized work environment.

Shift: Monday - Thursday; 7am - 5:30pm

Key Responsibilities

Fabrication & Assembly

  • Review and interpret cut sheets, work orders, engineering drawings, and manufacturing specifications.
  • Obtain required materials, components, tools, and equipment to support production schedules.
  • Verify materials and component specifications prior to fabrication and assembly.
  • Measure, mark, and cut barrel materials to required dimensions and tolerances.
  • Prepare springs and other components for installation and assembly.
  • Assemble fabricated barrel components and subassemblies using established work instructions.
  • Drill, bore, and prepare holes in barrel assemblies according to engineering specifications.
  • Ensure completed assemblies meet dimensional and production requirements prior to release.

Welding & Equipment Operation

  • Weld nuts, springs, brackets, and other metal components to or within barrel assemblies according to specifications.
  • Set up and operate fabrication equipment including saws, drill presses, welders, grinders, and other production machinery.
  • Safely utilize hand tools, power tools, and fabrication equipment required to perform assigned tasks.
  • Perform routine equipment checks and report malfunctions or maintenance concerns promptly.
  • Troubleshoot minor equipment and process issues and communicate concerns to supervision.

Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Perform in-process and final quality inspections using gauges, calipers, tape measures, fixtures, and other approved measuring instruments.
  • Verify dimensional accuracy, weld integrity, hole locations, and component placement prior to releasing products to the next operation.
  • Maintain accurate production and quality documentation as required.
  • Follow all company safety policies, quality standards, work instructions, and operating procedures.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area in accordance with housekeeping and 5S requirements.
  • Report safety concerns, quality defects, equipment issues, or process concerns to leadership promptly.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Meet daily productivity, quality, and delivery expectations.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives that improve safety, quality, efficiency, and productivity.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to learning fabrication processes, products, and departmental procedures.
  • Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members regarding production priorities and operational needs.
  • Assist in cross-training activities and support departmental goals as needed.

General Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter and maintain production-related data and documentation as required.
  • Follow verbal and written instructions related to production schedules and work assignments.
  • Maintain attendance and punctuality standards.
  • Work effectively within a team environment while supporting overall production objectives.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Education & Experience

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Previous manufacturing, fabrication, welding, machining, or assembly experience preferred.
  • Ability to read and interpret cut sheets, blueprints, engineering drawings, and work instructions.
  • Ability to understand dimensions, tolerances, symbols, and basic geometric requirements on drawings.
  • Working knowledge of welding and metal fabrication processes.
  • Ability to safely operate fabrication equipment and hand tools.
  • Basic computer skills for production reporting and documentation.
  • Strong mathematical skills, including working with fractions, decimals, and standard measurements.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to producing quality products.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Welding certification or demonstrated welding proficiency.
  • Experience in metal fabrication or industrial manufacturing environments.
  • Experience using precision measuring equipment and quality inspection tools.
  • Experience working in lean manufacturing environments and utilizing 5S principles.

Other Job Responsibilities and Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 45 lbs. unassisted with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and/or pull materials weighing more than 45 lbs. using team lifting procedures.
  • Ability to stand and/or walk for extended periods (8–12 hours per shift).
  • Ability to safely move throughout the manufacturing floor.
  • Ability to bend, kneel, crouch, climb stairs and/or ladders as required for job tasks.
  • Ability to use hands, wrists, and fingers for handling materials, writing, and computer work.
  • Frequent use of computers, keyboards, tablets, scanners, or handheld devices.
  • Ability to work in a loud, fast-paced industrial environment.
  • Ability to work in hot and cold environmental conditions.

Benefits include Medical/Dental/Vision, Paid Time Off, and a 401k plan (with an automatic 3% company contribution, regardless of your contribution) among others.

Our goal is to be a world-leading company that attracts diverse talent, where all team members feel safe being their true selves and are able to thrive in a work environment that promotes change, innovation, and provides equal access and opportunity.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Amarr is an E-Verify participant.

The London School of Business and Finance (LSBF) is committed to delivering a positive and supportive student experience throughout every stage of the student journey.

title: Senior Vice President
description:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

Senior Vice President (SVP)

Austin, Texas · Remote-Eligible (75% On-Site) · Founding Executive Role

About Our New Venture

This organization is a new, U.S.-incorporated manufacturing platform built to serve frontier-technology industries — humanoid robotics, aerospace, agricultural technology, and healthcare — where reshoring, national security priorities, and speed-to-production are reshaping how and where hardware gets built. Backed by MISUMI Group, a global leader in manufacturing solutions and precision components, this venture combines precision machining, final assembly/test/packaging (FATP), supply chain orchestration, and engineering services into a single U.S.-based platform.

Our founding customers include leading humanoid robotics companies, and is being built from day one to grow with a broader roster of frontier-technology manufacturers as capacity comes online.

The Opportunity

Our organization is standing up its first physical footprint in Austin, Texas: an initial facility in 2026, followed by a purpose-built campus opening in 2027. Over the following three years, the operation is expected to scale from a single-customer pilot into a multi-customer production platform, with the workforce growing from a founding team into a 200-plus-person operation as volume ramps toward several thousand units a year at full scale.

We are hiring the founding SVP to lead this build from the ground up — the first executive on the ground in Austin, responsible for turning an approved capital program into a running, profitable manufacturing operation.

Career path: This role is expected to be promoted to President & CEO of the new organization in 2027, as the operation transitions from initial, single-customer production into multi-customer scale-up — contingent on hitting the facility, customer, and team-building milestones below.

What You'll Own

  • Facility stand-up & scale-up: Lead commissioning of the initial Austin facility and the transition into the larger campus that follows, hitting the milestones tied to the capital plan.
  • Customer delivery: Own the relationship with our founding customer and its production ramp, then lead qualification and onboarding of additional frontier-technology customers as capacity comes online.
  • Operations & quality: Build out precision machining, FATP, and quality systems (FAIR, SPC, DFM) to the standard demanded by frontier-technology customers.
  • Workforce build: Execute a multi-year staffing ramp from a founding team to a 200+-person workforce, combining direct hiring, a local apprenticeship/technical-college pipeline, and flexible nearshore capacity for peak demand.
  • Governance & compliance: Partner with legal and security leadership to stand up the governance, security, and workplace controls required for U.S. government-adjacent manufacturing work, including export-control registration and cybersecurity certification requirements.
  • P&L and reporting: Own the new organization's operating P&L and report regularly to the company Board of Directors and MISUMI's Americas Business Hub leadership on cost, schedule, and quality performance.
  • Team & culture: Build the leadership bench underneath you, recruiting manufacturing and engineering leadership from Austin's robotics and advanced-manufacturing corridor.

What You Bring

  • 15+ years in manufacturing operations leadership, with direct P&L ownership of a plant, business unit, or manufacturing company.
  • A track record of standing up new manufacturing facilities from the ground up — greenfield or brownfield — including commissioning, hiring ramp, and production qualification.
  • Deep fluency in precision manufacturing: CNC machining, final assembly/test/packaging (FATP), new product introduction (NPI), and design-for-manufacturability (DFM).
  • Experience serving demanding, fast-iterating hardware customers — robotics, aerospace, defense, or similarly exacting sectors — strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with U.S. export-control and government-contracting frameworks (ITAR, CMMC) is a strong plus; willingness to build and operate within those frameworks is required.
  • Comfortable operating with board-level visibility and reporting, including to an international (Japan-based) parent company.
  • A builder's mindset — energized by a founding role with real ambiguity, not just running an already-established operation.

Additional Requirement

Because the organization's work is expected to support U.S. government- and defense-adjacent manufacturing programs under ITAR and related export-control frameworks, candidates must be U.S. citizens.

Location & Reporting

  • Location: Remote-eligible. The SVP is not required to permanently relocate to Austin, provided they can maintain an on-site presence at the new facility for approximately 75% of working time — reflecting the hands-on demands of facility commissioning, workforce build-out, and production leadership.
  • Travel: Up to 50% travel overall, covering on-site time in Austin plus trips to MISUMI's Americas Business Hub, customer sites, and Board meetings.
  • Reports to: The organization's Board of Directors, with a close working relationship with MISUMI's Americas Business Hub leadership.
  • Dotted-line reporting: The organization's Go-to-Market / Business Development leadership, to keep customer pipeline, commercial strategy, and new-customer qualification tightly aligned with facility capacity and delivery.

Salary Range:
$260,000 - $320,000 base salary per year, plus a variable compensation potential of between $260,000 - $320,000

We’re actively seeking teammates who:

  • Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
  • Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.

title: Operations Project Manager (Contract)
description:

Position Overview:

Mercury EMEA is seeking an Operations Project Manager to lead the execution of aeronautical project from Start of Production (post-FAI) through serial production and up to End-of-Life (EOL).

The role focuses on programs already in production or close to launch. The Operations Project Manager shall ensure production performance, industrial continuity, and lifecycle support in a context of:

• Manufacturing transfer from internal production to external partners (e.g. CICOR)

• High obsolescence pressure on complex electronic systems

• Long lifecycle aerospace products

A limited scope of industrialization support prior to FAI is expected to secure a smooth production launch.

Key Responsibilities:

This position plays a key role in securing on-time, on-cost, and compliant delivery in a fast-paced environment involving new partnerships and constrained timelines driven by customer expectations.

1. Production & FAI Execution

• Lead execution of projects production or pre-production (FAI phase) ensuring on-time, on-cost and quality deliveries on serial units

• Contribute to final industrial readiness and First Article Inspection

• Drive ramp-to-rate activities and secure production stability

• Coordinate with engineering and supply chain to prevent production disruption

2. Manufacturing Transition & Partnership Management

• Support the transition from internal manufacturing to external partner

• Closely Monitor and track partner performance (quality, delivery, cost) and implement corrective actions to ensure commitment on delivery dates

• Proactively verify that:

o Components are ordered on time

o Supply chain risks are anticipated early

o Supplier assumptions are consistent

o Risks are escalated early

o Recovery plan are executed

3. Obsolescence & Supply Chain Risk Management

• Drive mitigation strategies with a proactive obsolescence management (components, materials, technology) to secure supply continuity

• Coordinate with engineering and supply chain to prevent production disruption

4. Lifecycle to EO & Sustainment

• Ensure product supportability (spares, repairs, configuration management) throughout operational life acc. to customer expectations and maintenance contract

• Plan and execute product phase-out (final builds, LTB, customer alignment)

5. Cross-functional Coordination

• Align Engineering, Industrial , Manufacturing Supply Chain and quality to resolve industrial issues

6. Project Control & Performance Management

• Manage project KPIs: schedule, cost, delivery, and quality

• Identify risks and implement mitigation plans

• Provide regular reporting to senior management and stakeholders

7. Customer & Stakeholder Interface

• Act as primary interface for internal and external stakeholders during production phase

• Ensure customer commitments are met, particularly for:

o Delivery performance

o FAI acceptance

o Industrial maturity

Key Challenges of the Role

• Managing production under supply chain and obsolescence constraints

• Securing fast and effective outsourcing transition

• Driving supplier commitment and reliability (including close operational follow-up)

• Ensuring long-term product availability and support

• Operating in a hybrid industrial model (internal + external manufacturing)

Required Qualifications & Experience:

• Proven experience in aerospace or defense project management

• Strong background in:

o Production ramp-up / industrialization

o Manufacturing Supplier and subcontractor management

o FAI / qualification processes

• Solid understanding of:

o Electronic systems / avionics products

o Supply chain and manufacturing processes

• Experience with obsolescence management and lifecycle support is a strong advantage

Key Competencies

• Strong execution and problem-solving mindset

• Ability to operate under high pressure and tight timelines

• Excellent stakeholder communication skills

• Risk anticipation and mitigation capability

• Structured and results-driven approach

MUST / Nice-to-Have:

• Experience with manufacturing transfer / outsourcing (MUST)

• Knowledge of EN9100 / aerospace quality standards (MUST)

• Familiarity with safety-certifiable systems (DAL A / DO-254, DO-178) (Nice to have)

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Why Work at BYU

At Brigham Young University (BYU), your work is an opportunity to contribute to a distinctive educational mission rooted in the gospel of Jesus Christ and to make a meaningful difference in the lives of students.


As the flagship university of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, BYU strives to be among the exceptional universities in the world. We are devoted to our faith, our students, and the University's Mission: "To assist individuals in their quest for perfection and eternal life."


We seek staff members who enthusiastically embrace and advance this unique mission. Across the university, staff bring their expertise and talents to work that helps students learn, grow, and thrive. A culture of covenant belonging, weekly devotionals, meaningful opportunities for learning and growth, and a beautiful and historic campus make BYU a distinctive and inspiring place to build a career.


Belonging Statement

United by our common primary identity as children of God, BYU values and embraces the variety of individual characteristics, life experiences and circumstances, perspectives, talents, and gifts across the BYU community. This richness strengthens our shared efforts to create and support an environment of covenant belonging centered in Jesus Christ.


Employment Requirements

Members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints are required to hold and be worthy to hold a current temple recommend to be hired and to remain in any position at BYU.


In hiring decisions, Brigham Young University lawfully gives strong preference to qualified, faithful members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. All employees are required to abide by the university's Honor Code and Dress & Grooming Standards. Successful candidates are expected to support and contribute to the academic and religious missions of the university, which are aligned with the principles and doctrine of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.


Equal Opportunity

Brigham Young University is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability or protected veteran status.

**The last day to submit an application for this position is October 8, 2026, by 11:59pm MST. **


Business Intelligence Analyst


The Business Intelligence Analyst develops and maintains business intelligence solutions for BYU Continuing Education. This position extracts and transforms data from multiple platforms, builds and maintains reports, and uses modern data technologies and visualization tools such as Tableau and Power BI. The analyst partners with stakeholders to understand their needs, delivers effective solutions, trains users, gathers feedback, and refines analytical tools that support business goals and data-driven decision-making.


What you’ll do in this position:


1. Manage the data analytics and visualization toolset

  • Design, organize, maintain, and improve analytics and visualization tools, reports, and data connections, including updates related to schema changes and platform migrations.
  • Ensure report accuracy, data governance compliance, appropriate access controls, and row-level security.
  • Create tutorials and walkthroughs, monitor tool quality and usage, and support stakeholders in effectively using business intelligence solutions.

2. Supervise student employees

  • Hire, train, and supervise student employees.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation.

3. Consult with CE directors, product and program managers, and BYU Online faculty

  • Consult with stakeholders to identify analytics requirements, key performance indicators, and reporting priorities.
  • Monitor business intelligence trends, collaborate with BYU and Continuing Education IT to integrate data, and collect feedback on tool effectiveness and usage.

4. Present data to CE directors, product and program managers, and BYU Online faculty

  • Present data and insights to BYU Online faculty and instructional designers and train stakeholders to use business intelligence solutions.
  • Identify opportunities for new solutions, reduce reporting challenges, improve program insights, promote data literacy, and support data-driven decision-making.


5. Assist with other departments processes as needed

  • Conduct surveys and evaluations, support accreditation preparation, and coordinate course assessment initiatives and reports.
  • Develop foundational knowledge of Business Process Support functions and assist with flowcharts, process diagrams, and user journey maps.

What qualifies you for this role:


Required


• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, or a relevant field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

• Experience using Tableau, Power BI, or other industry-standard business intelligence tools.

• Ability to write complex level-of-detail expressions to accurately report data from sources with varying levels of aggregation.

• Ability to solve problems collaboratively and build strong relationships.

• Demonstrated ability to electronically handle data and maintain data confidentiality.

• Demonstrated writing skills, including graphical reporting elements.

• Outstanding communication skills and the ability to establish and maintain excellent working relationships.

• Ability to work in an iterative and incremental development environment.

• Ability to identify and clarify business needs and translate them into business intelligence solutions.

• Ability to design business intelligence tools that are easy to understand and use, regardless of a user's technical background and experience.

• Ability to translate multiple data elements into understandable visuals that quickly tell a story.


Preferred


• Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field.

• Five or more years of related experience with business intelligence in a higher education institution.

• Appropriate business intelligence software certifications, such as Desktop Specialist, Certified Data Analyst, Server Associate, Consultant, or Architect.

• Advanced to expert skill in Tableau Desktop, Prep, and Server.

• Familiarity with programming tools such as Python.

• Demonstrated ability to effectively present technical information and concepts to non-technical audiences.


What we offer in return:

This position comes with fantastic benefits, including:

• 401(k): BYU automatically contributes 8% at no cost to you. Additionally, if you contribute 5%, BYU adds an additional 4% (rehires may qualify for different retirement plans).

• Generous vacation and sick time, plus 13 paid holidays.

• Employee assistance program available to the employee and all members of their household.

• Tuition benefits for employees and eligible family members.

• Access to athletic facilities.

• Excellent medical and dental benefits.

• Short- and long-term disability benefits.

• Paid parental and maternity leave.

• Wellness program.

• Free on-campus parking.

• Free UTA passes for the employee, spouse, and qualified dependents.

• Discounts at the BYU Store and for many events at BYU.

Pay Grade: 53


Typical Starting Pay: $75,000 - $97,000

The actual compensation offered will take into consideration internal equity and may vary based on the candidate’s job-related experience, knowledge, skills, and other relevant factors. Candidates with very significant work-related experience may receive an offer higher than the posted typical range.

title: Senior Product Manager (Roadmap) - Star Trek Fleet Command
description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Star Trek™ Fleet Command team in Barcelona on a hybrid basis.

Star Trek Fleet Command's ongoing success goes from strength to strength. Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top grossing Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

As the Senior Product Manager, you will be the product owner for key monetisation and engagement initiatives across the live game. This includes driving the roadmap and execution of our monthly content releases, ensuring they are cohesive, compelling, and highly performant. You will work cross-functionally with Game Design, Product Marketing, Product Ops, Economy Design, and Data Science teams to define, prioritise, and deliver exceptional player experiences that meet business and player goals.

  • Own the content and performance strategy for our monthly releases, aligning them to player motivations, economic balance, and business KPIs
  • Define and manage the monthly content calendar, collaborating with Design, Production, and Engineering to deliver high-quality, on-time experiences
  • Use data and experimentation to optimise monetisation, engagement, and retention across a broad player lifecycle—from new users to end-game whales
  • Deeply understand player behaviour across multiple geos and platforms to ensure we deliver value through personalisation and segmentation strategies
  • Work closely with the economy and systems design teams to ensure content aligns with long-term progression goals and avoids inflation
  • Partner with UX, Research, and Community teams to develop empathy for player sentiment and pain points, and translate them into actionable product improvements
  • Build business cases for major new initiatives and content verticals, including competitive research and revenue forecasting
  • Mentor junior PMs and contribute to a culture of product excellence and cross-functional collaboration.

What We're Looking For

  • Extensive experience in product management, ideally with significant responsibility on a F2P mobile game
  • Demonstrated success managing complex monetisation and engagement systems, with extensive experience in content development
  • Data-native mindset, with the ability to translate raw performance metrics into strategic insights and actionable plans
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven track record of aligning diverse teams around a shared product vision
  • Strong player empathy and experience working with user research, community feedback, or other voice-of-player channels
  • Experience driving impact across cross-functional pods, including creative, design, and engineering teams

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

title: AI & Business Automation Consultant
description:
AI & Business Automation Consultant | Belfast | Hybrid

I am looking to hire an AI & Business process consultant to take ownership of automation and AI opportunities across the business.

This is a hands-on role. They're not looking for someone who simply understands AI in theory - they want someone who can look at a business process, identify what can be improved, and actually build and implement the solution.

What will you be doing?

  • Map business processes and identify automation opportunities.
  • Assess whether processes should be automated and determine the best approach.
  • Build automation solutions or identify the right technology to implement.
  • Work across sales, finance and wider operations.
  • Automate repetitive tasks to give teams more time back for revenue-generating activity.
  • Develop AI-powered solutions and workflows.
  • Potentially centralise and manage GPT/AI lead-generation tools.
  • Help develop a company-wide "mission control" dashboard providing operational data, prompts and insights.
  • Train internal team members to build and manage automation solutions.

What are we looking for?

  • Hands-on experience with AI and automation.
  • Someone who can build solutions, not just theorise.
  • Experience identifying business problems and translating them into technical solutions.
  • Strong workflow analysis and process improvement skills.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership.
  • Technology agnostic - able to choose the right tool for the problem.
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working with non-technical teams.
  • Curious, commercially minded and focused on finding better ways of working.

Technologies

Power Automate | Power Apps | Copilot Studio | Excel | SharePoint | ChatGPT

Experience with Python, UiPath or other automation platforms would also be relevant.

You don't need to have used every technology listed - the key is being able to understand the problem and work out the best way to solve it.

The Opportunity

This could suit someone early in their career who has a strong academic background in AI, potentially a Master's in AI / Machine Learning, alongside personal projects or practical experience building AI and automation solutions.

You don't necessarily need years of commercial experience. What's important is curiosity, initiative and the ability to build.

If you're someone who naturally looks at a process and thinks "there must be a better way of doing this", enjoys experimenting with new technology and has built AI/automation projects in your own time, this could be a great opportunity to take those skills into a real business environment.

The key is being able to understand a problem, explore the options, build a solution and continuously improve it - while communicating effectively with the people using it.

Contact me for more information or a confidential conversation.

Rachael Walker

AI Business Automation Consultant business process improvement automation power platform ai engineer

title: Clinical Administration Assistant
description:

Performing general office duties incorporating a variety of basic and routine clerical and secretarial duties in a clinical environment.

Be the "face" of one of our outpatient or hospital facilities-and use your administrative skills to impact the lives of our patients and their families. As a secretary/receptionist at Fresenius Kidney Care, you will be an integral part of a cross-functional team, providing administrative support to maintain clinic operations and provide the best customer care for patients living with kidney disease.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Under general supervision, follows established company policies and procedures and applies acquired job skills to:

Patient Engagement and Front Desk - Responsibilities may include the following based on location and business need:

  • Answering telephone & routing calls to the appropriate person
  • Professionally greet all patients and guests.
  • Maintain a professional environment at all times. Monitors the reception and waiting areas.
  • Distributing incoming mail.
  • Obtain necessary signatures to ensure the efficient processing of admissions data in accordance with FMCNA policies and procedures.
  • Ensure all aspects of patient confidentiality are maintained at all times

Scheduling and Registration - Responsibilities may include the following based on location and business need:

  • Maintains accurate records of hospitalization, patient travel, etc. to facilitate coordination of patient scheduling, ancillary testing, etc.
    • Prepares medical records for facsimile or mail related to travel, transplant, disability and others.
    • Organizes travel for patients by contacting and providing requested medical records.
    • Coordinates with transient patient paperwork.
    • Coordinates transfer placements and confirmations along with Clinical Manager.
    • Confirms admissions paperwork is completed and sent to designated department(s), such as billing, by collecting, faxing and scanning.
    • Assist with medical appointment referrals and scheduling.
    • Assist with transportation coordination and referrals.
  • Ensures data entry has been completed for Crown Web. Related to ESRD 2728. ESRD 2746 and PART.
  • Monthly insurance card scanning

Administrative and Additional Responsibilities - Responsibilities may include the following based on location and business need:

  • Setting up and maintaining filing systems and basic databases as applicable.
  • Completing forms and reports as required by the various company offices and outside vendors and agencies.
  • Preparing purchase orders using the appropriate software application.
  • Assisting with department/facility accounts receivable and accounts payable functions and responsibilities as needed.
  • Maintaining inventory of the necessary office supplies
  • Assists in auditing records for ongoing compliance with medical records standards (H&Ps, monthly physician progress notes, care plans, etc).
  • Assists in the collection of Patient Demographic Information and Continuous Quality Improvement Data.
  • Assemble, file and maintain patient medical records
  • Print patient schedule and pull patient charts daily.
  • Arrange for package pickup and delivery.
  • Assists with month-end reporting requirements.
  • Participate in collaboration sessions such as center/team huddles and staff meetings.
  • Attend education and training sessions as appropriate and apply key learnings.

SKILLS:

  • Knowledge of office procedures required.
  • Proficient in Microsoft office applications
  • Ability to adapt to supporting software applications.
  • Professional attitude and appearance
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to be resourceful and proactive when issues arise
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Multitasking and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks
  • Customer service attitude

  • The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Day to day work includes desk and personal computer work and possible interaction with patients, facility staff and physicians. The position may require travel between assigned facilities and various locations within the community. The work environment may be characteristic of a health care facility with air temperature control and moderate noise levels. May be exposed to infectious and contagious diseases/materials

title: Kræftkoordinator og koordinator for rygrehabilitering
description:
Sygeplejerske til kombineret stilling som Kræftkoordinator og som Sundhedskonsulent med koordinator- og tovholderfunktion for rygrehabilitering.

Vil du være med til at skabe sammenhængende og meningsfulde rehabiliteringsforløb for mennesker med kræft samt for mennesker med kroniske rygproblematikker?
Denne stilling i Rødovre Sundhedscenter indebærer især afklarende samtaler, koordinering og tæt samarbejde med Genoptræning og Arbejdsmarkedscenter.
Du får en central rolle i vores kræftrehabilitering samt ansvar for at udvikle og koordinere rygrehabiliteringsområdet i tæt samarbejde med Genoptræningen, hvor fysioterapeuterne er de faglige specialister på det muskel-skeletale område.

Om jobbet

Kræftforløbskoordinator
Du bliver en central fagperson for borgere og pårørende gennem kræftforløbet. Med afsæt i den enkelte borgers livssituation koordinerer du rehabiliteringsindsatser, holder afklarende, støttende og vejledende samtaler, afdækker behov for rehabilitering, palliation og senfølgeindsatser.

Sundhedskonsulent med ansvar for rygrehabilitering
Du får ansvar for at udvikle og koordinere kommunens indsats for borgere med længerevarende rygproblematikker. Du ønsker særligt at nå borgere, som oftest har svært ved at benytte eksisterende tilbud, især mennesker som er social udsatte og med psykisk sårbarhed. Du ønsker at skabe løsninger, der er relevante og som tager udgangspunkt i borgerens ressourcer, ønsker og hele livssituation.

Dine opgaver

· Fast kontaktperson for borgere med kræft samt borgere med kroniske rygproblematikker
· Afklare om den enkelte borger er i målgruppe for rygrehabilitering eller om der er behov for yderlig afklaring på hospital eller hos praktiserende læge
· Gennemføre afklarende sundhedssamtaler ud fra alle KRAMM-faktorer og med afsæt i den enkelte borgers ressourcer og ønsker for eget liv
· Identificere behov for rehabilitering, senfølger, palliation samt øvrige forebyggelses- og sundhedsfremmende indsatser
· Koordinere sammenhængende tværfaglige rehabiliteringsforløb
· Skabe bro til relevante civile tilbud og netværk
· Planlægge og gennemføre undervisning og gruppeforløb inden for kræftområdet herunder senfølgeforløb i naturen
· Bidrage til udviklingen af rygrehabiliteringsområdet
· Dokumentation og opfølgning i omsorgssystemet Cura

Fælles for begge opgaver er, at du samarbejder med mange andre aktører på tværs af kommune, region, almen praksis og civilsamfund. Samtidig bidrager du til Sundhedscentrets forebyggende og sundhedsfremmende tilbud. Se vores hjemmeside for mere viden om vores områder: .

Din profil

Du møder mennesker, der står i en sårbar livssituation med nærvær, faglighed og med et særligt blik for mennesker med sociale, psykiske eller andre komplekse udfordringer, som kan gøre det endnu sværere at navigere i et kræftforløb eller i et liv med kroniske smerter og funktionsnedsættelse.

Vi forestiller os, at du:
· er uddannet sygeplejerske med kendskab til de nationale forløbsprogrammer
· har erfaring med rehabilitering, forebyggelse og sundhedsfremme
· har arbejdet tværfagligt og tværsektorielt
· har erfaring med undervisning og relationsarbejde
· har viden om kræftforløb, rehabilitering, palliation og senfølger
· brænder for at arbejde med mennesker med psykisk sårbarhed
· kan arbejde selvstændigt samt rækker ud for sparring og hjælp ved behov

Om os

I Rødovre Sundhedscenter er vi 11 medarbejdere med forskellige faglige baggrunde. Vi arbejder med forebyggelse, sundhedsfremme og rehabilitering med afsæt i princippet "Sammen med borgeren" og ud fra at mennesker kan leve et meningsfuldt liv med høj livskvalitet trods sygdom.
Vi sætter pris på en uformel omgangstone og højt til loftet. Vi lægger vægt på tværfaglighed, faglig sparring, kompetenceudvikling samt løbende forbedring og udvikling af vores tilbud. Vi har et fagligt miljø, hvor vores arbejdsdag er præget af, at vi alle samarbejder tæt med mange andre aktører, både intern i kommune, region og i civilsamfundet. Det betyder, at vi ofte er spredt i løbet af arbejdsdagen og derfor prioriterer at samles til frokost og sparring samt hjælper hinanden, når det er muligt.

Derfor skal du vælge os

Vi tilbyder en unik mulighed for at kombinere dine erfaringer fra kræftområdet, rehabilitering, forebyggelse og sundhedsfremme med dine kompetencer og lyst til at koordinere samt arbejde med udsatte borgere i sårbare livssituationer. Samtidig med at du kommer til at være med til at udvikle et rygområde sammen med mange gode samarbejdspartnere.

Hos os får du:
· Stor indflydelse på egne opgaver og udviklingen af nye indsatser
· En fleksibel og afvekslende arbejdsdag
· Gode muligheder for kompetenceudvikling, kurser og faglig sparring
· Høj grad af selvstændighed og mulighed for at præge både dine arbejdsopgaver og udviklingen af de områder, du får ansvar for
· Ekstern supervision og et stærkt tværfagligt fællesskab

Vi har gode faciliteter og rammer, hvor vi kan sidde 1-3 medarbejdere pr. kontor, samtalerum/stillekontorer, multirum og mødelokaler. Vi bevæger os rundt på mange forskellige matrikler, så det er en fordel at være på cykel.
Der er mulighed for fri parkering i området omkring os, og vi ligger 5 minutters gang fra Rødovre Centrum.
Vi ved at ingen kan alt, men hvis vi har vakt din interesse – så send os en ansøgning eller kontakt os. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.
Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte leder Sonja Bjørnø på 30 76 81 92. Vi viser også gerne Sundhedscentret frem efter aftale. Du kan læse mere på eller se vores Facebook eller Instagram: ”Rødovre Sundhedscenter”.

Vi afvikler første samtalerunde onsdag den 20. oktober og anden runde med casearbejde fredag den 22. oktober.

Ansættelse og løn
37 timer/uge.
Arbejdstid primært mellem kl. 8–18 (torsdag til kl. 18). Du skal i denne stilling være indstillet på, at der kan være behov for at du ind imellem arbejder til sen eftermiddag andre dage af hensyn til borgerne. Et par gange om året kan der forekomme weekendarbejde, da vi deltager i forskellige events i kommunen.
Ansøgningsfrist: 18. oktober
Tiltrædelse: senest 1. december
Løn og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst og efter aftale med den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Ved ansættelse i Rødovre Kommune indhentes straffeattest.

Rødovre Kommune er en geografisk lille og centralt beliggende kommune med et højt ambitionsniveau for borgerne og byen. Også af den grund er vi en attraktiv og spændende arbejdsplads, og vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke. Derfor opfordrer vi alle uanset alder, køn, handicap, livsstil, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge jobbet.

Vi tilbyder vores medarbejdere en trivsels- og sundhedsordning med bl.a. fysioterapi og holdtræning. Bemærk, at Rødovre Kommune har røg- og nikotinfri arbejdstid, som betyder, at vi ikke må ryge eller tilsvarende som vapes eller snus i arbejdstiden.

Vores stillinger opslås på fuld tid medmindre andet er angivet i stillingsopslaget.

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
description:
Konovo is a global healthcare intelligence company on a mission to transform research through technology- enabling faster, better, connected insights.

Konovo provides healthcare organisations with access to over 2 million healthcare professionals and patients—the largest network of its kind globally. With a workforce of over 300 employees across 5 countries: India, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the United Kingdom, Mexico, and the United States, we collaborate to support some of the most prominent names in healthcare. Our customers include over 300 global pharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, research agencies, and consultancy firms.

As we transition from a service-oriented model to a product-driven platform, we are expanding our hybrid Bengaluru based team. We are looking for a Senior Applied AI Engineer to help advance the next chapter of Konovo’s AI-native platform. You'll be joining the 5+ member AI Foundation team responsible for advancing our core AI platform. You'll be working with each of our product engineering teams to incorporate AI capabilities into each of the products they are responsible for.

AI is already embedded in our product and internal tooling. Your role will be to deepen, scale, and operationalise those capabilities across our platform, data systems, and engineering workflows with production reliability and enterprise discipline. You will partner with global engineering, data, and product teams to translate real business problems into production-ready AI solutions.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands both the promise and limits of modern AI. You will design thoughtfully, build pragmatically, and ship responsibly. Your work will directly shape how our customers and employees experience AI at Konovo. You will operate in an environment where AI decisions impact enterprise customers globally and must meet high standards of reliability, compliance, and performance. AI is a strategic differentiator for Konovo. As a globally scaled healthcare intelligence company service hundreds of enterprise customers, AI at Konovo must accelerate innovation while protecting reliability, data integrity, and customer trust.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI and LLM-powered features within our intelligent platform
  • Improve model performance, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency in enterprise-scale production environments
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions
  • Advance our provider-agnostic AI architecture to enable secure access to multiple LLM ecosystems
  • Build internal AI tooling that enhances engineering productivity and broader employee workflows
  • Establish best practices for model evaluation, prompt engineering, testing, and governance
  • Ensure responsible AI implementation aligned with data privacy, security, and compliance standards
  • Design AI systems with strong guardrails around privacy, auditability, global regulatory requirements, and long-term maintainability
  • Contribute to architectural decisions as we evolve our modern data stack and AI platform capabilities
  • Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar for applied AI across the team
  • Evaluate emerging AI capabilities rigorously, adopting what delivers measurable value while avoiding unnecessary complexity or hype

What We’re Looking For:

  • A proactive and strategic thinker with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • 5+ years of experience building and deploying AI/ML systems in production environments
  • Strong hands-on experience with LLM integration, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and performance optimisation
  • Experience building AI systems where reliability, compliance, and uptime are business-critical
  • Proficiency in Python and experience working with modern AI frameworks and libraries
  • Experience building systems in cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. AWS preferred.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture, APIs, and scalable backend systems
  • Experience working in product-focused engineering teams, not just research environments
  • Ability to balance innovation with product stability, cost discipline, and measurable business impact
  • Comfort explaining AI trade-offs and feasibility clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working across timezones and collaborating with global teams
  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field
  • Adaptability to thrive in a fast-changing environment while navigating challenges collaboratively.

Bonus Points For Experience with:

  • Vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or model orchestration frameworks
  • Databricks, Snowflake, or modern lakehouse architectures
  • Healthcare, research, or data-intensive domains

Why Join Konovo?

  • Join a fast-growing global team with opportunities for professional growth and advancement.

title: Staff Engineer, Data (Remote, US)
description:
Who We Are

Renew Home is on a mission to change how we power the world by making it easier for customers to save energy and money at home as part of the largest residential virtual power plant in North America.

We partner with industry-leading brands to better manage residential energy for users by prioritizing efficiency, savings, and comfort — and cleaner energy for everyone.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer striving to create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment where everyone feels that they have a voice that is heard.

We strongly encourage candidates to check out our website at to learn more about the world-changing work we are doing.

Role Summary

At Renew Home, we are committed to transforming how residential energy is managed across North America. As a Staff Data Engineer, you will serve as a foundational technical leader shaping our end-to-end data platform strategy, real-time streaming pipelines, and enterprise data lakehouse ecosystem. You will architect high-throughput, fault-tolerant infrastructure capable of processing streaming device telemetry from millions of connected homes to support scalable analytics, operational insights, and machine learning initiatives.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role with meaningful technical leadership responsibility. You will act as a force multiplier across the engineering organization by mentoring engineers, incorporating feedback, influencing engineering culture, and helping shape how we work.

What You Will Do

  • Define and drive the long-term data architecture vision, roadmap, and design standards across Renew Home's virtual power plant ecosystem, ensuring high availability, security, scalability, and resilience.
  • Lead the design and implementation of fault-tolerant batch and real-time streaming data infrastructure capable of continuously processing data from millions of connected devices.
  • Collaborate closely with application and analytics engineering teams to drive data architecture vision and delivery.
  • Direct database architecture and continuous performance tuning across PostgreSQL Aurora, AWS Redshift, and query engines through advanced indexing, partitioning, and workload management strategies.
  • Set high technical standards for data pipeline development, monitoring, data quality, and uptime; actively lead infrastructure management and support operations in our on-call rotation
  • Mentor and guide senior and mid-level data engineers, promoting engineering best practices, architectural design reviews, and technical growth across the organization.
  • Continuously evaluate, prototype, and integrate modern data technologies and frameworks (e.g., Python, Redshift, Postgres, AWS/GCP, Lambda, Kinesis, Prefect, Iceberg, Terraform) to ensure optimal system evolution.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of software and data engineering experience, with a proven track record of architectural leadership at scale.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and operating production-grade high-volume batch and real-time data streaming architectures using technologies like GCP PubSub, AWS Kinesis, AWS Lambda, Apache Kafka and Apache Flink.
  • Deep expertise in building scalable data lake architectures (AWS S3, Iceberg, AWS Glue, Delta Lake) and managing structured and unstructured device telemetry data.
  • Expert hands-on proficiency in database design, performance tuning, query optimization, indexing, and partitioning with AWS Redshift and PostgreSQL Aurora.
  • Mastery of Python and SQL with strong software engineering principles, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, CDKTF and AWS CDK.
  • Self-starter with exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, capable of turning complex ambiguous problems into clean, scalable technical solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineering talent, drive cross-functional alignment, and champion data infrastructure best practices across multiple teams.
  • Bonuses:
    • Extensive experience optimizing enterprise-scale data warehouses and leveraging advanced Redshift capabilities (e.g., Redshift Spectrum, concurrency scaling, Workload Management).
    • Hands-on experience with big data engines (e.g., Apache Spark, Ray) or building end-to-end Machine Learning pipelines.
    • Active contributions to open-source data ecosystems or relevant advanced certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics, GCP Professional Data Engineer, AWS Solutions Architect Professional).

Benefits

What You'll Get

  • A full-time position, with a competitive salary based on experience. The base salary for this role is $170k - $220k. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for a target annual bonus of 15% of base salary, and participation in long-term incentive programs tied to company growth and performance. We use market data and consider your job family, background, skills, experience, and U.S. work location to determine compensation within our established pay range.
  • Fully remote work environment with home office set-up allowance.
  • Real and lived work-life balance - Company perks include no pre-set vacation limits (with a top-down culture of taking meaningful PTO every year!), parental leave benefits, and a corporate value of working sustainably and putting families first.
  • Competitive benefits package that includes numerous health and wellness benefits.
  • 401(k) plan, with employer contributions to the same.
  • Opportunity to work with amazing people who are passionate about their mission, thriving in a fully-remote work environment, and learning and growing every day.

At this time, Renew Home is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future immigration from the company, including training plans for foreign students.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Individuals seeking employment at Renew Home are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, gender identification, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Lähihoitaja, Ikääntyneiden palvelut, Kuntouttava arviointiyksikkö, Loimaa
description:
Kuntouttavia arviointiyksiköitä toimii Varsinais-Suomen alueella Kaarinassa, Naantalissa, Turussa, Paraisilla, Liedossa, Halikossa, Uudessakaupungissa ja Loimaalla. Kuntouttavan arvioinnin tavoitteena on mahdollistaa ikääntyneiden kotona ja omassa elinpiirissä selviytyminen tarjoamalla yhdenmukaisia ja laadukkaita arviointi- ja kuntoutuspalveluja.

Loimaan Kartanonmäki 1 on toiminnan käynnistyessä 20-paikkainen yksikkö. Työskentelet moniammatillisessa työryhmässä, johon kuuluvat lääkäri, vastaava sairaanhoitaja, sairaanhoitaja, lähihoitaja, sosiaaliohjaaja, fysioterapeutti ja toimintaterapeutti. Kuntouttavien arviointiyksiköiden toiminnan keskiössä on ikääntyneiden asiakkaiden toimintakyvyn ja palvelutarpeiden arviointi moniammatillisena yhteistyönä.

Tehtäväsi

Lähihoitajana varmistat asiakkaan kuntoutumista edistävän hoitotyön ja palveluiden toteutumisen sekä osallistut käytännön hoitotyön ja terveyden edistämisen suunnitteluun, toteutukseen ja arviointiin. Työsi tavoitteena on tukea asiakkaan kotona asumista ja toimintakyvyn säilymistä.

Hyödynnät työssäsi toimintakyvyn arvioinnin mittareita, kuten RAI-arviointia, osallistut hoidon suunnitteluun osana moniammatillista tiimiä ja seuraat asiakkaiden terveydentilaa sekä kuntoutumista. Raportoit muutoksista ja dokumentoit hoitotyötä tietosuojakäytänteet huomioiden. Lisäksi ohjaat ja neuvot asiakkaita sekä heidän omaisiaan ja osallistut uusien työntekijöiden, resurssipoolin työntekijöiden sekä opiskelijoiden perehdyttämiseen. Lähihoitajan työ on kolmivuorotyötä.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden olla mukana rakentamassa uuden yksikön toimintaa alusta alkaen ja vaikuttamassa ikääntyneiden asiakkaiden kuntoutumisen sekä kotona asumisen tukemiseen. Työssä yhdistyvät kuntouttava hoitotyö, toimintakyvyn arviointi ja moniammatillinen yhteistyö.

Pääset hyödyntämään osaamistasi monipuolisissa tehtävissä sekä työskentelemään tiiviissä yhteistyössä eri ammattiryhmien kanssa asiakkaan parhaaksi.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Odotamme sinulta kiinnostusta ikääntyneiden kuntoutumista edistävään hoitotyöhön, kykyä toimia moniammatillisessa tiimissä sekä valmiutta hyödyntää toimintakyvyn arvioinnin menetelmiä osana asiakastyötä. Tehtävässä toimiminen edellyttää hyvää suomen kielen taitoa.

Arvostamme vastuullista työotetta, huolellista kirjaamista ja kykyä ohjata asiakkaita sekä heidän läheisiään. Katsomme eduksi voimassa olevan LOVe-lääkeluvan, RAI-arviointimittariston tuntemuksen sekä hyvät tietotekniset taidot.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkinto (lähihoitaja) tai alan aikaisempi kouluasteinen tutkinto sekä voimassa oleva rekisteröinti JulkiTerhikki- ja JulkiSuosikki-rekisterissä.

Hae mukaan rakentamaan uutta kuntouttavaa arviointiyksikköä ja tekemään vaikuttavaa työtä ikääntyneiden toimintakyvyn, kuntoutumisen ja kotona asumisen tukemiseksi. Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävät sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

title: Insurance Coordinator
description:
PURPOSE AND SCOPE:

Explores, recommends, and coordinates the insurance and potential financial assistance options available to kidney dialysis patients in a specified geographic area, while maximizing revenue for the company. Supports FMCNA's mission, vision, core values and customer service philosophy. Adheres to the FMCNA Compliance Program, including following all regulatory and company policy requirements

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Meets regularly with dialysis patients at the clinic(s) in the assigned region to educate and coordinate insurance options:

  • Educates on the availability of alternative insurance options (i.e., Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Supplement, State Renal programs and COBRA).
  • Ensures patients have followed through with the application process.
  • Obtains premium statements and signatures from patients.
  • Discusses situation and options if employment status changes or other situations change.
  • Completes and follows up with paperwork when claims are disputed for non-payment.
  • Collects necessary documents to completed initial and annual indigent waivers.
  • Discusses insurance options when insurance contracts are terminated.

Responsibilities involving Medicare and Medicaid include but are not limited to:

  • Determining Medicare eligibility by meeting with the patients and contacting local Social Security offices to verify eligibility.
  • Discussing the Medicare application with eligible patients and assisting with the application process.
  • Acting as liaison between the patient and the local agents for Medicare terminations and re-in statements.
  • Completing the annual open enrollment and Medicare reinstatement papers with the patients.
  • Tracking 30-month coordinator period each month for those patients on employer Group Health Plans to ensure Medicare will be in place once coordination ends.
  • Monitoring and verifying the Medicaid status of each patient on a monthly basis and determining the spend down amounts
  • Works with patients to evaluate personal financial information and make determination for indigent program.
  • Completes initial Indigent waiver applications.
  • Tracks and completes annual indigent waiver applications.
  • Monitors all patients' insurance information to ensure that it is updated and accurate for the Accounts Receivable Department.
  • Addresses any identified anomalies or discrepancies, researches and answers questions as needed.
  • Meets with patients receiving direct payments from insurance companies to ensure payment of dialysis treatments owed to Fresenius.
  • Prepares, analyzes and reviews monthly reports to track work progress on caseloads; Analyzes patient reports from billing systems as an audit check to ensure the correct insurance information is entered into the billing system and that other changes are not overlooked. Researches and corrects any discrepancies identified.
  • Provides QA team members with monthly information regarding the details of the patients' primary and secondary insurance status as well as documentation regarding the plans of actions currently in place on a monthly basis as required by QA processes
  • Completes monthly audit exam to stay current on internal policies.
  • May present on insurance and financial assistance options to patients as necessary.
  • Assist with various projects as assigned by direct supervisor.

Additional responsibilities may include focus on one or more departments or locations. See applicable addendum for department or location specific functions.

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Day to day work includes desk and personal computer work and interaction with patients and facility staff. The work environment is characteristic of a health care facility with air temperature control and moderate noise levels. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Extensive local travel to clinics in a specified geographic area; must have a valid Driver's License.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's Degree required; Social Work or other Healthcare focus preferred.


EXPERIENCE AND REQUIRED SKILLS:

  • 2 - 5 years' related experience; healthcare industry preferred.
  • Experience with Medicare, Social Security and Medicaid systems a plus.
  • Past patient interaction a plus.
  • Excellent written and communication skills.
  • A strong customer service philosophy.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently.
  • Proficient with PCs and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Valid Driver's License

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation come before competence. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will own the environments, the deployment path, and the platform operations beneath production data products for a federal agency. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are.

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $140,000 per year. It is a remote position. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship; dual citizenship and green card holders are prohibited by the contract terms. It also requires the ability to satisfy the required suitability, security, and access requirements.

Your first project

Your first project will likely have you building the environments and the deployment automation the rest of the team builds on, and supporting them through cutover. Depending on the assignment, you may:

  • Stand up and maintain the Azure Databricks environments, including the access, secrets, and networking they depend on.
  • Build the deployment automation that promotes work between environments, using Declarative Automation Bundles (formerly Databricks Asset Bundles), infrastructure as code, and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI and CD) pipelines.
  • Tune Delta pipelines and platform performance.
  • Run platform operations, and write the runbooks that let someone else operate what you built.
  • Support environment parity, migration, and cutover alongside the Databricks team, under Peregrine change control, including bindings, rollback, and the evidence a release review needs.

You deliver environments that behave the same way twice and a deployment path the team can use without asking you. You automate the promotion, checks, and evidence that would otherwise be assembled by hand before every release, and you leave the runbooks and controls that keep the platform supportable after cutover.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of platform engineering, DevSecOps, or cloud infrastructure experience
  • Hands-on Azure Databricks platform work, including Unity Catalog and Delta pipeline performance
  • Deployment automation and environment promotion, including infrastructure as code and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI and CD) pipelines
  • Cloud networking, secrets management, and least-privilege access design in a governed environment
  • Platform operations for a production data platform
  • Migration and cutover support, including environment parity, rollback planning, and the evidence a release review asks for
  • Scripting in Python or Bash, and Git-based version control
  • Platform or DevSecOps work in at least one cloud environment other than Databricks, for example Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud
  • Delivery experience in a federal government environment, working to its security, access, and review processes
  • Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

  • Experience on a federal system accredited at Impact Level 5 (IL-5) or higher
  • Declarative Automation Bundles (formerly Databricks Asset Bundles), Terraform, or Azure DevOps pipelines
  • Databricks certification, or an Azure or Amazon Web Services cloud certification
  • Federal security experience supporting compliance frameworks, security controls, and authorization evidence
  • Familiarity with artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted developer tooling
  • United States citizenship; dual citizenship and green card holders are prohibited by the contract terms
  • The ability to satisfy the required suitability, security, and access requirements

Who you are

You treat the platform as a product the team depends on, and you would rather automate a step than document a workaround for it. You think in environments, permissions, and failure modes, and you check that a change behaves the same way in the next environment as it did in the last one. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What you bring

  • Hands-on work with Azure Databricks environments, including Unity Catalog and Delta performance.
  • The deployment craft around the platform, including infrastructure as code, environment promotion, and release automation.
  • Working depth in a second cloud platform, so you can judge a design on its tradeoffs rather than one vendor's defaults.
  • The operations discipline that migration and cutover demand, including parity, rollback, and evidence.

You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What we offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What we commit to

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

title: Regulatory Counsel (Data Protection & AI)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


The Legal team turns complexity into clarity by partnering with teams across Revolut to provide sharp, practical advice that helps the business move fast while staying protected. From structuring credit programmes to navigating new markets, the Legal team ensures growth is secure, compliant, and built for the long term.


We're looking for a Legal Counsel to advise on compliance and legal issues around data protection and artificial intelligence.


Reporting to the Head of Legal (Data Protection & AI) in London, you can be based in one of our European offices listed above, work remotely, or hybrid.


The breadth of work you'll encounter (and level of commercial involvement) is pretty unique for an in-house role, so you'll have a large degree of responsibility for our ongoing development and growth.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you’ll be doing

  • Advising the business on privacy, data protection, and AI legal issues around the structuring and marketing of new and existing products
  • Ensuring privacy, data protection, and AI considerations are core to the review process when launching features
  • Drafting and negotiating contractual data protection and AI clauses with a variety of third parties and other Revolut entities
  • Advising on complex international data transfers and how to structure these to bring them into line with GDPR requirements
  • Assisting with data breaches, including drafting breach notifications to be submitted to our supervisory authorities
  • Drafting and maintaining customer-facing privacy notices, explainers, and cookie policies
  • Liaising with global Legal Counsels on privacy, data protection, and AI matters that impact multiple jurisdictions
  • Supporting our Data Subject Rights teams to respond to complex data protection requests where legal review is required
  • Proactively engaging and working alongside regulators in multiple countries
  • Keeping on top of and advising on legal, regulatory, and industry developments
  • Leading by example while performing hands-on work to manage complex legal tasks quickly


What you'll need

  • 4-6 years of PQE
  • Excellent academic and law firm credentials
  • Experience advising on privacy, data protection, and AI matters in the United Kingdom and/or European Union
  • Sound judgement, composure under pressure, and a collaborative mindset
  • Confidence making decisions where there's ambiguity or incomplete information
  • A demonstrated track record of providing privacy and data protection legal advice
  • Some experience providing AI legal advice (alongside a genuine interest in the area)
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Experience providing detailed product counselling advice on innovative, customer-facing products
  • Fluency in English


Nice to have

  • Additional privacy and data protection qualifications

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a RPA Customer Engagement Specialist based in United States.

This role helps expand the adoption of robotic process automation across federal healthcare and supported organizations.
You will identify operational challenges and connect them with practical automation opportunities.
The position combines customer engagement, process discovery, marketing, and digital transformation.
You will build relationships with leaders and business process owners while developing a sustainable opportunity pipeline.
The role also supports demonstrations, briefings, outreach campaigns, and customer-facing communications.
Success is measured by meaningful opportunities progressing from initial conversations to viable automation initiatives.
This is an opportunity to help reduce administrative workload, improve efficiency, and deliver measurable operational value through automation.

  • Identify and develop new RPA opportunities across healthcare organizations, treatment facilities, program offices, and other supported groups.

  • Build and maintain relationships with organizational leaders, process owners, and key stakeholders to understand operational challenges and automation needs.

  • Conduct initial process-discovery discussions to assess workflows, pain points, workloads, and desired outcomes.

  • Determine whether processes are suitable candidates for automation based on factors such as volume, repetition, standardization, manual effort, and error risk.

  • Partner with technical teams and business analysts to assess the feasibility, value, and requirements of prospective automation opportunities.

  • Guide prospective customers through the appropriate RPA intake and service-request processes and maintain engagement throughout the opportunity lifecycle.

  • Develop and execute outreach and awareness strategies, including briefings, demonstrations, webinars, roadshows, conferences, and leadership engagements.

  • Create customer-facing presentations, capability briefs, one-pagers, success stories, use cases, and other promotional materials highlighting the value of automation.

  • Coordinate demonstrations of existing automation solutions and communicate measurable benefits such as labor savings, improved accuracy, faster processing, and stronger compliance.

  • Serve as a liaison between customers and the RPA team during early-stage discovery, ensuring expectations, requirements, and next steps are clearly communicated.

  • Track outreach activity, customer engagements, qualified opportunities, intake submissions, and projects entering the development pipeline.

  • Maintain accurate pipeline and engagement metrics and provide recurring status reports to program leadership.

  • Document projected and realized business benefits and use customer feedback and engagement data to recommend improvements.

  • Identify opportunities to replicate successful automation solutions across organizations with similar processes.

  • Support content and communications for approved websites, collaboration platforms, and other RPA awareness channels.
