title: At Your Service Center Associate, Cross County - Part Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Imuautonkuljettaja, Turku
location: Kaarina, Lieto, Naantali, Raisio, Turku, Finland
description:
Asiakasyrityksemme on Varsinais-Suomessa toimiva putkisto- ja viemäröintialan yritys. Asiakkaamme on erikoistunut putkistojen ja viemäröintikanavien huoltotöihin sekä niiden kuvaamiseen ja dokumentointiin. Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme imuauton kuljettajaa erilaisiin viemäri- ja salaojien huoltotöihin.


Tehtävän kuvaus

Tehtävänäsi on imuauton kuljettaminen, sekä siihen liittyvät huoltotyöt. Työtä tehdään pääasiassa arkisin päivävuorossa. Työ on ajoittain fyysistäkin, joten sinulla on hyvä fyysinen kunto. Kohteet vaihtelevat päivän aikana, joten et hetkahda kiireen keskellä.

Työssä tarvitset C-ajokortin ja voimassaolevat ammattipätevyydet. Työtäsi voi helpottaa jos sinulla on aikaisempaa rakennus- tai LVI alan taustaa, ja osaat tulkita eri rakennuskohteiden viemäröintikuvia. Aikaisempi kokemus viemärinpuhdistuksista katsotaan eduksi, mutta tärkeintä on hyvä motivaatio ja halu oppia uutta. Työ alkaa nopealla aikataululla ja palkka neuvotellaan.

Jos seuraavat asiat ovat hallussa, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö

Hakeaksesi tätä työpaikkaa, sinulla tulee olla:

* 2 vuoden kokemus vastaavanlaisesta työstä.
* Hyvä suomen kielen taito - työnjohtokieli on suomi.
* Korkea työmoraali – työ on itsenäistä ja vastaat itse työnjäljestäsi.
* Sosiaaliset taidot kunnossa – tulet toimeen ihmisten kanssa tiukoissakin paikoissa.
* C-ajokortti, sekä ammattipätevyydet voimassa.

Vision työntekijälupaus

Oli visiosi työelämästä kirkas tai vasta hahmottumassa, me autamme molemmissa tapauksissa. Varmistamme, etta tyosopimukset ja varusteet ovat kunnossa, ja että ammattilaisena saat osaamistasi vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tarkeaa, etta viihdyt tyossasi.

Visiolaisena saat tässä tehtävässä:

* Osaamisesi mukaan määräytyvän palkan, joka neuvotellaan.
* Palkanmaksun kaksi kertaa kuukaudessa.
* Paivittaisen tuen tyoasioissa.
* Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi ja edetä vaativampiin tehtäviin.

Onko meillä yhteinen visio? — Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta!

Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

* liität hakemukseesi ansioluettelon (CV) tai kirjaat aikaisemmat työpaikkasi kuluneelta viideltä vuodelta,
* kerrot, miten aiemmissa työpaikoissa opitut asiat tukevat sinua pärjäämään hakemassasi uudessa tehtävässä.

Näin saat lisätietoa tehtävästä

Jos haluat lisätietoja tehtävästä, voit lähettää rekrytoinnista vastaavalle henkilölle sähköpostia otsikolla "Haettu työ" osoitteeseen Kristian Tikka / kristian.tikka(at)visiohr.fi / 0503746385. Olemme tavoitettavissa ma-pe klo 09.00-16.00.

Tsemppiä hakemuksen tekoon!

Visio — Aidosti läsnä alueellasi

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on valtakunnallisesti paikallinen. Tunnemme paikalliset työmarkkinat ja olemme aidosti läsnä alueellasi. Jos haet Varsinais-Suomessa työpaikkaa, siinä auttavat sinua Turusta käsin Jukka, Mikko, Kristian ja Marko.

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut

Visio Varsinais-Suomi on osa Visio Henkilostoratkaisut -konsernia, joka on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilostopalvelualan yritys. Pelaamme reilua pelia ja tarjoamme toita niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Yhdistämme työntekijät ja työnantajat niin, että molemmat löytävät juuri tarpeisiinsa sopivan ratkaisun. Yhteistyo perustuu kaikkien kolmen tahon keskinäiseen luottamukseen.

Jos haluat reilun työnantajan, joka arvostaa osaamistasi ja huomaa työpanoksesi, se on Visio.

title: Product Owner

We are a leading Canadian financial services co-operative committed to being a catalyst for a sustainable and resilient society and our team is essential to deliver on this strategy. That’s why we prioritize our people, to ensure we provide a strong culture and development opportunities which enables our team to thrive and to live our purpose. As the Product Owner, you will play a key role in conveying the vision of the business stakeholders, to an Agile team, accountable for delivering on approved initiatives. How you will succeed:

What’s in it for you?

  • Flexible work options to support personal and family needs.
  • A holistic approach to your well-being, with physical and mental health programs and a supportive workplace culture.
  • Volunteer opportunities to give back to your community.

Expected salary/hourly range is $91,058.00 to $151,764.00 CAD

The salary amount for the successful candidate is determined by Co-operators in its discretion and will vary depending on several criteria including but not limited to: local market conditions, geography and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualification, experience and education.​

title: Environmental Development Technician III
description:
## **Job Details**

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

This unique opportunity is part of the **Mechanical Systems Engineering, Fabrication and Test Division** which engages in research, technology development, and the creation of advanced mechanical, thermal, propulsion, and electronic packaging systems with expertise that spans the full breath of mechanical disciplines and is applied from architectural concept development through operations.

As an **Environmental Development Technician,** you will be working for **Mechanical Fabrication & Test Section** which maintains technical support facilities and resources that provide the services required to fabricate, assemble, and test electro-mechanical developmental and flight hardware.  This Section develops and matures equipment and technologies, which enable and enhance our fabrication and environmental test capability for current and future missions.

**Some Challenges You Will Tackle:**

- Prepare, configure, and support thermal test equipment including small and large vacuum chambers
- Assist with setup and operation of vacuum and thermal chambers
- Install, route, and verify thermocouples and other temperature sensors.
- Troubleshoot vacuum, instrumentation, and data acquisition systems
- Perform chamber leak checks, pump-down operations and system readiness checks
- Monitor thermal vacuum testing and respond to test anomalies or out of limit conditions
- Support test article installation, chamber closeout, and post-test hardware removal
- Perform routine chamber maintenance and repairs
- Coordinate with engineers and other technicians to prepare for environmental testing
- xenon arc lamp handling
- Solar Simulator operations
- Cryo pump rebuilding
- Follow test procedures, safety requirements, and contamination control practices with working with critical hardware
- Work safely around flight hardware following ESD, cleanroom, and critical item handling requirements.
- Fabricate, terminate, label, route, and troubleshoot instrumentation and signal cables supporting vibration, acoustic, shock, and modal testing.

********IMPORTANT******* This position, because of its associated job duties, has been determined by JPL to be safety-sensitive as defined in JPL's Drug Free Workplace Requirement. An employee holding this position will be subject to periodic, unannounced, random drug testing. Please refer to JPL's Drug Free Workplace Requirement for more information. Candidates who are hired into designated safety-sensitive positions will be included in a pool from which individuals are randomly selected to participate in the unannounced drug testing.**

**Qualifications:**

- Typically requires a High School diploma with a minimum of 8 years of related experience; or an Associates degree with a minimum of 4 years of related experience; or a Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 1 years of related experience; and related required training.
- Experience with the use of LN2, GN2, and the design, assembly and fabrication or maintenance of pressure systems
- Experience operating and maintaining Vacuum Chambers
- Experience operating solar simulator
- Experience handling xenon arc lamps
- Experience operating and maintaining small shakers
- Ability to interpret engineering drawings, schematics, and test procedures.
- Demonstrated troubleshooting skills for instrumentation, electrical systems, and thermal vacuum test equipment.
- Ability to work independently and communicate effectively.
- Ability to work in a cleanroom environment with the appropriate gloves, hat, booties, smock etc. in support of flight hardware testing.
- Ability to be available to work day and night shifts, overtime, weekends, and/or holidays, as needed.

**Got These? Even Better**

- Experience operating and maintaining acoustic chambers, tunable shock beams, and mass properties machines
- Knowledge of Electro Static Discharge (ESD) hazards and awareness, Foreign Object Debris (FOD) management, hazard communication, cleanroom protocols and personnel protective equipment, Job Safety Analysis, Lockout/Tagout procedures, and handling of critical flight hardware and testing equipment.
- Fall restraint knowledge and experience
- Knowledge of fabrication of thermal couples, the operation of multi-meters, signal generators, and digital data management equipment and the repair and calibration of instrumentation equipment, spot welding equipment for instrumentation assembly and repair.
- Experience in handling/plumbing of cryogenic liquids and delivery systems, component replacement, the calibration, and repair of helium mass spectrometer leak detectors, experience with the operation or setup of Programmable Logic Control (PLC) type systems.

title: Senior Data Center Specialist - Shift Lead (Australia)
description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Senior Data Center Specialist - Shift Lead (SDCS Shift Lead) is the most senior on-shift technical authority and shift lead within the 24/7 Critical Operations team. This role leads a team of Senior Critical Operations Technicians and Critical Operations Technicians, providing deep technical expertise, operational assurance, leadership in incident response and oversight of plant stability across all electrical, mechanical, controls and life-safety systems.

The SDCS Shift Lead applies high-level technical judgement, disciplined risk management, real-time plant monitoring and structured fault response. The role leads and validates the quality of work completed by Senior Critical Operations Technicians and Critical Operations Technicians, enforces authorised operating boundaries and ensures critical infrastructure is operated safely, accurately and consistently.

The SDCS Shift Lead acts as the on-shift team lead and senior technical point of contact for the Critical Operations Supervisors, Senior Critical Operations Technicians and Critical Operations Technicians, providing high-quality escalation context, analysis and operational recommendations.

This role directly supports STACK’s commitment to 100% uptime and a concierge-level customer service experience, ensuring risk is proactively managed, planned works are executed safely, and customer communications are clear, timely and professional.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Critical Operations

• Uphold STACK’s 100% uptime objective by leading the on-shift team and providing advanced technical oversight, disciplined operational control and proactive plant monitoring.

• Maintain real-time situational awareness of critical electrical, mechanical and controls systems, identifying weak signals, anomalies and developing risks through BMS/EPMS and field observations.

• Act as the Shift Lead and senior technical escalation point for Senior Critical Operations Technicians and Critical Operations Technicians, providing real-time guidance, diagnostic support and risk evaluation.

• Lead or support first-response incident actions for the on-shift team, including stabilisation, containment decisions, technical communication and event documentation.

• Perform advanced diagnostics on abnormal conditions, including interpretation of telemetry, protection responses, redundancy shifts and thermal behaviours.

• Verify operational readiness following maintenance, resets, system changes or commissioning activities by confirming alarms, redundancy status, load paths and control sequences.

• Provide technical direction to Senior Critical Operations Technicians and Critical Operations Technicians during planned maintenance, shutdowns, functional testing and energisations to ensure safe execution aligned to SOPs, MOPs and EOPs.

• Review and provide input into risk assessments, switching plans, permit-to-work controls, isolations/LOTO and return-to-service documentation within authorised scope.

• Conduct targeted enhanced rounds focusing on redundancy health, automation behaviour, generator/UPS coordination, thermal stability and plant performance.

• Coordinate vendor activities during shift, ensuring safe execution, alignment to site requirements and correct system configuration after maintenance.

• Identify systemic risks, recurring faults, capacity constraints and design issues, and escalate to Critical Operations Supervisors, the Site Director and engineering stakeholders.

• Improve operational documentation, including SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, shift logs, CMMS data quality, handover standards and alarm-handling procedures.

• Support reliability investigations, post-event reviews and continuous improvement initiatives by providing detailed technical insights.

• Provide advanced operational expertise, oversight and technical authority. This role does not perform licensed electrical, mechanical or refrigeration work. All trade-restricted work is completed by appropriately licensed personnel or specialist contractors.

People

• Model outstanding safety behaviour, operational discipline and professional conduct as the Shift Lead across the shift.

• Lead, coach, uplift and technically mentor Senior Critical Operations Technicians and Critical Operations Technicians to strengthen team capability and execution consistency.

• Reinforce high-quality shift communication across the on-shift team, including clear escalation structures, accurate technical context and structured handovers.

• Support onboarding and technical familiarisation for new team members, clarifying operating boundaries, site safety, shift expectations and the Shift Lead escalation structure.

• Collaborate effectively with Security, Projects, Facilities and vendors to support safe and coordinated campus operations.

• Represent Critical Operations during customer visits, tours, audits and technical discussions, maintaining a concierge-level customer service approach at all times.

• Contribute practical insights and recommendations during toolbox talks, performance reviews, drills and operational meetings.

Competencies

• Advanced operational judgement in a mission-critical environment.

• Strong technical capability in electrical, mechanical and controls systems.

• Expert interpretation of plant telemetry, protection behaviour, automation sequences and redundancy models.

• Structured troubleshooting and stabilisation capability under pressure.

• Proficiency with BMS/EPMS, CMMS and operational data platforms.

• Skilled in coaching, guiding and uplifting technical capability in others.

• Strong written and verbal communication suitable for incidents and customer interactions.

• Calm, authoritative presence during alarms, escalations and operational events.

• Strong coordination and oversight skills for work control, vendor interaction and RTS verification.

• Continuous improvement mindset focused on safety, reliability and operational excellence.

Work Environment / Conditions

• The role supports a 24/7 rotating shift environment, including nights, weekends and public holidays as operationally required.

• Work occurs across data halls, plant rooms, electrical/mechanical spaces and external plant areas; PPE is required under site policy.

• Participation in emergency response, readiness exercises and incident management activities is required.

Travel Required

• Minimal travel expected; occasional travel between local STACK facilities may be required based on operational needs.

Preferred Education and Experience

• Extensive experience in data centres or other mission-critical facilities, including utilities, hospitals, Defence or industrial environments.

• Demonstrated expertise operating and monitoring critical power and cooling systems, including UPS, generators, switchgear, PDUs/PMMs, ATS/STS, CRAC/CRAH, FWU/CDU, chilled water systems, pumps, controls and fire systems.

• Strong background in inspecting, triaging and stabilising critical plant under abnormal conditions.

• Experience reviewing MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, risk assessments, switching plans and commissioning documentation.

• Ability to interpret single-line diagrams, network diagrams, automation logic, chilled water schematics and OEM manuals.

• Knowledge of permit-to-work processes, isolations/LOTO and operational risk frameworks.

• Strong written and verbal communication for technical reporting, incident updates and customer briefings.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

• Completion of STACK onboarding and required safety/compliance training.

• Ability to meet site authorisation requirements for system operation and system access.

• Physical capability to perform inspections, rounds and emergency response tasks.

• Ongoing compliance with STACK policies, procedures and behavioural standards.

Work Authorisation/Security Clearance Requirements

• Legal entitlement to work in Australia.

• Ability to satisfy pre-employment screening requirements, as applicable, including right-to-work checks, background checks and reference checks.

• Ability to meet data centre security requirements, including badging, access control and adherence to customer-mandated security protocols.

• Security clearance is not required unless specified for a customer-specific facility.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, redundancy, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Other Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this role. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice..

Laitoshuoltaja, tule tekemään kanssamme puhdasta ja toimivaa arkea!

Salon kaupungin ravitsemis- ja puhtaanapitopalveluissa etsimme joukkoomme kiertävää laitoshuoltajaa, jonka ensisijainen työskentelykohde on Salossa, Salon kaupungin eri kohteissa.

Mitä työpäivääsi kuuluu?

Työsi koostuu monipuolisista ylläpito- ja perussiivoustehtävistä sekä palvelukeittiöiden ateriapalvelutehtävistä. Suunnittelet ja toteutat omaa työtäsi työohjeiden, palvelukuvausten, sovitun puhtaustason sekä tilojen käyttäjien tarpeiden ja aikataulujen mukaisesti.
huolehdit tilojen puhtaudesta, hygieniasta, turvallisuudesta ja viihtyisyydestä
toteutat ylläpito- ja perussiivoustehtäviä
käytät erilaisia puhtaanapidon koneita, laitteita, välineitä ja menetelmiä
suunnittelet ja organisoit omaa työtäsi itsenäisesti
noudatat hygieniaan, omavalvontaan, työturvallisuuteen ja kemikaaliturvallisuuteen liittyviä ohjeita
ilmoitat havaitsemistasi poikkeamista ja korjaustarpeista
huolehdit sovitusti esimerkiksi tekstiilihuollosta, tarvikevarastojen täydennyksistä ja muista tukipalvelutehtävistä
hoidat tarvittaessa viherkasveja ja osallistut ympäristöhuollon tehtäviin
osallistut oman työsi, työyhteisön ja palvelujen kehittämiseen sekä uusien työntekijöiden perehdyttämiseen.
tarvittaessa vastaat valmistuskeittiöstä toimitettavien aterioiden tilaamisesta, vastaanottamisesta ja tarjoilusta sovittujen toimintatapojen mukaisesti sekä käytät työssäsi palvelukeittiön keittiölaitteita tarkoituksenmukaisesti.

Millaista työkaveria etsimme?

Sinulta löytyy puhtauspalvelualan perustutkinto, ammattitutkinto tai muu vastaava alan koulutus sekä:
haluat vaikuttaa asiakkaiden hyvinvointiin omalla työlläsi
arvostat yhteistyötä ja toisten onnistumista
kannat vastuun omasta työstäsi
tartut asioihin rohkeasti ja oma-aloitteisesti
lähestyt tilanteita ratkaisukeskeisesti
suhtaudut uusiin tilanteisiin avoimesti ja joustavasti

Kokemus puhtaanapito- ja ravitsemispalvelualalta katsotaan eduksi, mutta meille tärkeintä ovat oppimishalu, positiivinen asenne ja motivaatio tehdä työ hyvin. Tehtävän hoitamisessa tarvitaan oman auton käyttöä.

Meille vastuullisuus näkyy arjen valinnoissa. Työssäsi voit edistää kestävää kehitystä käyttämällä vettä, energiaa, materiaaleja ja puhdistuskemikaaleja harkiten sekä huolehtimalla asianmukaisesta lajittelusta.
Olemme luotettava ja vakaa työnantaja. Meille henkilöstön hyvinvointi on sydämen asia. Mielenkiintoisen työn lisäksi tarjoamme työntekijöillemme henkilöstöetuja, jotka tukevat kokonaisvaltaista hyvinvointia ja jaksamista.

Etuina tarjoamme muun muassa:
koulutusmahdollisuuksia
tyky-rahaa Epassin kautta
maksuttomia ohjattuja liikuntaryhmiä
ruokailun edulliseen henkilökuntahintaan

Työyhteisömme ovat monimuotoisia, kannustavia ja vastaanottavia. Panostamme hyvään johtajuuteen. Salon kaupunki on savuton työpaikka.

Koeaika on puolet määräaikaisen palvelussuhteen kestosta, mikäli virka- ja työehtosopimuksen mukaiset ehdot täyttyvät.

title: Activities Supervisor
description:
With a culture of recognition and reputation for excellence, ELS is the ideal organization in which to develop a long and successful career!

ELS is hiring for the position of Activities Supervisor in Wauchula, Florida.

What you'll do:

The Activities Supervisor directs the planning and implementation of our resort activities and events. This position arranges sponsors, schedules volunteers and reviews potential vendors.

Your job will include:

  • Plan and schedule events for all groups within the resort, as well as private events at the resort facilities.

  • Coordinate and manage all preparations for events: arrange food and beverages, solicit and schedule volunteers, book entertainers, collect ticket sale money, and other duties as required.

  • Arrange for sponsors to fund events.

  • Review requests and select vendors to conduct informational seminars.

  • Manage all activities related to monthly newsletters: gather information for articles, prepare layouts, submit final drafts to the printer, and arrange for delivery.

  • Maintain open communications with resort management, guests and vendors.

  • At all times, represent the resort in a professional manner.

Skills & experience you need:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • 3+ years of experience in events or activities planning.

  • Meticulous attention to details.

  • Excellent communications and organizational skills.

  • Strong skills in the Microsoft Office Suite, knowledge of Microsoft Publisher preferred.

In return for your excellent skills and abilities, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including: medical, dental, and vision plans, a generous 401(k) employer match, and paid vacations, holidays, and sick time.

We invite you to visit our web site at for additional information regarding our exceptional resort communities.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we welcome and thank all applicants.

title: Associate Director Data Strategy - Media Agency
description:
Associate Director, Data Strategy – Media Agency

London | Hybrid working


A standout opportunity to lead data strategy for one of the UK’s best-known health, beauty and wellness retailers.


This is a genuinely data-rich account where the client embraces innovation, invests in testing and wants data to sit at the heart of its marketing. You will turn complex audience and performance data into practical strategies, lead high-impact technology projects and help shape how AI, data partnerships and privacy-first planning are applied across the business.


Candidates should have Experience in a data-led media, advertising technology or digital activation role, with strong knowledge of audience-based buying, segmentation and audience data management.



Company and benefits

  • Join the growing data, technology and analytics division of a major global media network.
  • Work with a leading UK retailer that values innovation, collaboration and ambitious thinking.
  • Join a team that has doubled in size over the past year as its client remit continues to expand.
  • Access advanced data platforms, analytical tools and a global community of data scientists and specialists.
  • Lead strategic projects beyond day-to-day campaign delivery.
  • Build experience across audience strategy, AI, data partnerships, experimentation and governance.
  • Benefit from extensive training, development and clear progression opportunities.
  • Work within a collaborative agency and client partnership where successful work is recognised and celebrated.


Role and responsibilities

  • Transform customer and media data into actionable strategies that improve marketing performance.
  • Develop audience-led planning and bidding recommendations across addressable paid media channels.
  • Identify new audience signals, datasets and data products that can support the client’s commercial goals.
  • Lead testing programmes and work with activation teams to develop robust measurement methodologies.
  • Own strategic data partnership projects, ensuring external data is integrated and used effectively.
  • Help define valuable applications for agentic AI across the wider data and analytics team.
  • Work closely with media, MarTech, CRM, analytics and activation specialists.
  • Translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders, keeping projects aligned with client objectives.
  • Produce client-facing case studies and share successful innovation across the wider business.
  • Manage the approval and governance process for new data partners within a privacy-sensitive environment.


Skills and experience required

  • Experience in a data-led media, advertising technology or digital activation role.
  • Strong knowledge of audience-based buying, segmentation and audience data management.
  • Experience using data to develop actionable campaign, targeting or bidding recommendations.
  • Confidence managing senior clients and multiple stakeholders within a matrixed environment.
  • Strong analytical ability, including interpreting raw data and turning it into clear recommendations.
  • An understanding of data products, marketing technology and emerging AI applications.
  • Knowledge of experimentation and test-and-learn methodologies.
  • A solid understanding of privacy-first media, data governance and responsible data use.
  • Excellent communication, presentation and relationship-building skills.
  • Retail, health, beauty or other data-rich consumer-sector experience would be advantageous.

title: Senior SAP PP/QM Analyst
description:
Based in our Bengaluru office on a 16x5 shift pattern with on-call support on a rota basis.

The role focuses on specialist operational support for SAP S/4HANA Production Planning (PP) and Quality Management (QM), including complex incident resolution, problem management, system stability, and continuous improvement.

You will also contribute to DevOps activities, enhancements, testing, releases, and project delivery, working closely with business, functional, and technical teams.

You should have a B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, with at least 7 years of overall experience and strong hands-on SAP PP/QM functional and configuration expertise.

Responsibilities:

  • Work with the business to understand manufacturing and quality-management requirements and translate them into SAP solutions.
  • Perform requirement analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, documentation, deployment, and post-go-live support.
  • Configure and support SAP PP and QM processes in an SAP S/4HANA environment.
  • Find opportunities to simplify and standardize business processes using SAP standard functionality.
  • Prepare functional specifications for enhancements, interfaces, reports, forms, and workflows.
  • Work closely with ABAP, integration, security, data, and other functional teams.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and resolve complex production and quality-related issues.
  • Prepare test scenarios and support SIT, UAT, regression testing, cutover, and launch activities.
  • Support master-data migration, validation, and reconciliation activities.
  • Provide functional guidance and knowledge transfer to business users and support teams.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in PP process like MRP Live, Demand Management, MTO/MTS process, Production order life cycle, Capacity planning and QM Process like Quality planning, Quality inspection, result recording, defect management etc
  • Detailed understanding of PP and QM master data BOM, Routings, Work Centres, Production Versions, MIC, Inspection plan and Batch-managed manufacturing processes.
  • Integration of PP/QM with MM, SD, EWM/WM, and Product Costing.
  • Experience working with interfaces between SAP and external manufacturing, quality, MES, or planning systems.
  • Understanding of Fiori applications related to production planning, manufacturing execution, and quality management.
  • Track record of end user operational support, Incident, Request, Change and Problem Management aligned with ITIL.
  • Participate in Major Incident Management, Root Cause Analysis and continuous activities to keep platform reliable and reduce recurring issues.
  • Maintain operational documentation and work closely with internal teams and external vendors to resolve sophisticated issues.

'Nice to Have' Skills and Experience:

  • Knowledge of PP/DS or Advanced Planning.
  • Knowledge of MES/LIMS integration.
  • Understanding of Product Costing and production-order costing.
  • Experienced with development practices such as Waterfall, Agile.
  • Experienced working in a global, diverse and multicultural environment.
  • Exposure to manufacturing industries such as semiconductor, electronics, automotive, engineering, or high-tech manufacturing!

title: Senior Creative Producer (Fixed-term Employment)
location: Athens, Greece; Berlin, Germany; Copenhagen, Denmark; Helsinki, Finland; Stockholm, Sweden
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is a Finnish technology company known for its local commerce platform. From food delivery to grocery stores and cosmetics, we make cities better places to live by connecting people with the things they need. Our Global Creative Production team is currently undergoing a massive transformation, shifting from a reactive service center to an "upstream AI-Enabled growth engine".

We are looking for a Senior Creative Producer to join us at this pivotal moment.

This is a 6-month fixed contract opportunity starting ASAP.

Location: Helsinki, Berlin, Athens, Stockholm, Copenhagen

What you’ll be doing

As the Senior Creative Producer, you will manage digital projects from brief to final delivery. You’ll thrive in cross-functional collaboration across different business departments such as B2B, Communication, New Verticals, and Wolt+ teams. You’ll own project timelines for successful deliveries, weekly standups, daily communication with stakeholders and creative teams, and the localization and QA process during the production of social and digital assets.

You will own the end-to-end production of digital advertising projects, ensuring our creative assets are not only on-brand but also built for massive scale across global markets. You will be responsible for the day-to-day organization of the team and daily communication from brief to delivery.

Day-to-day in this role, you’ll:

  • End-to-End Delivery: Manage digital projects and multi-channel campaigns from concept to launch. Our deliverables touch social, in-app, DOOH, event collateral, and OOH.
  • Resource & Budget Control: Oversee project costs, timelines, and team allocations without losing creative quality.
  • Stakeholder Management: Align internal marketing teams, designers, and external agencies on project milestones and timelines. Daily and/or weekly status updates are crucial for the success of our projects.
  • Time Management & Multitasking: Excellent time management skills with the ability to set priorities, multitask, and meet deadlines. Our producers are working on multiple projects simultaneously, and projects might touch different surfaces each time.

Our humble expectations

  • Solid Production Experience: 8+ years in creative production or integrated campaign management, ideally within a high-growth tech environment or a progressive digital agency.
  • Understanding of Media Plans: You have experience with specs and asset production across Awareness, Consideration, and Conversion layers.
  • Stakeholder Management: Ability to manage complex projects with multiple high-level stakeholders while maintaining high creative standards. Demonstrated success partnering with distributed teams across time zones and cultures
  • Risk Management & Reporting: Ability to assess risks during production, find solutions, and share with management and stakeholders in a timely manner.
  • Organizational skills: Methodical in following a predetermined system to complete tasks and meticulous in paying close attention to small details without losing sight of the big picture.
  • Strong work ethic and accountability: A proactive attitude and rigor on everyday tasks, a positive mindset despite ongoing changes, and an excitement to learn. Resourceful during productions; deciding and acting on whether to bring external and/or internal resources and self-motivated to lead the project to completion. Someone who doesn’t shy away from a challenge and follows through on commitments made.
  • Tech-Forward Mindset: You have a strong interest (and ideally experience) in AI-powered creative tools and generative workflows.

What we offer

  • Shape the Future: You won’t just be filling a seat; you’ll be building the blueprint for how Wolt produces creative content for years to come.
  • Innovation at Scale: Work at the forefront of AI and automation in the creative industry, moving from manual tasks to agentic workflows.
  • Impact: Take ownership of strategic business priorities and see your work scale globally.
  • Wolt Culture: Join a team that values ownership, heart, and a "get things done" attitude in a hybrid, flexible work environment.

Next steps

  • Application Review: Our Production team will review your profile to see if your experience aligns with our strategy.
  • TA Screen: A 30-minute introductory call to discuss your background and motivations.
  • Hiring Manager Interview: A deep dive into your production philosophy with our Creative Production Lead.
  • Loop: Competency & Operating Principles: a structured behavioural interview with the team.
  • Working Session: a short case study and walk us through your thinking.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Quality Practice Advisor
description:
Position Purpose:
Establishes and fosters a healthy working relationship between large physician practices, IPAs and Centene. Educates providers and supports provider practice sites regarding the National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) HEDIS measures and risk adjustment. Provides education for HEDIS measures, appropriate medical record documentation and appropriate coding. Assists in resolving deficiencies impacting plan compliance to meet State and Federal standards for HEDIS and documentation standards. Acts as a resource for the health plan peers on HEDIS measures, appropriate medical record documentation and appropriate coding. Supports the development and implementation of quality improvement interventions and audits in relation to plan providers.


Key Details: Candidates must reside in Nevada, as this position requires occasional travel. One of the following active licenses or certifications is required: CCS, LPN, LCSW, LMHC, LMSW, LMFT, LVN, RN, APRN, HCQM, CHP, CPHQ, CPC, CPC-A, or CBCS. Preferred qualifications include provider experience, HEDIS knowledge, medical coding experience, quality improvement experience, and health plan experience.


  • Delivers, advises and educates provider practices and IPAs in appropriate HEDIS measures, medical record documentation guidelines and HEDIS ICD-9/10 CPT coding in accordance with state, federal, and NCQA requirements.
  • Collects, summarizes, trends, and delivers provider quality and risk adjustment performance data to identify and strategize/coach on opportunities for provider improvement and gap closure.
  • Collaborates with Provider Relations and other provider facing teams to improve provider performance in areas of Quality, Risk Adjustment and Operations (claims and encounters).
  • Identifies specific practice needs where Centene can provide support.
  • Develops, enhances and maintains provider clinical relationship across product lines.
  • Maintains Quality KPI and maintains good standing with HEDIS Abstraction accuracy rates as per corporate standards.
  • Ability to travel up to 75% of time to provider offices.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Education/Experience:
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent required
3+ years in HEDIS record collection and risk adjustment (coding) required


Licenses/Certifications:
One of the following required: CCS, LPN, LCSW, LMHC, LMSW, LMFT, LVN, RN, APRN, HCQM, CHP, CPHQ, CPC, CPC-A or CBCS

Pay Range: $27.02 - $48.55 per hour

At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.

Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.


Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the LA County Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act

Lead and expand Oxfam America's Inclusive Value Chains (IVC) programming and support the Corporate Accountability and Worker Justice Department's investor-focused work. Directly supervise four employees: Senior Advisor, Advocacy and Engagement; Senior Advisor, Inclusive Value Chains and Country Engagement and Land Rights; Company Engagement Lead, Inclusive Value Chains; and Advisor, Private Sector Climate Resilience and Inclusive Value Chains. title: Deployment Strategist
description:

Compensation: $150,000–$225,000 base salary + equity

About the Opportunity

Our client is seeking a Deployment Strategist to join their fast-growing technology company building AI-powered software for complex manufacturing and procurement environments.

In this role, you will work directly with customers across industries such as aerospace, defense, space, energy, and robotics to implement and operationalize a sophisticated procurement platform. You will own customer deployments from signed contract through go-live and beyond, working across procurement, engineering, finance, and IT teams.

This is a highly technical, customer-facing role at the intersection of implementation, data, systems integration, and business operations. You will learn how each customer's organization operates, map data from systems such as ERP, PLM, and MES platforms, configure workflows, troubleshoot integration issues, and help customers successfully adopt the platform.

What You'll Do

  • Own customer deployments from kickoff through discovery, data mapping and migration, configuration, go-live, and ongoing adoption.
  • Partner with procurement, engineering, finance, and IT stakeholders to understand business processes and translate them into scalable system workflows.
  • Map and validate data flows between the platform and ERP, PLM, and MES systems such as NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, Epicor, Arena, Teamcenter, and similar platforms.
  • Write SQL and GraphQL queries to validate migrations, investigate data discrepancies, troubleshoot issues, and support customer analytics.
  • Configure workflows for approval chains, RFQs, supplier onboarding, purchasing, and other procurement processes.
  • Diagnose integration and synchronization issues, working closely with engineering teams to resolve technical blockers.
  • Serve as an ongoing technical partner to customers, tracking adoption, identifying risks, and helping drive successful outcomes.
  • Translate recurring customer challenges and requirements into actionable feedback for product and engineering teams.
  • Help develop implementation templates, data-mapping guides, onboarding runbooks, success metrics, and other deployment best practices.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience owning customer implementations, deployments, technical programs, or operational outcomes.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative foundation, ideally within engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics, economics, data science, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous, complex problems and determine the highest-priority issues.
  • Strong technical fluency, including comfort writing SQL, reading API documentation, testing APIs in tools such as Postman, and troubleshooting data or integration issues.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to translate business requirements into clear technical documentation.
  • Experience independently managing customer relationships and complex implementations.
  • Ability and willingness to travel regularly to customer sites.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with manufacturing procurement processes such as MRP, sourcing, supplier quality, receiving, or three-way matching.
  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, maintaining, or integrating ERP, PLM, or MES systems.
  • Experience working with platforms such as NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, Epicor, Arena, Teamcenter, or similar systems.
  • Coding experience, particularly with TypeScript, GraphQL, or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience within aerospace, defense, space, energy, robotics, or other regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Previous experience within consulting, systems implementation, solutions engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical environment.

Additional Requirements

This position works with ITAR-controlled and CUI data. Candidates must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or otherwise qualify as a “U.S. person” under applicable ITAR regulations.

Visa sponsorship is not currently available for this position.

Benefits

  • Medical/Vision/Dental sponsored at 70%
  • Unlimited PTO
  • 401k with matching
  • Other misc benefits like OneMedical, Kindbody, TalkSpace, etc.
  • Opportunity to work with an elite team of entrepreneurs and engineers

Are you passionate about making a difference and helping others?


Would you like to work in a role that puts the customer at the heart of everything we do, making a genuine positive impact?


Then consider the role of Careers Coach at Reed in Partnership!


This role is office based, but will involve travel across Newcastle/ Northumberland also.

We will be in a position to be able to begin the formal recruitment process in the coming weeks and we will be in touch to discuss the next steps of your expression of interest as soon as possible.


Who we are:

Reed's Employability Division aims to positively transform lives by helping individuals who are unemployed, economically inactive, or facing challenges such as health conditions, disabilities, or caring responsibilities to find sustainable employment. Through a wide range of tailored support services including one-to-one careers guidance, CV writing, interview preparation, and skills training, we have supported over 250,000 people on their journey into work.

Youth Jobs Guarantee is a mandatory programme for 18-21 year olds who have been on Universal Credit for 18 months or more, providing a fully subsidised six month paid job of up to 25 hours per week at minimum wage.


What is this role about?

Youth Jobs Guarantee is a mandatory programme for 18-21 year olds who have been on Universal Credit for 18 months or more, providing a fully subsidised six month paid job of up to 25 hours per week at minimum wage.


A Careers Coach will use a variety of techniques including effective diagnosis, individual and group coaching, and maximising on any participant funding available to prepare them for employment, and access local education or training opportunities. They will also engage with local employers, training providers, and other key partners to source suitable opportunities that align with the participants’ goals.

  • Identifying each participants skills and strengths, and suitable training, placements and volunteering opportunities.

  • Conducting outreach activity such as running events and sessions at community organisations, attending job fair events and other promotional activity.

A generous base salary (pro-rata for part time), and great flexibility with your working schedule, we offer training, development and progression opportunities. You will have access to the range of Reed in Partnership benefits, which include:

  • Willingness to travel locally, and access to own vehicle (e.g. to meet customers/employers).

  • GCSE English Language at a minimum of a Grade B (or equivalent Level 2 qualification).

Desirable Attainments:

  • Degree or relevant qualification. Degree topics may include psychology, sociology, and social care/science. Relevant qualifications would include Information Advice and Guidance NVQs, Brokerage Standard, Social Work qualifications or qualifications relating to work with the specific client groups this role will involve
  • Level 3 or 4 NVQ in Advice & Guidance or Education & Training
  • Fluency in community languages. Community languages may include Cantonese, Mandarin, Hindi, Urdu, Punjabi, Somali, Vietnamese, Dari, Yoruba, Turkish, French, Spanish, Albanian, Arabic, Bengali, Farsi, Guajarati, Polish, Serbian and Greek (Dependent on programme).
  • Technical skills include the ability to use technology to deliver results and knowledge of welfare/benefits system

title: Senior Investigator
description:
Job Description:

Building trusted markets — powered by our people

At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.

We’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.

Location Overview

Cboe HQ is located in the historic Old Post Office district, it’s a landmark that blends classic architecture with modern amenities. The building features expansive spaces with high ceilings and large windows, offering an abundance of natural light and panoramic views of the city skyline and the Chicago River.

With its prime location in the heart of downtown, the OPO Building provides easy access to major transportation hubs, including Union Station and multiple CTA lines, making it convenient for commuters. The building is home to a variety of amenities, including restaurants, a fitness center, and collaborative workspaces, creating a vibrant and dynamic work environment in one of Chicago's most iconic areas.

PLEASE NOTE: To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model.

Our Team:

The Cboe Regulatory Division is responsible for the oversight of the markets for which it has regulatory responsibility and market participants. The Division endeavors to achieve this goal through effective and efficient surveillance, examination, and investigative programs aimed at detecting and disciplining or preventing violative or otherwise inappropriate behavior.

The Division is actively seeking a highly motivated individual to join our options investigations team and perform investigative activities to assist in determinations regarding possible violations of Cboe, Cboe C2, Cboe BZX, and Cboe EDGX Options Exchange (collectively, the “Exchanges”) Rules and other applicable rules and regulations governing Exchange Members and Trading Permit Holders (“TPH”).

Options Investigators in the Division are responsible for conducting focused investigations of trading activities on the Exchanges to detect possible violations of Exchange Rules, By-Laws, and interpretations and policies, and the SEC rules and regulations thereunder, or other improper activities.

Your responsibilities will be

  • Independently manage investigations from inception to conclusion and completing investigation steps in a timely manner that meet expected guidelines
  • Build and maintain a thorough understanding of the Exchanges trading and regulatory environments, as well as the broader securities industry, in areas such as markets, products, relevant rules and regulations, technologies and systems, processes and operational methodologies, and investigative techniques, while contributing to the creation of new investigative processes that address potential regulatory concerns
  • Evaluate and analyze matters to identify potential violations as well as the types of evidence, including data and information, necessary to determine whether the activity in question was violative or otherwise improper via thorough research, collection of evidence and fact-finding
  • Evaluate and analyze evidence to conclude sufficiency with respect to suspected violations through case law and/or precedent to determine whether non-disciplinary or disciplinary actions are warranted. Recommend appropriate disposition to management for review.
  • Prepare investigative reports detailing findings in a clear, cohesive manner supported by factual evidence and analysis. Utilize Division guidelines for style and form; present work that is complete and requires minimal revisions.
  • Assist in taking on-the-record testimonies, as required
  • Present case information to management and Enforcement committees, including formal disciplinary proceedings
  • Professionally interact with internal regulatory staff and external contacts, such as Members, other Self-Regulatory Organizations, and the SEC
  • Collaborate and communicate with cross-functional teams, particularly the Options Surveillance and Enforcement team to enhance or create solutions
  • Actively participate in team projects, discussions and problem solving
  • Actively participate in training/continuing education opportunities and meetings

The ideal candidate has

  • Bachelor's degree required, Economics, Business, Accounting, Finance, or related field preferred.

  • 5 years of Industry experience is required

  • Strong affinity with financial markets

  • Highly self-motivated and driven

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills

  • Exceptional written, analytical, and research skills

  • Strong organizational and planning skills

  • Must be proficient in MS-Office suite, including Excel

  • Experience in a regulatory, compliance, and/or legal environment is preferred

Benefits and Perks of working for Cboe Global Markets

We value the total wellbeing of our people – including health, financial, personal and social wellness. We believe standard benefits like health insurance and fair pay are a given at any organization. Still, you should know we offer:

  • Fair and competitive salary and incentive compensation packages with an upside for overachievement

  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, personal days, sick days and annual community service days

  • Health, dental and vision benefits, including access to telemedicine and mental health services

  • 2:1 401(k) match, up to 8% match immediately upon hire

  • Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Tax Savings Accounts for health, dependent and transportation

  • Employee referral bonus program

  • Volunteer opportunities to help you give back to your communities

Some of our associates’ favorite benefits and perks include:

  • Complimentary lunch, snacks and coffee in any Cboe office

  • Paid Tuition assistance and education opportunities

  • Generous charitable giving company match

  • Paid parental leave and fertility benefits

  • On-site gyms and discounts to other fitness centers

  • Paid Time Off

More About Cboe Global Markets

We’re reimagining the future of the workplace by focusing on what matters most, our people. Our journey is an inclusive one. We’re investing deeply in leadership programs and career development initiatives that ensure everyone has an equal chance to succeed.

We work with purpose, solving problems with ingenuity, collaboration, and a lot of passion. We’re an engaged and excited team connecting markets across borders and embracing growth in all its forms to achieve incredible outcomes.

Learn more about life at Cboe on our website and LinkedIn.

We are committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued and respected.

title: Elektriker til Scandlines
description:
Introduktion

Vil du bruge din el-tekniske faglighed i et maritimt miljø, hvor driftssikkerhed, teknologi og samarbejde går hånd i hånd?

Vi søger en fagligt dygtig og engageret elektriker, der har lyst til at blive en del af vores maritime drift. Hos Scandlines får du en alsidig arbejdsdag med tekniske udfordringer og mulighed for at arbejde med elektriske systemer i en moderne virksomhed, hvor sikkerhed og stabil drift er afgørende.

Jobbeskrivelse

Som elektriker bliver du en vigtig del af den daglige tekniske drift. Du arbejder selvstændigt og sammen med kolleger om vedligeholdelse, fejlfinding og udbedring af fejl på elektriske installationer og anlæg.

Dine primære opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Fejlfinding, reparation og vedligeholdelse af elektriske systemer
  • Arbejde med relæteknik samt AC- og DC-systemer
  • Læsning og anvendelse af eldiagrammer
  • Bidrag til sikker og stabil drift af tekniske installationer
  • Samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af fagområder

Det er krav til stillingen, at du består et 4 dages sikkerhedskursus i Esbjerg.

Faglige kompetencer

Vi forventer, at du har en relevant el-teknisk uddannelse og et solidt fagligt fundament. Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • Har kendskab til relæteknik
  • Har erfaring med fejlfinding på elektriske systemer
  • Kan læse og forstå eldiagrammer
  • Har kendskab til AC- og DC-systemer
  • Gerne har erfaring fra maritime elinstallationer
  • Gerne har grundlæggende viden om IT og netværk
  • Gerne har kendskab til automation samt styring og regulering

Personlige kompetencer

Du arbejder struktureret og kvalitetsbevidst og bevarer overblikket, når der opstår tekniske udfordringer. Du tager ansvar for dine opgaver, følger gældende sikkerhedsprocedurer og trives med både selvstændigt arbejde og tæt samarbejde.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du er løsningsorienteret, nysgerrig på ny teknologi og bidrager positivt til det faglige og kollegiale fællesskab.

Vi tilbyder
Du bliver en del af en moderne og visionær rederivirksomhed med spændende tekniske opgaver og dygtige kolleger. Vi tilbyder en arbejdsplads med fokus på sikkerhed, samarbejde, faglig udvikling og en mere bæredygtig færgedrift.

Ansøgningsfrist

15-10-2026

Yderligere oplysninger

Vil du vide mere om stillingen eller Scandlines, er du velkommen til at kontakte: Mads Korsholm på Mads.Korsholm@scandlines.com.

Besøg os på Facebook, Instagram eller vores hjemmeside for at få indsigt i en virksomhed i rivende udvikling.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og CV via nedenstående link. Vi behandler løbende indkomne ansøgninger og indkalder til samtale. Vi forbeholder os derfor retten til at tage opslaget ned, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Scandlines er et moderne og innovativt rederi med en grøn vision for fremtiden. Vi har en stolt kultur baseret på et stærkt dansk-tysk samarbejde og en maritim historie, som rækker tilbage til 1872.

Scandlines driver to færgeruter med høj kapacitet og frekvens. Seks af vores syv færger er hybridfærger, og to er desuden udstyret med et innovativt rotorsejl – og det bidrager til at gøre vores færger grønnere.

Vores kerneforretning består i at levere en effektiv og pålidelig transportservice til både passagerer og fragtkunder. Fokus i alle vores aktiviteter – uanset om det er om bord på vores færger eller i vores BorderShops – er at give vores kunder en god oplevelse.

Med 37.500 afgange fordelt på syv færger transporterede Scandlines i 2024 tæt på 6,4 millioner passagerer, over 1,6 millioner personbiler og 700.000 fragtenheder på ruterne Rødby-Puttgarden og Gedser-Rostock.

title: CT Technologist (Full Time, Night Shift)
description:
Centered in the heart of Montebello, Adventist Health White Memorial Montebello has a 70-year history of providing quality healthcare to the community. We are comprised of a 192-bed hospital, wound care medical office and surgical and laboratory services. The greater Los Angeles area is known for its art, rich culture, numerous sports teams and world-renowned dining. There is something for everyone in this culturally diverse community.

Job Summary:

Operates computed tomography (CT) equipment, producing cross-sectional images of patients' bones, organs and tissue that are used to diagnose medical conditions. Performs a variety of imaging procedures not limited to CT, including general radiography and fluoroscopy.

Job Requirements:

Education and Work Experience:

  • Associate’s degree in Radiologic Technology: Preferred

Licenses/Certifications:

  • Registered by the American Registry of Radiologic Technologists: R.T. (R)(CT)(ARRT) OR R.T. (R)(ARRT): Required
  • Radiologic Tech (RT) in the state of practice: Required in CA
  • Advanced Certification in the modality of CT: Required in OR and HI, Preferred in CA
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from approved vendor per AH policy: Required
  • Fluoroscopy license in state of employment: Required in CA, if employee operates fluoroscopy equipment
  • Venipuncture certification: Required in CA, if employees performs venipuncture to administer contrast materials

Facility Specific License/Certifications:

  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from approved vendor per AH policy: Required
  • Hospital Fire and Life Safety (HLFS): Required

Essential Functions:

  • Assesses, plans, implements and evaluates care for patients ranging in age from adolescence through geriatric.
  • Produces sagittal and coronal reformatted images for radiologist interpretation.
  • Uses PACS and teleradiology system to correctly transfer images to the appropriate location.
  • Maintains accurate records, files and billing information. Ensures the integrity of patient medical images and data while adhering to Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and other patient confidentiality guidelines and regulations.
  • Performs routine maintenance and calibration of equipment and manages supply inventory.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Adventist Health is committed to the safety and wellbeing of our associates and patients. Therefore, we require that all associates receive all required vaccinations as a condition of employment and annually thereafter, where applicable. Medical and religious exemptions may apply.

title: Senior Mechanical Estimator - Canem
description:
Senior Mechanical Estimator - Canem

As a wholly owned subsidiary of Bird, Canem Systems has been energizing Canada for over 60 years with cutting edge systems, practices and collaborative project management. With several office locations across Canada, Canem Systems is currently looking for a Sr Mechanical Estimator to join its growing team.

The Senior Mechanical Estimator - Canem is responsible for the effective preparation of detailed estimates for commercial, institutional, industrial, transportation, and other major infrastructure projects. This includes responsibility for building effective relationships with clients, suppliers and staff and contributing to marketing the company and its services.

This role can be located in any of our branches across Canada and reports directly to the Estimating Manager.

What You Will Be Working On

  • Establishing and maintaining effective relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, engineers and contractors in the industry; advising clients about new and effective products and services; and actively seeking out new opportunities, projects and clients and estimating and obtaining new projects.
  • Preparing mechanical budgets based on preliminary sketches, specifications, and other related information; preparing accurate cost estimates of resources required for tendered projects; contacting and receiving quotations from suppliers and trades; and preparing spreadsheets with supplier information and quotes.
  • Coordinating and preparing for pre-tender site tours; participating in project site visits as requested; analyzing possible cost savings for projects as requested by project managers.
  • Setting up data for estimates in computer programs; reviewing and confirming estimate information prior to tender closing, including drawings and supplier bill of materials; analyzing disadvantages and strengths of estimates prior to submission; and prepare and evaluating closing strategies.
  • Analyzing tender documents and contractual obligations; preparing and delivering quotation letters to client prior to closing time with relevant management approvals; obtaining feedback and results from client with regards to quotations; contributing to pre-plan meetings.
  • Maintaining and updating databases for estimating, change order and service in relevant computer programs, maintaining and updating historical estimate database.
  • Providing training and support to new and existing staff on estimating practices, change order procedures, and related software.
  • Providing leadership and positive motivation for project staff and company partners by acting as a responsible and goal-oriented team player and leading by example in achieving excellence and being accountable for results and outcomes.
  • Mentoring and developing estimators to strengthen their skills, knowledge, and experience and support their progression toward a Senior Estimator role.
  • Creating and maintaining benchmark estimate values
  • Managing project budgets and updating these as required by the project teams.

What We Are Looking For

  • 10+ years’ experience as a Mechanical Estimator.
  • 10+ years’ hands-on experience with Mechanical construction projects. Experience in Production or Field Operations would be considered an asset.
  • Previous experience as a Senior Estimator; informal or formal leadership experience is considered a strong asset.
  • Undergraduate degree or college diploma in Engineering, Construction Management, or other equivalent construction program or certification in one of the mechanical trades.
  • Eligible for or have attained PQS, CET or P. Eng designation or have obtained a mechanical trade designation.
  • Excellent engineering and technical knowledge of mechanical construction.
  • Excellent knowledge of industry products, practices and standards.
  • Experience with AUTO CAD / REVIT software is an asset.
  • Experience with Autobid or Accubid estimating software is an asset.
  • Current knowledge of mechanical, HVAC or plumbing, building and municipal codes and regulations.
  • Knowledge of engineering software and engineering skills an asset.
  • Ability to learn quickly, be flexible and adaptable.
  • Strong organizational abilities and demonstrated attention to detail.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong time management skills, specifically the ability to multi-task and prioritize.
  • Able to work independently and in team.

For Those Who Seek to Redefine

The greatest achievements in history are borne from the greatness within people – where human potential meets vision, and passion fuels evolution. Unlocking this potential is the most important thing we do at Bird.

As a leader in Canadian construction for over 100 years, the impact of our team is etched deeply within the core of our legacy. Beyond Bird, this impact is felt in the fundamental aspects of our everyday lives. From the critical infrastructure we depend on, to the energy and resources that keep us moving - we are powering our communities and shaping Canada’s skylines coast-to-coast-to-coast. Entrenched in the foundation of a culture built more than a century ago is an enduring quest to reimagine what is possible. Our impact is greater than ever, and we are looking for those who seek to redefine their story.

What We Believe In

We Put Safety First

A healthy and safe work environment is non-negotiable. We build a culture of operational and psychological safety through engagement, learning and leadership.

We Lead With Honesty

We speak and act with integrity, clarity and care so people can trust our word and our work. Being honest means we can deliver the best outcomes and consistent results.

We Are Stronger Together

Success is a team effort. Our inclusive workplace enables our combined expertise, humility and creativity to unlock our greater potential.

We Are Driven To Do Great Work

We built our name on quality. We have a passion for excellence in our work and relationships that honours our businesses and our industry.

We Create Opportunity

Rooted in a solid foundation, we adapt and grow to face the future. We are committed to elevating each other to chart the best path forward in an evolving world.

At Bird, we value Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DE&I) and believe it is essential to our success. We will continue to listen, learn, and take action in our commitment to building progress in our organization, and the industry as a whole. Cultivating an environment where all employees feel included, seen, and have a sense of belonging is core to Bird’s culture. We commit to proactively employing a workforce that reflects the communities in which we work, fostering an environment of continuous learning, and never compromising on our values.
