title: Raskaan kaluston asentajia, mekaanikkoja, hitsaajia ja rengasasentajia – Kotka
description:
Asiakasyrityksemme hakee uusia osaajia kasvavaan toimintaansa Kotkaan.

Etsimme raskaan kaluston asentajia, mekaanikkoja, hitsaajia ja rengasasentajia monipuolisiin huolto-, korjaus-, asennus- ja hitsaustehtäviin.

Jos raskas kalusto, työkoneet ja käytännön tekeminen ovat lähellä sydäntäsi, tässä on mahdollisuus päästä työskentelemään vaihtelevien ja mielenkiintoisten työtehtävien parissa.

Asiakasyrityksemme huoltaa ja korjaa raskasta kalustoa, työkoneita ja erikoiskalustoa. Työtä tehdään pääasiassa Kotkassa sijaitsevalla korjaamolla, mutta tarvittaessa myös kentällä asiakkaiden luona.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään:

Tehtäviin voi kuulua esimerkiksi:

  • Raskaan kaluston huolto- ja korjaustyöt
  • Työkoneiden ja erikoiskaluston huolto ja korjaus
  • Vianhaku ja ongelmatilanteiden ratkaiseminen
  • Hydrauliikkaan liittyvät huolto- ja korjaustyöt
  • Erilaiset hitsaus- ja korjaushitsaustyöt
  • Metallirakenteiden valmistus, korjaus ja muokkaus
  • Rengaspalvelut ja rengasasennukset
  • Kenttähuolto asiakkaiden luona
  • Päivystysluonteiset huolto- ja korjaustehtävät
  • Erilaiset kalustoon liittyvät erikoistyöt ja asennukset

Tehtäviä löytyy siis useammanlaisiin osaamisprofiileihin. Voit olla esimerkiksi raskaan kaluston mekaanikko, asentaja, hitsaaja tai rengasasentaja – tärkeintä on, että sinulla on omaa ammattiosaamista ja kiinnostusta raskaan kaluston parissa työskentelyyn.

Millainen tekijä sopii tehtävään:

Etsimme ennen kaikkea käytännön osaajia, jotka viihtyvät koneiden, kaluston ja korjaustöiden parissa.

Arvostamme:

  • Aikaisempaa kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä
  • Oman alan ammatillista osaamista
  • Teknistä ymmärrystä ja ongelmanratkaisukykyä
  • Reipasta ja oma-aloitteista työotetta
  • Huolellisuutta ja vastuullisuutta
  • Kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että osana työporukkaa
  • Valmiutta vaihteleviin työtehtäviin ja tarvittaessa kenttätyöhön

Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata. Tehtävänkuvaa voidaan rakentaa osaamisesi mukaan. Jos olet esimerkiksi ammattitaitoinen hitsaaja, mutta raskaan kaluston parissa työskentely ei ole vielä tuttua, tämä ei ole este – tärkeintä on hyvä hitsausosaaminen ja kiinnostus oppia uutta.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Monipuolisen työn raskaan kaluston, työkoneiden ja erikoiskaluston parissa
  • Vaihtelevia työpäiviä korjaamolla ja mahdollisuuksien mukaan myös kentällä
  • Mahdollisuuden hyödyntää ja kehittää omaa ammattiosaamistasi
  • Ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön
  • Palkkauksen osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan
  • Mahdollisuuden pidempiaikaiseen työllistymiseen asiakasyrityksessä

Palkkaus:

Palkka määräytyy autoalan kaupan ja korjaamotoiminnan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti ja siihen vaikuttaa osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi. Palkka on arviolta 13,50€/h - 16,40€/h.

title: IT Support Technician
description:
Salary: $65,000 – $79,999 per year

Are you someone who enjoys taking on new challenges, continuously learning, and working for a company that values both personal and professional growth?

We’re Torque IT, a well-established IT services provider based in South Perth, and we’re looking to expand our team as we continue to experience steady growth. With over 50 years of combined experience, we deliver tailored and reliable IT services to businesses across Australia.

Why Work with Us?

At Torque IT, we believe in creating an environment where people can thrive. We focus on collaboration, accountability, and autonomy, encouraging each team member to contribute to shared goals while managing their responsibilities with independence. With clients across a wide range of industries—housing, building management, environment, unions, and accounting—we offer a variety of challenges and opportunities for growth.

Here’s what we offer:

  • Exposure to the latest technologies

  • Continuous training and skill development

  • A supportive, inclusive, and growth-oriented work environment

  • Competitive salary packages, including a phone, laptop, and super

Our Services

As a Premier IT Services Provider, Torque IT delivers a comprehensive range of business IT solutions, including:

1. Business IT Services

  • Help desk and technical support

  • IT infrastructure management (servers, storage, networks, cloud)

  • Cybersecurity services (threat monitoring, MFA implementation, security audits)

  • Cloud services (migration, backups, disaster recovery)

  • Managed IT services (full IT outsourcing, proactive monitoring)

2. Building Networks

  • Design, build, and support for smart building networks (tenant connectivity, security systems, compliance support)

3. Systems Development

  • Custom app development (PowerApps), workflow automation, and system integration

  • Data management and business intelligence solutions

Your Role

As part of our team, you will:

  • Provide support to clients, handling issues related to Microsoft 365, Entra, Windows Servers, Azure, networking, and more

  • Participate in project work, collaborating with our IT engineers and account managers

  • Assist in building custom solutions and managing virtual environments for clients

  • Ensure proactive monitoring of client systems to identify and address potential issues before they become critical

About You

We're looking for someone who is passionate about building a career in IT and takes pride in delivering professional, customer-focused service. You’re a quick learner with strong communication skills, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and a desire to continually develop your technical knowledge.

You’ll ideally have some experience in a Level 1 IT support role, either through work experience or study. You enjoy working both independently and as part of a team, have a solid technical foundation, and are familiar with the Microsoft 365 and Office suite.

To be successful in this role, you'll have:

  • Excellent communication and customer service skills

  • A proactive mindset and strong problem-solving abilities

  • Experience or training in Level 1 IT support

  • The ability to work autonomously while contributing to a team environment

  • A solid technical foundation and willingness to continue learning

  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and the Microsoft Office suite

  • A professional, reliable, and customer-focused approach

Additional Requirements

  • Permanent residency in Australia

  • Ability to provide a police clearance

  • Availability for full-time work Monday to Friday

What We Value

At Torque IT, we foster a respectful, inclusive, and flexible workplace where people are trusted, supported, and empowered to do their best work. We value professionalism, accountability, teamwork, and a commitment to delivering excellent outcomes for our clients.

We're looking for people who are passionate about continuous learning, enjoy helping others grow, and want to contribute to a positive team culture. If you're driven to develop your career while helping our team and business succeed, we'd love to hear from you.

How We’re Evolving

We continue to evolve by integrating system automation and AI to enhance efficiency and scalability. Our solutions are designed to streamline operations, reduce manual intervention, and empower clients to adapt quickly to changes in the IT landscape.

Ready to Take the Next Step?

If you’re ready to grow your career with Torque IT and be part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and personal development, we’d love to hear from you.

Submit your resume and cover letter, detailing why you would be a great fit for this role. Let’s work together to elevate the IT experience for businesses across Australia.

title: AI Change Lead – Enterprise AI Transformation
description:
AI Change Lead – Enterprise AI Transformation

Contract: 9 months

Location: London / Hybrid

Rate: Up to £450 per day – flexible for the right candidate

IR35: Inside IR35

Start: ASAP


We are looking for an experienced AI Change Lead to lead the adoption of AI technologies across a large, complex global organisation.


This is not simply an AI training role. We are looking for someone who has personally led large-scale change or transformation programmes, can influence senior stakeholders and understands how to drive genuine behavioural change and adoption across an enterprise.

The Role


You will be responsible for developing and executing the change strategy around the adoption of AI and Generative AI, helping leaders and employees understand, embrace and embed new AI-enabled ways of working.


Key responsibilities will include:

  • Lead the change management strategy for enterprise-wide AI adoption.
  • Design and deliver AI adoption and fluency programmes for senior leaders, managers and wider employee populations.
  • Coach senior leaders on leading teams through AI-driven changes to ways of working.
  • Build and activate AI champion networks and communities of practice.
  • Develop learning interventions, workshops and engagement programmes to accelerate adoption.
  • Translate complex AI concepts into compelling, accessible communications and narratives.
  • Drive a culture of experimentation, curiosity and responsible AI adoption.
  • Identify and promote successful AI use cases to build engagement and momentum.
  • Establish KPIs, adoption metrics and behavioural indicators to measure the success of change initiatives.
  • Use employee feedback and adoption data to continually refine the change approach.
  • Partner with Technology, Learning, Communications and business teams to embed AI across the organisation.

Essential Experience

We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate:

  • 8+ years' experience in Change Management, Organisational Development or Transformation.
  • Proven delivery of large-scale, enterprise-wide transformation programmes within complex organisations.
  • Strong experience developing and executing change and adoption strategies.
  • Experience influencing and coaching senior/executive stakeholders.
  • Demonstrable experience driving behavioural and cultural change, not simply delivering communications or training.
  • Experience designing and delivering learning programmes, workshops and change interventions.
  • Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills.
  • Experience measuring adoption and demonstrating the impact of transformation programmes.
  • Ability to operate effectively within complex, global and highly matrixed organisations.
  • Strong understanding of Generative AI and tools such as ChatGPT and Microsoft Copilot.

Highly Desirable

  • Previous experience leading AI, digital or technology adoption programmes.
  • Experience implementing GenAI or Copilot across a large enterprise.
  • Experience within pharmaceuticals, life sciences or another highly regulated global organisation.
  • Experience building champion networks or communities of practice to accelerate technology adoption.

title: Director, People
description:
The Position

At WS Development, we pride ourselves on providing a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment where employees are encouraged to contribute to the decisions, planning, process, and culture of the firm. We are a vertically integrated firm, focused on developing, building, owning, and managing beautiful places where people want to be!

We are seeking a seasoned and strategic Director, People, to join our People team. Reporting to the SVP, People, this is a senior HR leadership role for someone who combines deep HR expertise with strong business acumen and a genuine desire to partner closely with our operating groups. As a real estate developer and owner, WS Development relies on its HR Business Partners to be true extensions of the businesses they support and the Director, People will serve as the HRBP to several of our most dynamic teams, including Development, Construction, Investments, Brand & Marketing. This individual will also take on a broader set of strategic responsibilities beyond the traditional HRBP scope, helping to shape and elevate the People function as the company continues to grow.

What You'll Do

As Director, People at WS Development, you will be responsible for:

  • Serving as the primary HR Business Partner to leaders and employees across multiple departments, developing a deep understanding of each business and its people needs.
  • Acting as a trusted advisor and thought partner to senior leaders and executives on organizational design, workforce planning, succession planning, and talent strategy.
  • Leading full life-cycle HR support for your client groups, including performance management, employee relations, compensation planning, promotions, and talent development.
  • Partnering with the SVP, People and the broader People team to design and roll out company-wide programs, policies, and initiatives, and ensuring they are effectively adopted within your client groups.
  • Leveraging AI tools and platforms to streamline HR processes—from talent analytics and reporting to drafting communications and policy documents—modeling for client groups how AI can be used to work smarter and more efficiently.
  • Coaching and developing managers on leadership effectiveness, performance conversations, team dynamics, and change management.
  • Managing complex and sensitive employee relations matters, including leading investigations and ensuring fair, consistent, and legally sound resolutions.
  • Analyzing metrics and trends within your client groups, such as turnover, engagement, and headcount, to proactively identify issues and recommend solutions.
  • Leading or contributing to cross-functional and ad hoc strategic projects that extend beyond the traditional HRBP scope such as process improvements, HR systems and reporting enhancements, culture and engagement initiatives, and special projects for the SVP, People and executive team.
  • Mentoring and providing guidance to other members of the People team and serving as a role model for the level of partnership and judgment expected across the department.
  • Staying ahead of legal and regulatory developments related to employment law and labor relations across our markets and ensuring your client groups remain compliant with all applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.

Requirements

Keys to Success and Position Requirements

A successful candidate will bring with them:

  • Bachelor's degree in human resources, business administration, or a related field with a record of high academic achievement.
  • 8+ years of progressive human resources experience, including significant experience as an HR Business Partner supporting senior leaders and multiple client groups, ideally within real estate, professional services, or another fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to build credibility and trust with senior executives, acting as a strategic partner rather than solely a functional expert.
  • Curiosity and fluency with AI tools, with a genuine interest in adopting new technology to improve HR processes, decision-making, and day-to-day efficiency.
  • Strong knowledge of HR principles, practices, and regulations, with particular depth in employee relations, performance management, organizational design, and compensation.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills, with the executive presence and judgment to navigate sensitive and high-stakes conversations.
  • Proven ability to manage ambiguity and competing priorities across several client groups simultaneously, while still delivering with a high level of rigor and attention to detail.
  • A track record of taking on work beyond the traditional scope of the role. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves on strategic projects, process improvement, and other initiatives as the business needs evolve.
  • Experience managing complex employee relations issues effectively.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Excel.
  • Commitment to integrity, confidentiality, and professionalism in all aspects of People management.
  • Desire (and ability) to laugh and have fun.

The expected salary range for this position is $150,000–$170,000 per year. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as skills, qualifications, experience, and location. This role is also eligible to participate in our annual bonus program.

title: Program Manager, Stroke Program
description:
Centered in the heart of Boyle Heights, Adventist Health White Memorial is one of the area's leading healthcare providers since 1913. We are comprised of a 353-bed hospital, three medical office buildings, residency programs, comprehensive cancer care and a vast scope of services located in the Los Angeles area. In 2019, Adventist Health White Memorial was recognized with the Malcolm Baldrige National Quality Award, the nation's highest presidential honor for performance excellence. We are proud to promote wellness in the community at the local farmers market and through our community resource center with services for seniors and Spanish-speakers. Los Angeles is known for its art, rich culture, numerous sports teams and world-renowned dining. There is something for everyone in this culturally diverse city.

Job Summary:

Oversees Stroke and Neuro-interventional program data collection, abstraction and entry. Manages compliance and accreditation with regulatory agencies. Supervises and directs the activities of various levels of assigned personnel using both professional and supervisory discretion and independent judgment.

Job Requirements:

Education and Work Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in nursing or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Required
  • Master's Degree: Preferred
  • Five years' experience: Preferred
  • One year's leadership experience: Preferred
  • Two years' experience of acute care nursing in hospital setting: Preferred

Licenses/Certifications:

  • Registered Nurse (RN) licensure in the state of practice: Required
  • Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) certification or Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from approved vendor per AH policy: Preferred
  • Nurse Practitioner (NP) licensure in state of practice: Preferred
  • Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) certification from approved vendor per AH policy: Preferred
  • ABNN Certified Neuroscience Registered Nurse(CNRN) certification: Preferred
  • ABNN Stroke Certified Registered Nurse(SCRN) certification: Preferred

Facility Specific License/Certifications:

  • Hospital Fire and Life Safety (HLFS): Required

Essential Functions:

  • Maintains accountability for managing the stroke program. Achieves set standards for stroke clinical patient guidelines and ensures compliance with data submission/regulatory requirements in order to maintain Comprehensive Stroke Certification.
  • Collaborates with the Medical Director(s) and management staff to oversee/lead the stroke program. Implements patient care guidelines with Emergency Medical Services (EMS), Emergency Department, Cath Lab, nursing units and other professional disciplines to ensure high quality outcomes and high patient/family/employee satisfaction.
  • Provides day-to-day technical leadership while performing escalated or complex duties. Uses independent judgment requiring in-depth analysis of variable factors. Collaborates with management and top professionals/specialists in selection of methods, techniques and analytical approach.
  • Provides specialized and advanced nursing knowledge and expertise while functioning as a clinician, educator, researcher and consultant to medical and nursing personnel, patients and families. Maintains responsibility for establishing/maintaining transfer agreements with surrounding hospitals through marketing/outreach activities, including community education. Increases awareness of the program and grows market share.
  • Conducts performance reviews and provides input on direct reports for human resource decisions such as hiring, promotions and disciplinary actions. Participates in the development of employees. Participates in the preparation of the department budget.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Organizational Requirements:

Adventist Health is committed to the safety and wellbeing of our associates and patients. Therefore, we require that all associates receive all required vaccinations as a condition of employment and annually thereafter, where applicable. Medical and religious exemptions may apply.

Adventist Health participates in E-Verify. Visit https://adventisthealth.org/careers/everify/ for more information about E-Verify. By choosing to apply, you acknowledge that you have accessed and read the E-Verify Participation and Right to Work notices and understand the contents therein.

title: Patient Registration Specialist
description:
​


Title: Patient Registration Specialist
Job Category: Triad Complete Healthcare Poteau
Location: Poteau, Ok
Position Type: Full-Time
Compensation: Competitive Wages


Triad Complete Healthcare in Poteau is seeking a courteous, professional, and detail-oriented Patient Registration Specialist to support daily front office operations. This role is essential to patient experience and clinic efficiency. The ideal candidate demonstrates a patient-centered attitude and strong organizational skills. At Triad, you will find a comfortable and supportive work environment — our team members are proud to be part of the Triad family.

Patient Reception & Customer Service

  • Greet and check in patients and visitors in a courteous, professional, and friendly manner.
  • Verify patient information and update demographics as needed while ensuring privacy and confidentiality.
  • Act as a liaison between patients, staff, and physicians, communicating clearly and effectively.
  • Address patient concerns and complaints in a timely, compassionate, and professional manner.
  • Inform patients of delays or changes to appointments as needed.

Phone & Appointment Management

  • Answer incoming phone calls, direct inquiries appropriately, and provide accurate information regarding clinic policies and services.
  • Schedule, reschedule, confirm, and remind patients of appointments according to clinic protocols.
  • Coordinate with healthcare providers to manage appointment availability and patient flow efficiently.

Patient Intake & Information Management

  • Perform all patient intake functions, collecting and processing forms including insurance information, medical history, and consent documents.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records in the Electronic Health Record (EHR) system.
  • Prepare patient charts and ensure all required documentation is available for providers.

Insurance & Authorization Responsibilities

  • Scan insurance cards, verify eligibility, validate benefits, and ensure accurate documentation for each visit.
  • Identify insurance coverage issues and communicate appropriately with patients, providers, and staff.
  • Perform prior authorizations with payers in a timely manner and notify physicians and team members of delays or non-coverage.

Administrative & Financial Duties

  • Accurately collect co-pays, deductibles, and other payments.
  • Account for daily cash and payment entries, perform daily balancing, and prepare deposits.
  • Assist with billing inquiries and posted transactions.
  • Process incoming and outgoing mail, faxes, and other communications.

Clinic Coordination & Organization

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and professional front desk and waiting room area.
  • Prioritize work assignments and utilize time between patients to review forms and data for accuracy and completeness.
  • Coordinate with medical staff and management to ensure smooth clinic operations and timely patient visits.

Qualifications

  • High School diploma or equivalent required
  • Previous experience in a medical office, clinic, or general office environment preferred.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.
  • Basic knowledge of medical terminology and insurance processes preferred.
  • Ability to understand insurance benefits and perform basic mathematical tasks.
  • Proficient in basic computer skills and office equipment (phones, fax, copier).
  • Ability to type at least 40 WPM.
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and critical-thinking abilities.
  • Ability to follow verbal and written instructions accurately.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems; Athena experience is a plus.
  • Knowledge of insurance verification, prior authorizations, and billing practices.
  • Compassionate and empathetic approach when working with patients and families.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bilingual (Spanish/English) is a plus.

title: MOA Administrative & Staff Assistant
description:
Why Work at BYU

At Brigham Young University (BYU), your work is an opportunity to contribute to a distinctive educational mission rooted in the gospel of Jesus Christ and to make a meaningful difference in the lives of students.


As the flagship university of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, BYU strives to be among the exceptional universities in the world. We are devoted to our faith, our students, and the University's Mission: "To assist individuals in their quest for perfection and eternal life."


We seek staff members who enthusiastically embrace and advance this unique mission. Across the university, staff bring their expertise and talents to work that helps students learn, grow, and thrive. A culture of covenant belonging, weekly devotionals, meaningful opportunities for learning and growth, and a beautiful and historic campus make BYU a distinctive and inspiring place to build a career.


Belonging Statement

United by our common primary identity as children of God, BYU values and embraces the variety of individual characteristics, life experiences and circumstances, perspectives, talents, and gifts across the BYU community. This richness strengthens our shared efforts to create and support an environment of covenant belonging centered in Jesus Christ.


Employment Requirements

Members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints are required to hold and be worthy to hold a current temple recommend to be hired and to remain in any position at BYU.


In hiring decisions, Brigham Young University lawfully gives strong preference to qualified, faithful members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. All employees are required to abide by the university's Honor Code and Dress & Grooming Standards. Successful candidates are expected to support and contribute to the academic and religious missions of the university, which are aligned with the principles and doctrine of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.


Equal Opportunity

Brigham Young University is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability or protected veteran status.


MOA Administrative & Staff Assistant

This role serves as a key administrative partner to the Museum Director and staff, overseeing daily office operations, scheduling, records, purchasing, communications, and support for museum activities. The position also coordinates museum facilities and events while building positive relationships with university departments, staff, visitors, donors, and guests. Strong organization, communication, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities are essential.


What you’ll do in this position:


Executive, Administrative & Office Support

  • Provides executive administrative support to the Museum Director, Assistant Director, curators, and museum staff, including correspondence, scheduling, communications, and special projects.
  • Develops and implements effective administrative office policies, procedures, and processes.
  • Hires, trains, schedules, and supervises part-time student administrative assistants.
  • Manages museum purchases, Workday expense reports, and assists staff with Workday and business/guest travel processes.
  • Coordinates travel arrangements, meetings, agendas, minutes, and the Museum’s administrative calendar.
  • Manages museum mailings, contact databases, administrative files, records, and archival materials in accordance with university policies.
  • Serves as the Department Records Retention Manager and oversees the organization and preservation of digital and physical records.
  • Responds to administrative inquiries, welcomes visitors, and directs questions to the appropriate museum or university personnel.
  • Maintains the professional appearance and organization of the administrative office, including office equipment, supplies, and staff break room.

Museum Scheduling & Event Planning

  • Coordinates the use of museum facilities with university departments and other approved groups for classes, lectures, performances, meetings, and other activities.
  • Plans, organizes, and executes museum, staff, donor, and special events, including exhibition openings, retreats, field trips, and annual department events.
  • Coordinates event logistics, including scheduling, facilities, catering, supplies, communications, and other arrangements with museum and university personnel.

Administrative Relations & Professional Representation

  • Provides courteous, responsive, and professional service to museum staff, university personnel, patrons, donors, guests, and community members.
  • Facilitates administrative questions and concerns while promoting effective communication and collaboration across the Museum and University.

What qualifies you for this role:

Required:

  • A firm commitment to the mission of BYU
  • Minimum of two years of office, administrative, or related professional experience.
  • Strong administrative and organizational skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Knowledge of general office practices and procedures.
  • Ability to train and supervise student employees.
  • Ability to manage calendars, appointments, events, and complex scheduling needs.
  • Ability to prioritize and organize workload effectively.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain appropriate confidentiality.
  • Ability to interact professionally and effectively with administrators, faculty, staff, students, donors, guests, and members of the public.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with museum staff and university departments.

Preferred:

  • Knowledge of database and contact-management systems.
  • Familiarity with museum operations, policies, and procedures.
  • Experience with event planning and coordination.
  • Experience with records retention, records management, or archival practices.
  • Familiarity with Workday or similar financial and administrative systems.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, art history, museum studies, or a related field.
  • Previous museum, university, arts administration, or similar professional experience.

What we offer in return:

This position comes with fantastic benefits, including:

  • 401k. BYU automatically contributes 8% at no cost to you. Additionally, if you contribute 5%, BYU adds an additional 4% (Rehires may qualify for different retirement plans)
  • Generous vacation and sick time, plus 13 paid holidays
  • Employee assistance program, available to the employee and all members of their household
  • Tuition benefits for employees and eligible family members
  • Access to athletic facilities
  • Excellent medical/dental benefits
  • Short/long term disability benefits
  • Paid parental and maternity leave
  • Wellness program
  • Free on-campus parking
  • Free UTA passes for employee, spouse, and qualified dependents
  • Discounts at the BYU Store and for many events at BYU

$20.75 to $27.00 /hourly

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Nieuwe klanten, nieuwe projecten en steeds meer mogelijkheden om organisaties te helpen met slimme HR- en payrolloplossingen. Mooi! Dit vraagt ook om meer structuur, focus en voorspelbaarheid. Daarom zoeken wij een Delivery Manager Iemand die ervoor zorgt dat onze operatie schaalbaar wordt, projecten succesvol verlopen en collega's optimaal kunnen presteren. Het verder vorm- en uitvoering geven aan onze Customer Onboarding Journey.

Je wordt onderdeel van het MT en bent een belangrijke sparringpartner van de Business Unit Directeur. Je brengt rust, overzicht en richting. Niet door processen belangrijker te maken dan mensen, maar door samen een organisatie neer te zetten waarin kwaliteit, eigenaarschap en klanttevredenheid hand in hand gaan.

Je krijgt de kans om een belangrijke veranderopgave te leiden We zoeken namelijk iemand die niet denkt in beperkingen, maar in mogelijkheden. Iemand die niet vraagt waarom iets niet kan, maar die samen met het team bepaalt hoe we het wél gaan organiseren.

  • Het begeleiden van klanten en fungeren als hun gids gedurende implementatie-, onboarding- en optimalisatietrajecten;
  • Het creëren van rust, overzicht en voorspelbaarheid binnen klantprojecten;
  • Het functioneel aansturen van consultants en het bewaken van voortgang, kwaliteit en capaciteit;
  • Het signaleren van risico's, knelpunten en afhankelijkheden en hier proactief op acteren;
  • Het bewaken van projectbudgetten, planningen en klantafspraken;
  • Het verder ontwikkelen en standaardiseren van onze implementatie- en onboardingsaanpak;
  • Het verbinden van collega's, teams en klanten om gezamenlijk tot de beste resultaten te komen;
  • Het creëren van één manier van werken die schaalbaarheid, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid ondersteunt;
  • Het nemen van eigenaarschap en verantwoordelijkheid wanneer projecten of klanttrajecten extra aandacht vragen;

Je bent een fijne collega (vind je zelf) & dat hoor je ook van anderen. Jij bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor klanten én collega's. Je brengt structuur in complexe trajecten, houdt overzicht wanneer er meerdere zaken tegelijk spelen en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor resultaat. Je wacht niet af tot problemen ontstaan, maar bent degene die vooruitkijkt, richting geeft en mensen bijeenbrengt. Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • HBO of WO werk- en denkniveau;
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Projectmanager, Delivery Manager, Customer Success Manager, Projectmanager of vergelijkbare rol binnen een dienstverlenende omgeving;
  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van klanttrajecten en implementatieprojecten;
  • Ervaring met het bewaken van budgetten, voortgang, capaciteit en klanttevredenheid;
  • Het vermogen om verschillende belangen samen te brengen en mensen in beweging te krijgen;
  • Sterke organisatorische, communicatieve en analytische vaardigheden;
  • Ervaring met procesverbetering, standaardisatie en het creëren van meer voorspelbaarheid binnen organisaties;
  • Ervaring binnen IT-, software-, HR-tech- of consultancyorganisaties is een sterke pré.

Werken bij Axians betekent onderdeel zijn van één van de grootste ICT-organisaties, met het voordeel van een klein en autonoom team. Je werkt samen met betrokken collega’s in Hoorn, in een team waar ieder zichzelf kan zijn. Hoorn is soms je uitvalsbasis voor meetings en overleg, maar het grootste deel van de tijd ben je actief op locaties door heel Nederland. Onze opdrachtgevers zijn namelijk verspreid over het hele land, wat zorgt voor veel afwisseling in je werkdag. En daarnaast kun je ook nog eens je thuiswerkplek inrichten. Als Axians zijn we een van de grootste ICT-kennispartners van Nederland. Met onze expertise in HR- en salarissoftware (HRM Suite 365) helpen wij onze klanten hun HR- en salarisprocessen te verbeteren. Wij staan dicht bij de klant en ondersteunen hen bij hun digitale transformatie. Bij ons werken mensen die “The Best of ICT with a Human Touch” combineren.

  • Een salaris tussen €5300 – €6300 o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband;
  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsregeling;
  • Een aantrekkelijke bonusregeling;
  • Een sleutelpositie binnen een groeiende en ambitieuze business unit;
  • De mogelijkheid om daadwerkelijk impact te maken op onze dienstverlening, teams en klantbeleving;
  • Een rol binnen het Management Team met veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief;
  • 28 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen;
  • Flexibele werktijden en hybride werken;
  • Naast een goed salaris en bonusregeling ontvang je een thuiswerkvergoeding, pensioenbijdrage, hebben we een leaseregeling voor een nieuwe fiets en kun je deelnemen aan een aandelenprogramma;
  • Volop ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling via onze Academy, opleidingen en trainingen;

title: Rengasasentaja (Sesonki)
description:
RENGASASENTAJA (SESONKITYÖ)

Etsimme reippaita ja motivoituneita rengasasentajia syksyn renkaanvaihtosesonkiin. Työ on nopeatempoista ja fyysistä, joten hyvä kunto ja reipas asenne ovat tärkeässä roolissa.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu renkaiden vaihto, asennus ja tasapainotus sekä renkaiden kunnon tarkistaminen ja arviointi. Lisäksi tehtävään kuuluu asiakaspalvelua ja työpisteen järjestyksestä huolehtimista, ja tarvittaessa avustat myös muissa korjaamon työtehtävissä osaamisesi mukaan.

title: Head of School (Biomedical & Life Sciences)
company: LONDON SCHOOL OF BUSINESS & FINANCE PTE. LTD.
description:
Head of School (Biomedical & Life Sciences)

Shape the Future of Biomedical and Life Sciences Education

LSBF is seeking a visionary and industry-connected leader to guide the strategic growth of our School of Biomedical & Life Sciences.

This is more than an academic leadership role. We are looking for someone who can bridge academia, healthcare, research, and industry to ensure our programmes remain relevant, future-focused, and connected to real-world opportunities.

Whether you come from higher education, healthcare, biomedical research, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, or the life sciences sector, we are looking for someone passionate about developing the next generation of biomedical and healthcare professionals.

About the Role

Reporting to the Director of Studies, you will provide academic and strategic leadership for LSBF's Biomedical & Life Sciences portfolio.

You will oversee programme quality, curriculum development, faculty leadership, industry engagement, and academic governance while helping to strengthen LSBF's reputation within the biomedical, healthcare, and life sciences community.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable operating across academic, industry, and professional environments, acting as an ambassador for the School while fostering meaningful partnerships that benefit students and graduates.

Key Responsibilities

Academic Leadership & Governance

  • Lead the academic quality and strategic direction of the School.
  • Ensure programmes remain current, industry-relevant, and aligned with emerging developments in healthcare and life sciences.
  • Participate in Academic Boards, Examination Boards, programme reviews, and quality assurance activities.
  • Work closely with university partners and regulatory bodies to maintain academic standards and compliance.
  • Support programme validation, accreditation, and enhancement initiatives.

Industry & Professional Engagement

  • Develop strategic partnerships with healthcare institutions, laboratories, biotechnology companies, pharmaceutical organisations, and professional bodies.
  • Position LSBF as an active contributor within the biomedical and life sciences ecosystem.
  • Represent LSBF at industry forums, conferences, academic events, and professional networks.
  • Facilitate guest lectures, employer engagement activities, and industry projects.
  • Create opportunities for student internships, experiential learning, and professional exposure.

School Growth & Innovation

  • Contribute to the growth and development of the School.
  • Identify emerging trends and opportunities within biomedical sciences, biotechnology, healthcare innovation, digital health, and related disciplines.
  • Recommend new programmes, specialisations, professional certifications, and industry collaborations.
  • Support student recruitment initiatives through outreach activities, talks, webinars, and industry engagement.

Faculty Leadership & Student Success

  • Lead, mentor, and develop academic staff.
  • Foster a culture of academic excellence and innovation.
  • Support student progression, engagement, and achievement.
  • Drive initiatives that enhance graduate employability and learning outcomes.

Laboratories & Learning Resources

  • Provide oversight of laboratory-based learning environments and resources.
  • Support planning and enhancement of laboratory facilities and equipment.
  • Ensure compliance with health, safety, and operational requirements.

Teaching (Preferred)

Candidates who can contribute to teaching within one or more of the following areas will be viewed favourably:

  • Biomedical Science
  • Molecular Biology
  • Genetics
  • Human Physiology
  • Biotechnology
  • Microbiology
  • Immunology
  • Clinical Research
  • Public Health
  • Bioinformatics
  • Healthcare Innovation
  • Research Methods

What We Are Looking For

Industry Leaders

Applications are welcome from experienced professionals including:

  • Biomedical Science Leaders
  • Biotechnology Managers
  • Clinical Research Leaders
  • Healthcare Innovation Professionals
  • Pharmaceutical Industry Professionals
  • Laboratory Directors
  • Research Scientists
  • Regulatory Affairs Specialists
  • Healthcare Technology Leaders

Academic Leaders

Applications are also welcomed from:

  • Heads of School
  • Programme Leaders
  • Associate Deans
  • Professors
  • Senior Lecturers
  • Academic Managers

Qualifications

  • Master's degree required.
  • Doctorate (PhD) preferred.
  • Qualification in Biomedical Science, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Bioinformatics, Public Health, or a related discipline.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management experience.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Understanding of academic governance, quality assurance, and higher education regulations is advantageous.

Why Join LSBF?

This is an opportunity to shape the future direction of Biomedical & Life Sciences education at LSBF.

You will have the platform to:

  • Influence programme strategy and innovation.
  • Build meaningful industry and healthcare partnerships.
  • Raise LSBF's profile within the biomedical and life sciences sectors.
  • Develop future-ready graduates for healthcare and scientific industries.
  • Contribute to the growth of a modern and industry-connected School.

What excites us most is not whether you come from industry or academia, but whether you can help build the School's reputation, grow industry partnerships, inspire students, and ensure our programmes remain relevant in a rapidly evolving healthcare and life sciences landscape.

title: Granlund: Sähkösuunnittelija
description:
Työsopimuksen tyyppi: vakituinen

Sijainti: Lemminkäisenkatu 48, 20520 Turku

Hakuaika päättyy: 7.10.2026

Oletko sähkösuunnittelija, joka haluaa kehittää osaamistaan monipuolisten hankkeiden parissa? Granlund hakee nyt tiimiinsä sähkösuunnittelijaa kokoaikaiseen ja vakituiseen rooliin Turkuun!

Mitä tulet tekemään?

Sähkösuunnittelijana työskentelet osana Granlundin Turun tiivistä ja osaavaa sähkösuunnittelutiimiä monipuolisten rakennushankkeiden parissa. Roolissa pääset mukaan projektien koko elinkaareen, aina hankesuunnittelusta toteutukseen. Työpöydälläsi on samanaikaisesti useampia projekteja, ja kohteet ovat vaihtelevia. Viime aikoina tiimi on työskennellyt muun muassa toimitilojen, koulujen, päiväkotien, hoitolaitosten, datakeskusten, pysäköintilaitosten ja asuinrakennusten parissa. Projektit painottuvat uudiskohteisiin, mutta mukana on myös saneeraushankkeita.

Vastaat sähkösuunnittelusta osana projektiryhmää ja työskentelet tehtävissäsi myös itsenäisesti vastuuta ottaen. Suunnittelutyön lisäksi teet yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, laitevalmistajien, urakoitsijoiden ja työmaahenkilöstön kanssa sekä osallistut kohdekäynneille ja työmaakokouksiin. Kohteet sijaitsevat pääasiassa Turun seudulla, mutta satunnaisesti projekteja voi olla myös muualla Suomessa.

Granlundilla pääset kehittämään osaamistasi monipuolisesti vaihtelevien hankkeiden parissa. Projektityöskentelyn lisäksi voit osallistua Granlundin sisäiseen kehittämiseen ja vaikuttaa oman työnkuvasi sekä urapolkusi suuntaan. Millaista osaajaa etsimme?

Saatat olla urasi alkupuolella tai jo kokeneempi osaaja: sinulla on kuitenkin jo osaamista sähkösuunnittelusta ja ymmärrystä projektien eri vaiheista. Toivomme sinulta oma-aloitteista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työskentelyotetta sekä valmiutta ottaa vastuuta omasta tekemisestäsi. Vaikka työskentelet itsenäisesti, ympärilläsi on hyvähenkinen ja osaava tiimi, jossa asioita ratkotaan yhdessä.

Hakijalta odotamme:

  • Soveltuvaa teknistä korkeakoulututkintoa, esimerkiksi sähköinsinöörin tai diplomi-insinöörin tutkintoa

  • Aiempaa relevanttia suunnittelukokemusta, mielellään vähintään 2–3 vuoden ajalta, sekä kokemusta työskentelystä projektien eri vaiheissa

  • Alan suunnitteluohjelmistojen tuntemusta: Granlundilla käytössä on MagiCAD ja Revit

  • Oma-aloitteista ja itsenäistä työskentelytyyliä sekä hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja suomeksi

Lisäksi katsomme eduksi:

  • Englannin ja ruotsin kielen taito

Mitä Granlund tarjoaa sinulle?

  • Mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa ja vaativissakin hankkeissa, joissa pääset kehittämään sähkösuunnittelun osaamistasi laaja-alaisesti.

  • Kattavan perehdytyksen sekä hyvät kasvu- ja kehitysmahdollisuudet: Granlundilla jokaisen työntekijän ammatilliseen kasvuun ja kehitykseen panostetaan ja pääsetkin laajentamaan osaamistasi mm. monipuolisen koulutustarjonnan, vaihtelevien työtehtävien ja kollegoidesi asiantuntemuksen avulla.

  • Osaavan ja hyvähenkisen sähköryhmän tuen: voit kysyä neuvoa ja ratkaista haastavia tilanteita yhdessä kollegoidesi kanssa.

  • Kilpailukykyiset henkilöstöedut, kuten liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun, henkilöstön virkistysmatkoja sekä kattavan työterveyshuollon. Voit tutustua Granlundin kattaviin etuihin tarkemmin täällä.

  • Kokemukseesi ja osaamiseesi pohjautuvan kuukausipalkan sekä tulospalkkiojärjestelmän.

Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, ja työllistyt suoraan Granlundin palvelukseen. Tarkempi aloituspäivämäärä on sovittavissa tilanteesi mukaan. Granlundilla töitä tehdään joustavasti toimistolla ja etänä. Työpisteesi sijaitsee Turussa, ja toivomme, että olet valmis työskentelemään säännöllisesti toimistolla sekä vierailemaan kohteissa.

Rekrytointiprosessi:

  • Etähaastattelut aTalentin kanssa

  • Haastattelut paikan päällä Granlundin kanssa

Kiinnostuitko? Hienoa!

Lähetä ansioluettelosi sekä motivaatiokirjeesi PDF-muodossa viimeistään 7.10. aTalentin hakujärjestelmän kautta osoitteessa:

https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/385105/create/

Huomioithan, että käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuajalla niiden tulojärjestyksessä. Emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse, vaan käsittelemme ainoastaan hakujärjestelmän kautta saapuneet hakemukset. Haluamme varmistaa, että kaikki hakijat voivat osallistua prosessiin tasavertaisesti ja huomioimme tarvittaessa yksilölliset esteettömyystarpeet.

title: SAP Center of Excellence (COE) Account to Report – Controlling Functional Consultant  (Specialist level)
description:
SAP Controlling Specialist is a permanent member of the COE A2R team, responsible for designing, building, and supporting planning models, management reporting frameworks, within S4HANA Margin Analysis and SAP Analytics Cloud. The role ensures seamless integration between SAC and SAP S/4 HANA Controlling (CO), enabling real-time financial insights across cost centers, internal orders, projects, profitability analysis, and internal management reporting.


The role sits at the intersection of management accounting, data analytics, and SAP technology -- requiring both a strong understanding of CO business processes and deep technical proficiency in SAC modelling, story design, Margin Analysis, Overhead Management, and integrated planning. The ideal candidate combines hands-on SAC implementation experience with a solid grounding in SAP Controlling (CO-CCA, CO-PA, CO-PC, EC-PCA), Margin Analysis (CO-MA), and Overhead Management (CO-OM), plus the ability to translate complex business reporting requirements into user-friendly SAC analytical solutions. Experience with Project Systems (CO-PS) is a valuable asset.


1. Run Operations & Expert Support


• Provide L3 functional support for SAP S/4HANA Product Costing covering material cost estimates, cost component splits, standard and moving average price management, and inventory valuation

• Deliver L3 support for SAC analytics, Margin Analysis, and Overhead Management implementations covering SAC story design, data model optimization, S4/HANA Margin Analysis (CO-MA) profitability analytics, and S4/HANA Overhead Management (CO-OM) cost allocation design

• Resolve complex issues related to cost rollups, price differences, settlement/variance postings, SAC data refresh logic, and integration between PP, MM, CO, FI and analytics layers

• Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for costing, Margin Analysis, Overhead Management, and inventory valuation

2. Problem Management & Root Cause Analysis

• Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring and critical issues in Product Costing, Margin Analysis, Overhead Management, and SAC

• Identify configuration gaps, process weaknesses, data defects, and analytical logic issues; drive permanent fixes through controlled change

3. Change & Enhancement Support, under the governance of ITS COE A2R

• Analyze business change requests related to cost management, margin analysis models, overhead allocation structures, and SAC analytics content

• Design and implement configuration changes, Functional/Technical Specifications, and Testing & UAT support

• Ensure compliance with ESPHORA Template, internal controls, and audit requirements

4. Reconciliation & Control

• Ensure reconciliation between Inventory valuation, Material Ledger, and FI General Ledger

• Validate data flow in Margin Analysis, Overhead Management, and SAC reporting layers

• Support financial controls, audit queries, compliance reviews, and management/legal reporting.


Requirements for the role:


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Management or a related field.
  • Working time: CET time zone
  • 6–8 years hands-on configuration and support in Product Costing (CO-PC), Margin Analysis (CO-MA), Overhead Management (CO-OM), and Cost Centre Accounting (CO-CCA)4–6 years hands-on experience in Product Costing and all other CO modules
  • 3–5 years hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) data models, stories, and embedded analytics for financial reporting
  • Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end Account-to-Report (A2R) processes, integrating Controlling modules with SAC analytics delivery
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with high attention to detail
  • Effective communication skills for interacting with business stakeholders and technical teams
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, tickets, and priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience documenting data policies, functional specifications, and technical specifications
  • Product knowledge:
    • SAP Products: SAP S/4HANA (Controlling, Margin Analysis, Overhead Management), SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) -- data modelling, story design, analytical content, SAP Datasphere (semantic layer, data integration)SAP Solution Manager, SAP Fiori & UI5, SAP CPI / PI-PO.

At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company, making a massive difference one cup at a time.

It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing. At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are more than just a coffee company. We are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company that makes a difference one cup at a time.

At Dutch Bros, our culture is unmatched. We’re a fun, tight-knit crew that supports each other and creates connections you won’t find anywhere else. Ready to make a massive difference together?!

$11.00 per hour base pay + an average of $5.50 per hour in tips

title: Senior Product Manager (Roadmap) - Star Trek Fleet Command
description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Star Trek™ Fleet Command team in Dublin on a hybrid basis.

Star Trek Fleet Command's ongoing success goes from strength to strength. Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top grossing Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

As the Senior Product Manager, you will be the product owner for key monetisation and engagement initiatives across the live game. This includes driving the roadmap and execution of our monthly content releases, ensuring they are cohesive, compelling, and highly performant. You will work cross-functionally with Game Design, Product Marketing, Product Ops, Economy Design, and Data Science teams to define, prioritise, and deliver exceptional player experiences that meet business and player goals.

  • Own the content and performance strategy for our monthly releases, aligning them to player motivations, economic balance, and business KPIs
  • Define and manage the monthly content calendar, collaborating with Design, Production, and Engineering to deliver high-quality, on-time experiences
  • Use data and experimentation to optimise monetisation, engagement, and retention across a broad player lifecycle—from new users to end-game whales
  • Deeply understand player behaviour across multiple geos and platforms to ensure we deliver value through personalisation and segmentation strategies
  • Work closely with the economy and systems design teams to ensure content aligns with long-term progression goals and avoids inflation
  • Partner with UX, Research, and Community teams to develop empathy for player sentiment and pain points, and translate them into actionable product improvements
  • Build business cases for major new initiatives and content verticals, including competitive research and revenue forecasting
  • Mentor junior PMs and contribute to a culture of product excellence and cross-functional collaboration.

At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. Cboe HQ is located in the historic Old Post Office district, it’s a landmark that blends classic architecture with modern amenities. The ability to:

  • Organize and express ideas clearly and understandably when speaking to individuals or groups; listen to others and respond appropriately.
  • Create well-written, organized presentation materials, correspondence and other documentation.
  • Organize and prioritize work assignments; complete multiple tasks timely, with accuracy and quality; adjust to changes in priorities and situations; readily accept new assignments, processes or technology as part of the job.

We work with purpose, solving problems with ingenuity, collaboration, and a lot of passion. We’re an engaged and excited team connecting markets across borders and embracing growth in all its forms to achieve incredible outcomes.

title: Research Scientist - AI Safety
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

As a Research Scientist - AI Safety at Faculty, you will conduct original technical research in AI safety to build the foundation for safe, trustworthy AI deployment. Operating at the forefront of AI, you will design and execute impactful experiments, study model behaviour, and develop robust, reproducible tooling. Working alongside Senior and Lead Research Scientists, you will bridge scientific discovery with practical application, helping translate complex technical insights for external partners, frontier labs, and national security institutes. This is an incredible opportunity to hone your expertise, shape emerging safety standards, and solve some of the most critical challenges in modern AI.

What you'll be doing:

  • Executing technical research in AI safety by designing and running experiments to study and steer model behaviour.

  • Applying white-box and black-box methodologies, focusing on interpretability, steering, and behavioural studies of transformer-based LLMs.

  • Developing high-quality, modular, and reproducible research code in Python using deep learning frameworks like PyTorch.

  • Building and maintaining research infrastructure and technical tooling to accelerate scientific discovery.

  • Documenting and communicating experimental findings through high-quality academic papers, technical reports, and presentations.

  • Collaborating with senior scientists to identify literature gaps, refine hypotheses, and identify research scope.

  • Translating complex technical insights for diverse audiences, including external frontier labs, government bodies, and safety institutes.

Who we're looking for:

  • Solid background in machine learning fundamentals and transformer architectures (specifically LLMs).

  • A practical understanding of white-box and black-box interpretability techniques, such as steering vectors or mechanistic interpretability.

  • Demonstrated capability to take structured technical problems and formulate hypotheses

  • Strong programming skills in Python and deep learning frameworks like PyTorch, with a track record of writing clean, modular research code, using Git for version control.

  • Excellent communication, enabling you to translate complex technical concepts and experimental results into clear reports and presentations.

  • Curiosity and analytical rigour, combined with exposure to core AI safety areas such as robustness, evaluations, or uncertainty calibration.

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Maintenance and Reliability Engineering Supervisor
description:
Position Summary

The Maintenance and Reliability Engineering Supervisor is the first-line leader for maintenance coworkers at the Cresco manufacturing facility and a hands-on technical resource for production resources. Reporting to the North America Maintenance & Facilities Manager, this position directs daily maintenance execution, develops the maintenance team, leads complex troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and equipment reliability improvements. Additional responsibilities include automation and equipment installation.

This is a site-focused, player-coach role. The position executes Cresco maintenance priorities within the strategies, standards, budgets, and capital plans established by the North America Maintenance & Facilities Manager and works closely with Operations, Engineering, EHS, Quality, and Supply Chain to support safe, reliable, and efficient manufacturing.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities

  • Direct the day-to-day work of Cresco maintenance technicians and skilled trades, including work assignment, prioritization, shift coverage, and coordination of planned and emergency maintenance activities.
  • Coach, train, and develop maintenance coworkers; set clear expectations; provide ongoing feedback; complete performance reviews; and address attendance, conduct, and performance matters in partnership with Human Resources and the North America Maintenance & Facilities Manager.
  • Lead maintenance work with a safety-first approach and ensure compliance with lockout/tagout, electrical safety, machine guarding, confined-space, hot-work, environmental, and other applicable company and regulatory requirements.
  • Serve as the senior hands-on technical resource for complex mechanical, electrical, PLC/control, hydraulic, pneumatic, and automated equipment issues, coordinating breakdown response and supporting repairs when required.
  • Execute preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance plans; monitor schedule and PM compliance; manage the site maintenance backlog; and escalate resource, equipment, or production risks promptly.
  • Drive consistent use of the computerized maintenance management system (CMMS), including complete work orders, accurate equipment history, failure codes, labor and parts information, and reliable maintenance data.
  • Track and use maintenance and reliability measures such as downtime, PM compliance, schedule attainment, backlog, mean time between failures, mean time to repair, and recurring failure trends to improve performance.
  • Lead structured root cause analysis for significant or recurring equipment failures, assign corrective actions, and verify that solutions are completed and sustained.
  • Partner with Production, Engineering, EHS, and Quality to eliminate chronic equipment losses, improve reliability and overall equipment effectiveness, and support Lean, TPM, and other continuous improvement activities.
  • Support assigned capital projects, equipment installations, commissioning, start-up, and process changes by providing technical input, coordinating maintenance resources, and ensuring maintenance documentation and training are completed.
  • Assist as backup in day-to-day contractor and service-vendor activity and help maintain appropriate spare-parts availability within approved plans, purchasing processes, and spending authority.
  • Support the selection and onboarding of maintenance coworkers and help build technical depth, cross-training, and succession capability within the Cresco maintenance team.
  • Communicate equipment condition, maintenance performance, resource needs, and emerging risks to the North America Maintenance & Facilities Manager and plant leadership.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Reliability Engineering; Engineering Technology; or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and progressively responsible industrial maintenance experience.
  • At least five years of progressive industrial maintenance or reliability experience in a manufacturing environment, including direct leadership of skilled maintenance coworkers, team leads, or comparable formal responsibility for daily work execution.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach coworkers, assign and follow up on work, manage performance, and build accountability in a skilled-trades environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, PLC/control, and automated manufacturing systems, with the ability to lead complex troubleshooting and repairs.
  • Experience supporting equipment installation, commissioning, capital improvements, contractors, and external technical service providers.
  • Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance, 6S, Kaizen, or other structured continuous improvement methods is preferred.

Skills and Competencies

  • Hands-on technical credibility combined with sound judgment about when to troubleshoot directly, coach others, or escalate an issue.
  • Strong frontline leadership, coaching, communication, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to organize competing priorities, distinguish emergency work from planned work, and maintain disciplined follow-through in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to use maintenance data to identify trends, establish priorities, and measure results.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with hourly coworkers, technical specialists, production leaders, and senior management.
  • Working proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and computerized maintenance management systems.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements

  • Frequent presence in a manufacturing environment with exposure to machinery, moving equipment, noise, vibration, dust, heat, lubricants, industrial chemicals, and varying temperatures, with required personal protective equipment provided.
  • Regular standing and walking throughout production, warehouse, and maintenance areas, with frequent bending, stooping, kneeling, reaching, and climbing stairs, ladders, or elevated platforms as needed to inspect and access equipment.
  • Ability to use tools and handle parts and components, read schematics and technical documents, and occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds, with mechanical or team assistance used for heavier loads.
  • Flexibility to work outside normal business hours, including evenings, weekends, and emergency situations, and to participate in on-call coverage as required to support Cresco manufacturing operations.

title: Senior Project Manager - Overland Park, Kansas
description:
About Us:
DeSimone is a leading global structural engineering firm known for delivering innovative, high-performance design solutions across the built environment. Our team of engineers, designers, and technical experts collaborates on a diverse portfolio—from iconic high-rise buildings to complex, large-scale structures—shaping skylines and communities around the world. With offices across the U.S. and internationally, we partner closely with clients to bring bold ideas to life with precision, creativity, and technical excellence.

Why DeSimone?
At DeSimone Consulting Engineering, you’ll work alongside some of the world’s most brilliant engineering minds on projects that redefine skylines and push the boundaries of design and innovation. From iconic skyscrapers to cutting-edge structures, our global portfolio reflects a commitment to excellence and creativity.

We are a team that values growth, collaboration, and real impact—you won’t just be part of the work, you’ll help shape it. With strong mentorship, hands-on experience, and opportunities to advance, you’ll build a career as impressive as the projects you’re working on.

We offer a flexible, collaborative work environment along with a comprehensive benefits package—including medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, and 401K —designed to support your well-being and long-term success.

At DeSimone, your contributions matter. You’ll be trusted with meaningful work, empowered to grow, and supported every step of the way.

Ready to build what’s next? Join us.

About the Role:

The Senior Project Manager (SPM) oversees the entire structural design process from inception to completion. The SPM applies engineering standards and leverages industry-specific software to manage design and documentation tasks. With expertise in structural engineering concepts and building codes, the Senior PM supervises project work, coordinates with clients, architects, and other team members and provides creative solutions within the project framework. Additionally, they handle cost and personnel estimation, proposal preparation, while contributing to project staffing discussions.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead structural engineering projects from concept through construction, ensuring technical excellence, quality, budget compliance, and on-time delivery.
  • Oversee the design and analysis of structural systems using industry-standard software, including STAAD.Pro, RAM, ABAQUS, and AutoCAD.
  • Supervise and mentor engineers, BIM technicians, and project team members, providing technical guidance, training, and quality oversight throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Manage the preparation and review of structural calculations, construction documents, specifications, shop drawings, and technical reports.
  • Coordinate structural designs with clients, architects, contractors, municipal agencies, and multidisciplinary project teams to achieve project objectives.
  • Review RFIs, contractor submittals, and construction documents, providing practical solutions and ensuring alignment with design intent.
  • Monitor project schedules, staffing needs, resource allocation, and project budgets while proactively addressing challenges and maintaining project momentum.
  • Develop creative engineering solutions, identify critical project risks, and lead teams through complex technical problem-solving efforts.
  • Prepare fee proposals, participate in contract and scope reviews, and contribute to project budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, support business development initiatives, and help generate new opportunities through networking, industry involvement, presentations, and thought leadership.
  • Lead project meetings, presentations, and stakeholder discussions while ensuring clear communication and accountability among all parties.
  • Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, professional development, and continuous improvement across project teams and the broader organization.

What We're Looking For:

  • Bachelor's degree in Structural Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related field with 12+ years of relevant experience in structural analysis, building design, and project management; or a Master's degree with 10+ years of related experience.
  • Minimum of 9 years of experience performing and supervising structural engineering design and analysis projects.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license required.
  • Extensive experience using structural engineering software including STAAD.Pro, RAM, ABAQUS, and AutoCAD.
  • Strong background in structural steel design, with experience in concrete, masonry, wood, and light-gauge steel structures.
  • Demonstrated success managing engineering projects, including staffing, budgeting, scheduling, resource planning, and client coordination.
  • Deep knowledge of local and national building codes, industry standards, and structural engineering best practices.
  • Experience preparing and managing construction document packages, including plans, details, schedules, specifications, and related deliverables.
  • Strong understanding of construction administration processes, contractor coordination, shop drawing review, RFI responses, and submittal review.
  • Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop engineering teams while fostering a collaborative and high-performing work environment.
  • Exceptional analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities, with a demonstrated capacity to develop practical and innovative engineering solutions.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong business acumen with experience supporting proposals, project financial management, client development, and business growth initiatives.
  • Self-motivated leader who demonstrates professionalism, accountability, sound judgment, and a commitment to technical excellence.
  • Master's degree in Structural Engineering preferred.
  • Structural Engineer (SE) license preferred.

Minimum (Required) Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Structural or Civil Engineering or related field; and twelve (12) years relevant work experience in structural analysis and building design with an emphasis on structural steel buildings, including project management; ; or
