title: Erfaren Projekteringsleder til NCC Infrastructure
description:
Vil du have ansvaret for projekteringen på store anlægsprojekter og være den, der binder rådgivere, myndigheder og udførelse sammen fra tilbud til aflevering? Hos NCC Infrastructure får du en central rolle med både fagligt ansvar, stor kontaktflade og projekter med reel tyngde.

Før det kan bygges, skal det hænge sammen

NCC Infrastructure løser anlægs- og forsyningsopgaver for både offentlige og private kunder. Det kan være fjernvarme, klimasikring, byggemodning, vandværker, renseanlæg eller andre tekniske anlæg.

Divisionen er i vækst og går efter større og mere komplekse projekter. Samtidig fylder totalentrepriser mere, og det stiller højere krav til den del af arbejdet, der foregår, før maskinerne rykker ud.

Derfor søger NCC en erfaren projekteringsleder til Project Management Office i NCC Infrastructure.

“Der kommer flere spændende og komplekse projekter ind, hvor du får lov til at tage ansvar for projekteringen fra start, samle trådene og være med til at sætte retningen for, hvordan vi gør det bedst”
- Susannah Keller Tidemann, leder for projekteringsteamet

Du tager styringen fra tilbud til aflevering

Som projekteringsleder får du ansvar for projekteringen på egne projekter og tilbud. Du skal ikke selv tegne løsningerne. Du skal styre processen, udfordre rådgiverne og sikre, at projekteringen hænger sammen med kontrakten, økonomien og den måde, projektet faktisk skal bygges på. Du ser med andre ord løsningerne med projektets briller: Kan de bygges, og hvad betyder de for tid, økonomi, risiko og udførelse?

I praksis betyder det, at du:

  • styrer projekteringen på større og komplekse anlægsprojekter
  • koordinerer rådgivere på tværs af fx vej, bro, geoteknik, afvanding og forsyning
  • følger op på tidsplan, kvalitet, økonomi, risici og muligheder
  • driver dialogen med bygherre og myndigheder om beslutninger, tilladelser og godkendelser
  • sikrer, at de projekterede løsninger er i overensstemmelse med NCC’s projektmæssige rammer og kan omsættes til en effektiv udførelse
  • bidrager til at udvikle projekteringsledelsen på tværs af PMO

Du bliver en del af projekteringsteamet i PMO, som er en tværgående funktion, der understøtter projekterne med specialistviden og projekteringsledelse. Du har altså dit faglige tilhørsforhold i PMO, men bliver koblet tæt på de projekter, du arbejder med og bliver en del af projektorganisationen omkring dem. Dit udgangspunkt bliver NCC’s kontor i Søborg med løbende møder ude på projekterne og hos eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

title: Lead, Coding Quality
description:
About Us:


Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. Enabling our teams with leading technology allows analytics to guide our solutions and keeps us accountable achieving goals.


We build long-term careers by investing in YOU. We seek to create an environment that cultivates your professional development and personal growth, as we believe your success is our success.

JOB SUMMARY:

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Note: The essential duties and responsibilities below are intended to describe the general duties and responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. This position may perform all or most of the primary duties listed below. Specific tasks, responsibilities or competencies may be documented in the Team Member’s performance objectives as outlined by the Team Member’s immediate Leadership Team Member.

The Lead Coding Quality Specialist is responsible for directing the day-to-day work of a small team of coding quality specialists (auditors) who provide internal hospital and physician (provider) auditing. The Lead must have the ability to accurately audit and code (ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, HCPCS, Level I & II modifiers) all of the following service types: facility inpatient, emergency room, outpatient surgery, observation, ancillary, recurring therapy, clinic, professional, and billing/coding edit resolution. The Lead will work with multiple facility-specific and state billing and coding guidelines, as well as various Medicare Administrative Contractors nationwide, and will collaborate with the Coding Department on coding audits and training.


Duties:

  • Lead a team of coding quality specialists, to include assigning tasks, ensuring deadlines are met, and mentoring and training staff on quality and compliance
  • Ensure compliance with departmental standards and coding practices
  • Ensure team members are working efficiently and meeting performance expectations
  • Conduct regular code reviews to assess quality, compliance, and risk
  • Identify coding issues and recommend corrective actions
  • Communicate audit findings to staff and management
  • Maintain detailed records of audits and outcomes
  • Align conduct with AHIMA's Standards of Ethical Coding and the Company's Code of Ethics and Business Conduct and support the Company's Ethics and Compliance Program
  • Comply with all internal policies and procedures
  • Actively participate in Company provided training and education
  • Ensure individual compliance with all privacy and security rules and regulations and commit to the protection of all Company confidential information, including but not limited to, Personal Health Information
  • Required to audit the work of the on their aligned team
  • Required to audit and code as part of individual responsibility

Qualifications:

  • Must have 3+ years of production coding experience. This should include hospital and/or physician practice, inpatient coding experience in addition to prior auditing experience
  • Must have one of the following Coding Certifications: Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC); Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)
  • Must be certified through either the AAPC (CPC or COC) or AHIMA (CCS or CCS-P)
  • Must have an understanding of healthcare billing practices and compliant claims preparation for both governmental and commercial payers
  • Regular, predictable, and punctual attendance is required
  • Must have working knowledge and experience with systems such as EMR, Billing, etc.
  • Must have a phone, reliable internet connection and current coding materials such as CPT and ICD-10-CM coding references
  • Will be required to maintain an ongoing productivity level and accuracy rate of 95% or higher
  • Will be required to maintain a quality score of 95% or higher
  • Must be proficient in Microsoft programs like Excel and Outlook. Examples include:
  • Excel: should be able to open and add to a spreadsheet, perform basic formulas like adding or multiplying
  • Outlook: should be able to manage emails and schedule and attend meetings
  • Ability to communicate effectively and professionally both verbally and in writing
  • Ability to coordinate, analyze, observe, make decisions, and meet deadlines
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and direct the work of others
  • May be required to perform other duties as assigned by Leadership Team Member

Physical Demands:

Note: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions as described.


Regular eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity is required to operate office equipment. The ability to perform work at a computer terminal for 6-8 hours a day and function in an environment with constant interruptions is required. At times, Team Members are subject to sitting for prolonged periods. Team Member may experience elevated levels of stress during periods of increased activity and with work entailing multiple deadlines.

Regular eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity is required to operate office equipment. The ability to perform work at a computer terminal for 6-8 hours a day and function in an environment with constant interruptions is required. title: At Your Service Center Associate, Culver City Center - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

title: Machine Builder III-IV
description:
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Safety:
    • Follows established safety protocols and procedures; provides continuous improvement ideas for safety
    • Wears Personal Protective Equipment and properly uses other safety equipment when required
    • Corrects safety discrepancies and reports any machine or plant safety concerns to the Production Lead
    • Ensures that work areas remain well organized and free of clutter

  • Quality:
    • Meets established quality standards and follows quality procedures; provides continuous improvement ideas for quality
    • Corrects quality discrepancies and reports any quality concerns to the Production Lead

    • Trains other employees by following Delkor training system
  • Daily Responsibilities:
    • Proficient in the assembly process of machines including formers and closers
    • Navigates SolidWorks models and drawings to determines problem(s) and clarify the build process.
    • Performs the assembly process of loaders and special machines
    • Completes a Production Concerns request when discrepancies are discovered.
    • Completes an Engineering Change Request (ECR) for machine continuous improvement ideas
    • Assembles machines per the build book and other documented requirements
    • Has general knowledge of third-party equipment and is able to integrate with Delkor equipment.
    • Returns stock parts on machine build/machine checkout properly
    • Assists with disassembling, crating, and shipment of machines.
    • Understands parts shortages and priorities and communicates shortages as appropriate
  • Performs other tasks or duties as assigned.

Education and Experience

  • Two-year Automated Packaging degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of five years of experience as a packaging machinery assembler.
  • Experience in using various types of pneumatic and electrical tools, grinders, band saw, sanders, lifting and moving devices, saws and drills including an assortment of hand tools.

Technical Skills and Competencies

  • Possess required computer skills to navigate through Web Client, Composer, Navision, and Outlook.
  • Use Solid works to review drawings and determine any assembly issues with fit, form or function.
  • Assist with basic mechanical troubleshooting during the build process.
  • Must have basic knowledge and understanding of electrical, pneumatic schematics.
  • Understand, practice, and promote the 5S guidelines.
  • Ability to read, understand, and analyze machine drawings.
  • Improve skills and competency by progressing through the skills matrix.
  • Able to adapt to a fast-paced environment.

Interpersonal Communication

  • Communicates clearly and effectively (verbally and/or non-verbally) to individuals and groups, internally and externally, to exchange ideas and convey detailed information accurately.
  • Works well with a variety of people and personalities, and with other Delkor departments.
  • Works collaboratively, as a team member, to suggest ideas and resolve issues in a positive manner.

Work Ethic

  • Self-motivated and able to work independently and accurately with minimal supervision.
  • Able to maintain a positive workplace environment, even when encountering challenging situations.
  • Able to work on and troubleshoot unique custom designed equipment including third party equipment.
  • Able to problem solve and take direction regarding routine activities and problem resolution.

Physical Requirements

  • Stand and walk for a majority of the day.
  • Speak and hear to give and receive detailed information through verbal communication in person or using the telephone; exchange ideas and convey detailed information accurately to co-workers, managers, vendors and others inside and outside the company.
  • Apply physical mobility (reaching, bending, climbing, crawling, kneeling, arm and leg extension) to perform all assembly production activities.
  • Possess extensive arm and hand mobility and strength to lift, hold, reach, carry, push and pull parts. Also able to move parts, tools, equipment and materials in and out of vehicles.
  • Lift 40 pounds regularly; occasionally lift up to 75 pounds with assistance.
  • See and judge distances and space relationships to successfully complete detailed activities to find tolerances, including reading written plans and other documents.

Work Environment

  • Ninety percent (90%) of the job duties are performed on the assembly floor with exposure to tools, dirt, dust, chemicals, metals and plastics, varying temperatures, construction noises and odors from production processes.
  • Ten percent (10%) of the work is performed in an office setting, carrying out detailed work sitting at a desk and working on the computer, or working at an office table.

Tools and Equipment

  • Operate all types of tools typically used on an assembly floor; be familiar with different rigging techniques.
  • Use general office equipment such as computer, printer, telephone, copiers, e-mail, and other such equipment.

Pay Range

  • The hourly salary range for this position is $­­­­­­­­­28.00 - $36.00 per hour. At Delkor, we are committed to ensuring that each employee’s compensation reflects their experience, performance, and skills relevant to their current role. This salary range accounts for various factors considered in the hiring process, including but not limited to education, skills, work experience, and certifications. As a result, the final salary offer for the selected candidate(s) may fall anywhere within this range.
  • Machine Builder level IV is eligible for a sign on bonus of $12,000.
  • In addition to base salary, Delkor provides a comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to support your overall well-being. Our benefits include health, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k)-retirement plan, paid time off, life and disability insurance, and a variety of additional voluntary benefits.

title: Fire Protection Systems Engineer

description:
Role Summary

Responsible for the safe, reliable and compliant operation, maintenance, testing and continuous improvement of fire protection and life safety systems within a semiconductor manufacturing facility. The role supports the protection of personnel, facilities, critical manufacturing equipment, cleanrooms and hazardous material storage areas, while ensuring system readiness for 24/7operations.

Key Responsibilities

Fire Protection Systems

  • Operate, maintain and monitor site-wide fire protection and life safety systems, including fire detection and alarm, suppression, sprinkler, hydrant, fire pump, gas detection and related emergency systems.
  • Ensure system availability, reliability and readiness to support continuous manufacturing operations.

Maintenance & Reliability

  • Develop and implement preventive and corrective maintenance programmes.
  • Troubleshoot system faults, alarms and equipment failures, and coordinate repairs with contractors and vendors.
  • Monitor maintenance performance and ensure timely closure of corrective actions.

Inspection, Testing & Compliance

  • Plan and conduct inspections, testing and functional checks of fire protection systems.
  • Ensure systems and activities comply with applicable regulatory requirements, recognized fire protection standards, corporate engineering standards and EHS requirements.
  • Maintain appropriate records and support regulatory, authority and insurance inspections or audits.

Emergency Response

  • Support emergency response activities involving fire andhazardous material incidents.
  • Participate in emergency drills, evacuation exercises and response preparedness activities.
  • Develop and maintain relevant emergency response procedures and coordinate with relevant emergency services when required.

Projects & Continuous Improvement

  • Support fire protection engineering projects from design review through installation, testing and commissioning.
  • Review relevant engineering drawings, specifications and technical proposals.
  • Identify opportunities to improve system reliability, reduce false alarms and minimize operational disruptions.
  • Support evaluation and implementation of new technologies and system enhancements.

Documentation & Performance Management

  • Maintain key fire protection system documentation, including system records, inspection and maintenance records, asset information and compliance documentation.
  • Monitor and report key performance indicators relating to system availability, alarms, maintenance and compliance.

Key Requirement

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering or a relevant Science discipline, such as Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering or Occupational Health & Safety.
  • Relevant experience in fire protection, life safety systems, facilities engineering, EHS or related engineering functions.
  • Experience in semiconductor, electronics manufacturing, chemically intensive manufacturing or other industrial environments is preferred.
  • Knowledge of applicable fire protection standards, regulatory requirements and EHS practices.
  • Relevant professional or industry certifications, such as WSHO, SFSM or other recognized fire protection, safety or engineering qualifications, will be an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions and with diverse teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrates adaptability, resilience, continuous learning and a commitment to safety and operational excellence.
  • Willingness to travel for training or business requirements, including overseas training where required.

Others

  • Where relevant to the job role and scope of responsibilities, the jobholder may be appointed to statutory or regulatory roles (e.g. Fire Safety Manager, WSH Officer, Energy Manager, Water Efficiency Manager, Environmental Control Officer, Licensed Electrical Worker, or Radiation Protection Officer). Such appointments form part of the core role and applicable job grade, with no separate appointment allowance.
  • The jobholder is responsible for maintaining all required certifications and CPD, reporting any lapse immediately, and discharging applicable statutory duties independently with direct reporting to the occupier on statutory compliance matters.

title: Facilities Maintenance Specialist II
description:
SUMMARY

Facilities Maintenance Specialist II performs a variety of semi-skilled and skilled tasks in all aspects of facility maintenance for all campus buildings and performs the related duties as assigned. At this level, incumbents perform the full range of tasks common to the classification series under less supervision while exercising discretion and independent judgment within established guidelines.

Coordinates with other facility technicians in the performance duties and knowledge of minor carpentry, electrical/motors, plumbing/pumps and HVAC systems including chillers and boilers with routine preventive/corrective maintenance functions and projects. Has experience with computers and software usages.

This is a day-to-day on-site position, with no remote site capabilities.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Performs various maintenance functions and capable repairs in carpentry, plumbing, heating and air conditioning, minor painting, and minor electrical repair. Completes assigned work orders and submits a daily task repair list of completed items utilizing the current software.

Inspects air conditioning and heating systems to ensure efficient operation; diagnoses electrical and mechanical malfunctions and makes necessary repairs including pumps, motors, belts and pulleys. Including minor preventive duties of lubrication and replacement of belts and air filters.

Provides carpentry work associated with all campus buildings including residential life complexes in minor repairs of; drywall, plaster, roofing, doors, ceiling grid/tile and floor surfaces; repairing windows, store front trim, minor painting, staining building fixtures. Installation and assembly of furniture and appliances.

Troubleshoots and repairs plumbing systems water fountains, toilets, faucets, showers and drains in campus facilities; replaces plumbing pipes, flush valves and maintains sanitary sewer lines and systems.

Performs minor electrical and low voltage repairs, including lighting, light fixtures, minor control modules, VFD’s, relays and contactors.

Monitors campus software for control systems of HVAC/Key logs including site inspections assigned for equipment monitoring makes the necessary decisions in equipment settings for thermostats, building valves for proper cooling and heating. Maintains the associated records as needed.

For work that cannot be performed in-house assists in contacting, scheduling and coordinating contracted maintenance services, such as HVAC, plumbing and electrical work. May include contracted roofers, door & glass installers and other unique contractor repairs. Has oversight for their work and monitoring the project till completion, verifying work invoices.

Assists in campus events setup, including bleachers, chairs, tables and staging as needed or as stand in for any event maintenance needs. This may include commencements, holidays or other scheduled weekend events. (Example working Fourth of July)

This position requires and is expected to be on-call, working overtime, weekends, evenings, and holidays to accommodate the campus needs, it may require being a shift that is rotational with other like positions. In addition, responding if called for campus emergencies including snow and ice events.

Must have consistent and regular attendance for position requirements.

DIRECT SKILLS & ABILITIES NEEDED

The use of related hand and power tools. Including Carpentry, HVAC, Electrical and Plumbing.

Skills in the refrigeration field. This should include installations, diagnosing and repair of small appliances up to industrial equipment. Have experience and knowledge in hydronics and other applications of heating and chiller systems. This includes installation, trouble shooting and repair of gas fired furnaces, low-pressure steam boilers, chillers, pumping systems and air handling equipment.

Skills in electrical trade include diagnosing of industrial equipment, fixtures and controls. Utilizing the proper tools and safety methods. Be able to read designed schematics and install electrical fixtures and equipment involved in various construction projects.

Have a working understanding of DDC automated controls, pneumatic controls and other control systems. Should have a general knowledge of computers operations (prefer Microsoft Word and Excel).

Work independently in the absence of direct supervision.

Understand and carry out oral and written instructions.

Communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.

Maintain physical condition appropriate to the performance of assigned duties and responsibilities including mental capacity, which allows the capability of making sound decisions and demonstrating intellectual capabilities.

.Capability in establishing and maintaining positive cooperative working relationships with those contacted in the course of work.

QUALIFICATIONS To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Capabilities in the reading of building plans and blueprints, electrical schematics, and piping system diagrams.

Past hands-on experience record reflecting corresponding work in the related field.

PRIOR EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE. Higher Educational Degree or recognized trade school is preferred; high school graduate or GED required. A minimum of four years verified experience in general or trades related maintenance or certification from a recognized trade school and two years of acceptable experience or any journeyman certificate considered.

LANGUAGE SKILLS. Ability to read/speak English preferred, understand and interpret procedure manuals, work orders, equipment operating instructions, blueprints, specifications and general correspondence (ie: memos, letters, etc.). Ability to effectively communicate orally with staff, students, administration and visitors. Ability to read and accurately complete maintenance requests, time sheets, supply requests, etc.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS. Ability to calculate figures and amounts or proportions in square footage. Ability to apply concepts of basic math for basic calculations.

REASONING ABILITY. Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS. Requires a minimum Type 2 Refrigerant Transition and Recovery Certification. Universal Certificate preferred. Must be able to take associated testing for acceptable certification for HVAC within six months of start date. Must have valid Driver’s License and ability to meet the University’s insurance requirements for driving university vehicles.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; use hands to finger, handle or feel including the use of a computer keyboard; reach with hands and arms; work on their feet for several hours at a time; and bend, stoop, climb ladder/stairs. The employee is frequently required to lift and/or move up to 65 lbs., may require working overhead, using a ladder or scaffolding. The employee is occasionally required to work at certain heights and be able to climb extension ladders and work while balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, or moving within confined areas including equipment, crawl and attic spaces; and talk or hear including the use of a telephone and 2-way radio. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT. The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Typically, the employee works indoors, in classroom, business office and athletic facility environments with a moderate noise level. Frequently the employee is required to work in the maintenance shop or mechanical rooms with loud power equipment. Occasionally the employee will be required to work outside the building during inclement weather for construction, repair and maintenance functions

title: AI Engineer, Product
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
WELLTOWER – REIMAGINE REAL ESTATE WITH US

At Welltower, we’re transforming how the world thinks about senior living and wellness-focused real estate. As a global leader in residential wellness and healthcare infrastructure, we create vibrant, purpose-driven communities where housing, healthcare, and hospitality converge. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and endlessly ambitious—guided by our mantra: The only easy day was yesterday.

We’re looking for bold, independent thinkers who thrive on challenge, embrace complexity, and are driven to deliver long-term value. Every team member is empowered to think like an owner, innovate fearlessly, and lead from where they stand. If you're passionate about outcomes and inspired by the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare infrastructure, we want you on our best-in-class team.

SUMMARY

Welltower is a global leader in wellness-focused and healthcare real estate. We move fast, think like owners, and build for long-term value. This is a hands-on AI engineering role for someone who wants to build from the ground up inside a company with real scale behind it.

The AI Engineer, Product builds the product surface that brings AI capability to the people across the business who rely on it. You own agent-driven tools and interfaces end to end, work directly with users on real data, and iterate fast against live feedback. The emphasis is on the product and the agent behavior behind it, not the front end alone.

  • Build and ship the product surface: the agent-driven tools, interfaces, and workflow tooling that teams use to do their work and make decisions
  • Design, tune, and evaluate how agents behave in the product so the output is trustworthy enough for users to act on
  • Work embedded with users, translating how they actually work into working software on real data
  • Get to a live, useful output fast, then iterate against direct feedback
  • Build configurable, reusable surfaces rather than one-off rewrites so each build accelerates the next
  • Work off a live demo on real data as the spec rather than a lengthy requirements document

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 6+ years shipping production software, with the depth to own a product surface end to end
  • Have deployed an agent in a commercial production environment
  • Experience building data-dense, decision-support, or analytics products where users act on the output
  • Ability to build fast against messy, real data and iterate in front of users
  • Based in the NYC metro area and able to work on-site

COMPENSATION

Salaries may vary by location. The base salary range for this role in New York is $160,000 to $220,000. In addition to base pay, this role is eligible for a total rewards package that includes an annual bonus opportunity, equity awards through our long-term incentive program, and a comprehensive benefits suite.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, drug screening, and verification of employment, education, and other credentials relevant to the position.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive Base Salary + Annual Bonus
  • Generous Paid Time Off and Holidays
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program – purchase shares at a 15% discount
  • Employer-matching 401(k) Program + Profit Sharing Program
  • Student Debt Program – we’ll contribute up to $10,000 towards your student loans!
  • Tuition Assistance Program
  • Comprehensive and progressive Medical/Dental/Vision options
  • Professional Growth
  • And much more!

ABOUT WELLTOWER

Welltower® Inc. (NYSE: WELL) an S&P 500 company, is the world's preeminent residential wellness and healthcare infrastructure company. Our portfolio of 2,500+ Seniors and Wellness Housing communities is positioned at the intersection of housing, healthcare, and hospitality, creating vibrant communities for mature renters and older adults in the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada.

Our real estate portfolio is unmatched, located in highly attractive micro-markets with stunning built environments. Yet, we are an unusual real estate organization as we view ourselves as a product company in a real estate wrapper driven by relationships and unconventional culture.

Through our disciplined approach to capital allocation powered by our data science platform and superior operating results driven by the Welltower Business System, we aspire to deliver long-term compounding of per share growth and returns for our existing investors – our North Star.

Welltower is committed to leveraging the talent of a diverse workforce to create great opportunities for our business and our people. EOE/AA. Minority/Female/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/Disability/Vet

title: Sr Hazardous Building Materials Specialist

· Experience working on projects for federal agencies such as the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Department of Defense (DoD), Air Force, Navy, Department of Energy (DOE), Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), or other federal clients.

· Demonstrated experience working with multidisciplinary technical teams and subcontractors.

· Experience preparing and managing cost proposals, project budgets, schedules, work plans, and technical deliverables.

· Knowledge of environmental investigation, remediation, compliance, and restoration projects.

· Ability to obtain and maintain access to federal facilities and project sites.

· Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Other Characteristics

· Experience working in a team-oriented environment with client, project, and staff management expertise.

· Strong strategic planning and management skills, with effective communication abilities.

· Willingness to work well independently and as a member of a team.

· Commitment to high-quality outcomes, maintaining standards, and attention to detail.

· Comfortable in a dynamic environment, with excellent time management skills and the ability to thrive under stress.

· Proficient in communicating effectively with all levels of the organization.

· Basic understanding of financial management principles and business acumen.

· Strong leadership and team management skills.

· Strong commitment to safety, quality, and client satisfaction.

· Effective verbal and written communication with clients, regulators, subcontractors, and project teams.

· Excellent project planning, organization, and time management abilities.

· Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, and Project.

Preferred

· Bachelor's degree in Geology, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Biology, Chemistry or another closely related scientific or engineering discipline.

· Professional Geologist (PG), Professional Engineer (PE), Project Management Professional (PMP), or other relevant professional certification.

· OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER certification and current refresher training.

· Experience working on projects under CERCLA, RCRA, NEPA, TSCA, Clean Water Act, and other federal environmental programs.

· Experience supporting proposal development and capture activities.

Supervisory Responsibilities

· This position will have supervisory responsibilities.

DOT Covered/Safety-Sensitive Role Requirements

· This position is not subject to federal requirements regarding Department of Transportation “safety-sensitive” functions.

Necessary Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Employees must always maintain a constant state of mental alertness. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The employee must be able to perform typical office and project management duties, including sitting, standing, walking, using a computer, participating in meetings, and communicating by phone, email, and in person. The position may require occasional travel to project sites, where the employee may walk on uneven terrain, climb stairs, access active work areas, and wear required personal protective equipment. The employee may occasionally lift or carry lightweight project materials, files, or equipment, typically up to 50 pounds.

Work Environment

The work environmental characteristics described here are representative of those that must be borne by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the role. Employees must always maintain a constant state of situational awareness. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work is performed in both office and field environments. The HBMS Specialist may be required to visit active project sites to observe field activities, attend client or subcontractor meetings, monitor project progress, and support coordination with project teams. Field visits may include exposure to outdoor weather conditions, construction equipment, uneven terrain, and active work areas. Personal protective equipment may be required when visiting project sites.

Physical Setting:

· Typically, office or home office environment with occasional field visits. This is a remote position depending on proximity to a BSNC office. Travel will be required to project locations for performance of inspections, site visits, etc.

· Fieldwork involves a variety of environments, including correctional facilities, military installations, abandoned buildings, and other industrial/commercial settings.

Schedule and Flexibility:

This is a salaried position based on a 40-hour workweek. The employee may receive additional compensation for extended field projects or assignments that involve long workdays, provided such work is approved in advance by a supervisor. Occasional travel will be required throughout the United States for fieldwork. Most assignments will last less than one week, though longer travel periods may occasionally be necessary.

As a condition of employment, you will be required to pass a pre-employment drug screening and have acceptable background check results. If applicable to the contract, you must also obtain and maintain the appropriate clearance levels required and must also be able to obtain access to military installations.

BSNC gives hiring, promotion, training, and retention preference to BSNC shareholders, shareholder descendants and shareholder spouses who meet the minimum qualifications for the job.

title: Data Coach
description:
Lead Coach — Data Skills Bootcamp, London (Level 4)

London-based, ~40% in-office· Starts October 2026 ·Level 4 data analytics (iO-Sphere programme)

Level 4 is analytics with real rigour, and you can teach it because you've lived it — past the basics, in a job where the analysis had to hold up. As lead coach you own a London cohort of 45 learners: you're in the room, you set the pace, and when someone's quietly slipping in week six, you're the one who catches it before it's a week-fourteen problem.

You'll lead delivery of our Level 4 Skills Bootcamp in data analytics — iO-Sphere's own curriculum, assessed against our own criteria — in person in London around 40% of the time, with a team of support coaches alongside you. You hold the standard for the whole cohort.

About iO-Sphere

We train people to do things with data and AI, not just learn about them. Learners work on real problems — including in Prism, a simulated business we built on 500 million rows of real data. 900+ people have trained with us, we're rated 4.8 on Google, and we're one of the UK's fastest-growing data and AI training startups. Teams at PwC, BAE Systems, Dunelm, Motorway and CBRE send us their people.

We're a startup, so how we coach isn't finished — and we'd want you helping build it. The people who improve how we do this are the ones deepest in it.

What you'll do

  • Lead live in-person sessions in London (our office is in E1, by Liverpool Street) — around 40% of the time, roughly two days a week
  • Own the pace and progression of the full 45-learner cohort — direct the support coaches, keep sight of where every learner stands, and step in yourself when it matters
  • Run onboarding (suitability) conversations with new joiners and offboarding/exit interviews, and provide information, advice and guidance (IAG) throughout
  • Put learners' additional learning support (ALS) plans into practice and teach inclusively, so everyone can access the material whatever their starting point
  • Mark Level 4 submissions against our own assessment criteria using our AI-assisted flow in iO Academy: review the draft, make the final judgement, write feedback specific enough to act on
  • Be the point of quality for the cohort — spot risk early, work with Delivery and Quality, keep the bar high
  • Run and document interventions when a learner needs support, and keep it all logged and up to date in Aptem — ALS plans, interventions, contact and progress — to the standard a regulated, inspected provider needs
  • Support learners towards data roles: portfolios, interviews, the "what next"

What we're looking for

  • Strong hands-on data analysis experience beyond entry level — SQL, a BI tool, and the judgement that comes from real work
  • Confident leading a room and setting a standard, not just presenting slides
  • Comfortable holding the standard across a large cohort and coordinating other coaches
  • Clear written English and a real eye for detail in feedback
  • A genuinely inclusive approach — you adapt so learners with different needs and starting points can all get there
  • AET Level 3 (Level 3 Award in Education and Training) or equivalent — or ready to complete it fast, before delivery starts (we fund it)
  • Experience delivering Skills Bootcamps is ideal
  • Able to be in London around 40% of the time (roughly two days a week) for the term

The essentials

  • Fixed-term contract, roughly four months. Starts October 2026, through to the week after the programme ends
  • London hybrid — around 40% in person at our E1 office (roughly two days a week)
  • Pay: £13,500–£20,000 for 4 months — £40k–£60k annualised — under PAYE
  • Enhanced DBS, safeguarding and Prevent training, and the right to work in the UK (we can't offer sponsorship)
  • Progression: depending on programme volume when the contract ends, there's a genuine route into further bootcamp delivery, trainer, or apprenticeship coaching roles with iO-Sphere

Location

This role is London-based — you'll be at our E1 office (by Liverpool Street) around 40% of the time, with the rest remote, working alongside the wider skills bootcamp team when you're in.

How we hire

A short screening call, a conversation with the delivery team you'd work with, and a practical task drawn from real delivery or marking rather than an invented puzzle. We move quickly — we need people ready for October.

Safeguarding

iO-Sphere is committed to safeguarding and operates within regulated Further Education environments. All applicants must complete their application honestly and in full, and consent to the pre-employment checks required for the role. Failure to disclose relevant information, or providing false information, will result in the application being withdrawn or employment being terminated.

Equal opportunities

iO-Sphere is an equal-opportunities employer. We hire on merit and welcome applications from every background. If you'd need any adjustment to the process, just tell us.

title: Technical Program Manager and Data Product Delivery Lead
description:
About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation come before competence. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will own the integrated delivery of three production data products across Peregrine and its delivery partners for a federal agency. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are.

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $150,000 to $165,000 per year. It is a remote position. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship; dual citizenship and green card holders are prohibited by the contract terms. It also requires the ability to satisfy the required suitability, security, and access requirements.

Your first project

Your first project turns a fixed schedule and a complex technical scope into clear decisions, accepted deliverables, and a stable team. You will deliver:

  • One integrated plan, backlog, calendar, risk register, decision log, and definition of done.
  • Delivery of all monthly milestones and formal deliverables with acceptance evidence prepared before submission.
  • A disciplined agile cadence that connects daily work, biweekly demonstrations, weekly management, and monthly government reporting.
  • Fast resolution of access, data, architecture, partner, staffing, and acceptance dependencies.
  • Clear writing. Status reports, risks, decisions, and escalations must be concise enough to act on immediately.
  • Visible performance management across all personnel, including partner resources and replacements.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

  • 8+ years leading technical delivery, including at least three enterprise data, analytics, cloud, or artificial intelligence (AI) programs
  • Working knowledge of data engineering, cloud platforms, analytics, testing, and model delivery. This is a technical delivery job, not an administrative coordinator
  • Experience managing federal customers, subcontractors, deliverables, acceptance, risk, reporting, and security-dependent onboarding
  • Practical agile leadership, including backlog management, sprint planning, demonstrations, retrospectives, and corrective action
  • Strong written and verbal communication. You must explain technical issues to executives and turn customer comments into controlled work
  • United States citizenship; dual citizenship and green card holders are prohibited by the contract terms
  • The ability to satisfy the required suitability, security, and access requirements

Preferred

  • Experience on a federal system accredited at Impact Level 5 (IL-5) or higher
  • Azure Databricks, Microsoft Power BI, ServiceNow, or federal financial and audit data experience
  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Scrum Master, product management, or a comparable delivery credential supported by real project results
  • Experience with firm fixed price delivery and acceptance-based invoicing

Who you are

You turn a fixed schedule and a complex technical scope into clear decisions, accepted deliverables, and a stable team. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What you bring

  • Calm under pressure and quick to surface bad news before it becomes expensive.
  • Direct, organized, low ego, and comfortable holding senior specialists accountable.
  • Able to work at executive altitude in one meeting and inspect a test plan or backlog in the next.
  • Protective of the customer relationship without hiding delivery facts from Peregrine leadership.
  • Persistent with access and dependency follow-up. Polite reminders alone will not move this program.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What we offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What we commit to

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

title: IT Business Analyst I
description:

As a Business Analyst you are responsible for meeting with stakeholders, understanding functional needs and desired outcomes, communicating needs (typically in form of user stories) to the impacted team(s) and effectively tracking relevant items through the Software Development Life Cycle. This includes, but is not limited to helping prioritize work along with participating in functional testing to confirm that desired outcomes are aligned to the long-term vision. You will also help prioritize and track requests, and test and deliver solutions to the business.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills and ability to build and maintain business relationships

title: Senior Principal Engineer, Information Systems
description:
Job Summary:


Mercury Systems is a leading technology company serving the global aerospace and defense industry across more than 20 locations. We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Principal, Information Systems to provide advanced technical leadership and drive the execution of critical network and infrastructure initiatives across multiple Mercury sites.

In this strategic individual‑contributor role, you will operate and serve as a recognized master in your discipline, establishing operational plans, guiding innovative engineering solutions, and shaping long‑term technology direction. You will influence enterprise‑wide technology standards, mentor engineers across locations, and deliver expert problem‑solving for difficult challenges requiring sound judgment and deep technical knowledge.

This role offers the opportunity to directly influence Mercury’s secure, scalable, and high‑performance technology environment and contribute meaningfully to the evolution of IT policies, architectures, and practices.

  • Provide senior‑level technical leadership and serve as a functional team lead for Information Systems Engineers across multiple sites, promoting technical consistency, knowledge sharing, and effective execution.
  • Design, deploy, monitor, and manage vital enterprise infrastructure (e.g. LAN, WAN, Wireless, Voice, etc.) with an emphasis on reliability, scalability, and security.
    Establish operational plans and develop tactical engineering strategies that support major network modernization, expansion, and optimization initiatives.
  • Research, evaluate, and recommend emerging technologies, architectures, and best practices that improve functional results and align with Mercury’s long‑term IT strategy.
    Lead complex incident response efforts, executing advanced diagnostics, root‑cause analysis, and resolution of hardware, software, and network‑related issues.
  • Act as the primary technical lead on major enterprise network projects from planning through implementation, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional leaders to shape IT policies, standards, and enterprise governance frameworks.
  • Ability to present technical findings, architectural recommendations, and operational performance updates to senior leadership as needed.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, reporting, and adherence to network security requirements and industry best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Typically requires 10+ years of related professional experience (aligned with Mercury IC5 Senior Principal level).
  • Expert knowledge of data networking and integration principles, architectures, and operational best practices.
  • Proven experience leading major network design, deployment, and modernization projects as a senior technical contributor.
  • Strong understanding of network security concepts, controls, and compliance considerations.
  • Experience working with domestic and international telecommunications vendors.
    Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and guide engineering teams in a multi‑site environment.
  • Ability to independently evaluate emerging technologies and recommend scalable, secure solutions.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve advanced hardware/software issues independently or collaboratively.
  • Experience with voice/video communication and room-based conferencing across 20 sites worldwide.
  • Proven Experience managing and supporting the following technologies:
    • Virtualization Technologies both on-prem and in the cloud.
    • Identity Management – Entra (Azure Identity), AWS, MS AD Management, ADFS, Radius
    • DNS, PKI, and Certificate Management
    • Storage, NAS, SAN – on-prem and cloud (Pure, Dell Power Store, NetApp, AWS, Azure,)
    • Enterprise Voice – Teams Enterprise/Business Phone Systems, Crestron
    • Backend Server Farm Management
  • This position requires you to have or obtain a government security clearance. Security clearances may only be granted to U.S. citizens.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Cisco certifications (CCNA, CCNP, CCIE).
  • Experience with Checkpoint firewalls, Juniper remote access solutions, NAC technologies, or ForeScout CounterAct.
  • Experience with routers, switches, cabling, TCP/IP, MPLS, VoIP, and data‑center networking.
  • Experience presenting technical strategies or operational updates to senior leadership.
    Experience providing technical mentorship or leading cross‑site engineering initiatives.
  • Familiar with AI technologies and extending AI into infrastructure in secure environments.

title: Lean Manufacturing Specialist
description:
Career Area:

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Pekerjaan Anda Membangun Dunia di Caterpillar.


Ketika Anda bergabung dengan Caterpillar, Anda bergabung dengan tim global yang peduli tidak hanya tentang pekerjaan yang kami lakukan – tetapi juga tentang satu sama lain. Kami adalah pembuat, pemecah masalah, dan pembangun dunia masa depan yang menciptakan komunitas yang lebih kuat dan berkelanjutan. Kami tidak hanya berbicara tentang kemajuan dan inovasi di sini – kami mewujudkannya, bersama dengan pelanggan kami, di tempat kami bekerja dan tinggal. Bersama-sama, kami membangun dunia yang lebih baik, sehingga kita semua dapat menikmati hidup di dalamnya.


Saat ini, kami sedang mencari Lean Manufacturing Specialist untuk bergabung dengan Quality team kami di Caterpillar Indonesia Batam.

Sebagai Lean Manufacturing Specialist, Anda bertanggung jawab mendukung implementasi budaya Lean dan Continuous Improvement (CI) melalui koordinasi aktivitas CI, audit, Gemba Walk, dan Value Stream Certification (VSC). Posisi ini juga mengelola data, dashboard, dan pelaporan kinerja Lean untuk mendukung pencapaian KPI serta berkolaborasi dengan tim lintas fungsi dalam mendukung Operational Excellence dan implementasi standar Lean.


Informasi Tambahan:
Shift: Normal
Lokasi Kerja: Batam, Kepulauan Riau
Jenis Pekerjaan: Kontrak 12 bulan
Anda akan bekerja di lingkungan kantor maupun di area produksi.

Relokasi domestik tidak tersedia untuk posisi ini.

Sebagai seorang Lean Manufacturing Specialist Anda akan:

  • Mendukung pelaksanaan program Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement (CI), Kaizen, dan Operational Excellence melalui koordinasi aktivitas, monitoring progres, serta pelaporan hasil perbaikan.
  • Mengelola dan memonitor dashboard Lean, status Continuous Improvement (CI), hasil audit, serta memastikan tindak lanjut temuan dan action plan diperbarui secara tepat waktu.
  • Menganalisis data dan menyiapkan laporan berkala untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan terkait aktivitas Lean dan Continuous Improvement.
  • Mendukung aktivitas Lean dan CI seperti Value Stream Certification (VSC), Lean Visual Management, Gemba Walk, Audit 5S, dan Standardized Work.
  • Memonitor penyelesaian action plan, corrective action, dan hasil Root Cause Analysis (RCA) melalui koordinasi dengan tim lintas fungsi dan stakeholder terkait.
  • Mengelola dokumentasi terkait pelatihan dan program awareness Lean.

Kandidat yang berhasil harus memiliki:

  • Pendidikan minimal Diploma (D3) atau Sarjana (S1) di bidang Teknik Industri, Teknik Manufaktur, Teknik Mesin, atau disiplin terkait.
  • Pengalaman kerja 1–3 tahun di lingkungan Manufaktur, Continuous Improvement (CI), Operational Excellence, Analisis data, Pelaporan atau Pengelolaan Proyek.
  • Memahami konsep Lean Manufacturing, termasuk CI, Kaizen, 5S, Waste Elimination, Standardized Work, Visual Management, Gemba Walk, dan Metodologi Problem Solving.
  • Memiliki kemampuan analisis data dan pelaporan yang baik, didukung penguasaan Microsoft Excel tingkat lanjut (Pivot Table, Lookup Function, Chart), kemampuan Power BI atau tools dashboard serupa menjadi nilai tambah.
  • Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, koordinasi, dan problem solving yang baik, bersifat proaktif, teliti, terorganisir, serta mampu mengelola beberapa prioritas dan memastikan tindak lanjut berjalan efektif.
  • Memiliki kemampuan Bahasa Inggris dasar hingga menengah (Basic to Intermediate) untuk kebutuhan komunikasi dan pelaporan.

Pekerjaan ini mungkin memerlukan banyak gerakan aktif di seluruh pabrik termasuk naik turun tangga dan anak tangga, mengangkat peralatan, serta mendorong dan menarik peralatan.

Odotamme sinulta päivittäistä läsnäoloa työpaikalla ja aktiivista otetta henkilöstön johtamiseen suoraan konehallin arjessa.

Odotamme sinulta

* Vankkaa teknistä ymmärrystä metallin työstöstä, erityisesti koneistus- ja hitsausmenetelmistä.

* Kykyä pitää tuotannon langat käsissä ja viestiä sujuvasti johdon kanssa.

* Mahdollisuuden työskennellä edelläkävijäyrityksessä huipputeknologian laitevalmistuksen parissa.

* Mahdollisuuden vuosibonukseen.

* Laajan ja kattavan työterveyshuollon.

* Kulttuuriedun vapaa-ajallesi.

* Säännöllisiä ja mukavia yhteisiä tapahtumia työkavereiden kesken.

Tule mukaan rakentamaan tulevaisuuden teknologiaa ja johtamaan konepajan ammattilaisia! Lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi WE Rekryn hakemuslinkin kautta mahdollisimman pian. Käsittelemme hakemuksia aktiivisesti heti haun käynnistyttyä.

title: Indonesia Project Lead (m/w/x)
description:
The BAMBU BARU project aims to position Indonesia as a leader in regenerative construction by leveraging regionally sourced bamboo given its wide availability across the archipelago. It builds on a foundational phase carried out through the ReBuilt Initiative (February 2023 - December 2025) , which explored locally specific pathways for shifting the built environment away from carbon-intensive materials toward nature-based alternatives, generating knowledge on natural systems and socio-spatial dynamics and developing a roadmap for regenerative development demonstrated by the award-winning BaleBio Pavilion in Bali, an 84-square-meter community hub built from engineered bamboo and salvaged materials to demonstrate active carbon sequestration.

Beyond individual pavilions, the project collaborates with the Indonesian Ministry of Housing to integrate Cement-Bamboo Frame Technology (CBFT) into national affordable housing standards and subsidy programs, creating a blueprint for climate-resilient, low-cost homes that support local economies and ecological restoration.

  • Pilot Management & In-Country Representation: Lead the overall planning, coordination, and execution of the BAMBU BARU Piloting Phase in Indonesia, serving as Bauhaus Earth's senior point of contact for key stakeholders while translating Berlin HQ strategy into local operations.

  • Team Leadership & Capacity Building: Direct, line-manage, and mentor a local multidisciplinary team, conducting regular 1:1 check-ins, structured feedback loops, and performance evaluations.

  • Work Package & Technical Oversight: Manage all study work packages, research timelines, (e.g., value chains, policy, implementation), ensuring strict quality control, budget compliance, and structural standards across material supply chains and prototyping.

  • Partner & Consortium Coordination: Facilitate active collaboration and weekly steering alignment across multi-partner consortiums, including Base Bahay Foundation, Bamboo Village Trust, and external consultants.

  • Digital Project Management & Strategic Alignment: Implement modern PM tool stacks (e.g., Asana, Google Workspace) for cross-time-zone alignment between Berlin and Indonesia, ensuring project delivery consistently matches funder expectations, risk matrices, and overall governance goals.

  • Risk Mitigation & Change Management: Continuously monitor operational, political, and logistical risks on the ground in Indonesia, establishing proactive mitigation strategies and escalating critical timeline or budget constraints to Berlin leadership.

  • Education: Master’s degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Urban Planning, International Development, environmental engineering,or a related degree in architecture or material science.

  • Project Management Experience: Proven track record of leading and managing complex, multi-partner projects funded by international donors, philanthropic foundations, or public grant schemes, specifically within construction, or built-environment contexts. This includes hands-on responsibility for milestone tracking, work package delivery, budget governance, risk mitigation, and formal funder reporting.

  • Regional Expertise: 4+ years of experience collaborating with one or more stakeholders, either government ministries, municipal partners, and/or developers in Indonesia.

  • Languages: Full professional fluency in both Bahasa Indonesia and English.

  • Travel Availability: Willingness and ability to travel to Indonesia approximately 3 to 4 times per year for on-site steering, stakeholder engagements, and site visits.

  • Material & Construction Knowledge: Familiarity with bamboo or nature-based construction systems and supply chains.

  • Stakeholder Diplomacy: Strong stakeholder management skills across government entities, international funders, research institutions, and NGO/consortium partners.

  • Methodological Alignment: Solid grasp of agile project management methodologies, quality assurance (QA) frameworks, and formal donor reporting structures.

  • German Language Skills: Proficiency or fluency in German is a plus, but not required.

  • High-Impact Work: Shape national housing standards and climate-resilient architecture at a transformational scale in South-East Asia.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with an international, highly interdisciplinary team of researchers, architects, and climate scientists in Berlin.

  • Strategic Autonomy: High level of ownership and authority to shape country strategy, direct operations, and lead senior government relationships.

  • Mission-Driven Culture: Purpose-led organization dedicated to climate action, circular building solutions, and transforming the built environment.

  • Professional Growth: Strategic position at the intersection of international development, sustainability innovation, and high-level stakeholder management.

Start Date: 1st November, 2026

title: Senior Data Engineer - Analytics Platform
description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Senior Data Engineer - Platform

Madrid Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home

Join Our Data Team at Ebury Valencia office.

Ebury's strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data team and we are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Platform Engineering team! Our mission is to develop, maintain and improve Ebury's Data Platform - this role owns the Analytics Platform: the tools, frameworks, and standards that empower our Data Analysts to deliver trusted insights at scale. You will manage the full lifecycle of our BI and visualization stack, built on Sigma, together with dbt and BigQuery as the core modelling and warehousing tools, and help evolve how analysts work - bringing software engineering practices into the analytics workflow.

Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve Ebury's analytics platform end-to-end, with Sigma as the core BI and visualization tool - administration, governance, versioning, and best practices
  • Define and manage the SDLC for analyst workflows across dbt and BigQuery: development standards, testing, code review, CI/CD, and release processes
  • Build the frameworks and guardrails that enable self-service analytics - ensuring dashboards and datasets are discoverable, documented, governed, and trustworthy
  • Champion metrics consistency across the organisation, ensuring business definitions are aligned between the warehouse, semantic models, and BI layer
  • Support and upskill the Data Analyst community, helping them adopt analytics-engineering practices (version control, testing, modular modelling) as their ways of working evolve
  • Provide observability for analyst-facing data products: usage analytics, freshness, data quality signals, and cost/performance optimisation of BI workloads on BigQuery
  • Collaborate closely with the rest of the Data Platform team - scheduler & infra, semantic layer, and AI platform - to deliver a coherent platform experience for all data domains
  • Drive continuous improvement by evaluating emerging BI and analytics tooling, patterns, and best practices in the modern data stack

About you

  • Self-motivation and curiosity, with a desire to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment, continuously improving both technical and business skills
  • Platform engineering experience building internal platforms consumed by other teams - ideally analytics or BI platforms
  • Hands-on expertise administering and scaling a modern BI tool (Sigma strongly preferred; experience with comparable tools such as Looker or Tableau also valued)
  • Deep experience with dbt and BigQuery - project structuring, testing strategies, performance and cost optimisation
  • Strong SQL proficiency and solid Python skills for tooling and automation
  • Experience establishing SDLC practices for analytics teams: Git workflows, CI/CD, testing, and documentation standards
  • Solid understanding of data governance concepts - lineage, access controls, cataloging - as they apply to the BI layer
  • Strong communication and enablement skills - you enjoy teaching, documenting, and raising the bar for how analysts work
  • Hands-on experience operating services on GCP is a plus
  • Fluency in English (Spanish, a plus)

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Discretionary bonus based on performance
  • Continued personal development through training and certification
  • We are Open Source friendly, following Open Source principles in our internal projects and encouraging contributions to external projects

About us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions - business accounts, hedging, and financing - on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.
